title: Nehemiah 10:29
text: joined with their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse and into an oath, to walk in the law of God, which had been given by Moses the servant of God, and to keep and do all the commandments of Jehovah our Lord, and his ordinances and his statutes;

title: Nehemiah 10:30
text: and that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons:

title: Nehemiah 10:31
text: and that if the peoples of the land brought wares or any grain on the sabbath day to sell, we would not take it of them on the sabbath, or on [any] holy day; and that we would leave [the land uncultivated] the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.

title: Nehemiah 10:32
text: ¶And we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God,

title: Nehemiah 10:33
text: for the bread to be set in rows, and for the continual oblation, and for the continual burnt-offering, [for that] of the sabbaths [and] of the new moons, for the set feasts and for the holy [things], and for the sin-offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and [for] all the work of the house of our God.

title: Nehemiah 10:34
text: And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood-offering, to bring [it] into the house of our God, according to our fathers' houses, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of Jehovah our God, as it is written in the law;

title: Nehemiah 10:35
text: and to bring the first-fruits of our land, and the first-fruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year to the house of Jehovah,

title: Nehemiah 10:36
text: and the firstborn of our sons and of our cattle, as it is written in the law; and to bring the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks to the house of our God, to the priests that minister in the house of our God;

title: Nehemiah 10:37
text: and that we should bring the first-fruits of our coarse meal and our heave-offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, new wine and oil, to the priests, into the chambers of the house of our God, and the tithes of our ground to the Levites, that they, the Levites, should take the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.

title: Nehemiah 10:38
text: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes; and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, into the chambers of the treasure-house.

title: Nehemiah 10:39
text: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the heave-offering of the corn, of the new wine and the oil, into the chambers, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the doorkeepers and the singers. And we will not forsake the house of our God.

title: Nehemiah 11:1
text: ¶And the princes of the people dwelt in Jerusalem; and the rest of the people cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the cities.

title: Nehemiah 11:2
text: And the people blessed all the men that willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.

title: Nehemiah 11:3
text: And these are the chiefs of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon's servants.

title: Nehemiah 11:4
text: And in Jerusalem dwelt some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Pherez;

title: Nehemiah 11:5
text: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.

title: Nehemiah 11:6
text: All the children of Pherez that dwelt in Jerusalem were four hundred and sixty-eight valiant men.

title: Nehemiah 11:7
text: And these are the children of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Isaiah;

title: Nehemiah 11:8
text: and after him, Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred and twenty-eight:

title: Nehemiah 11:9
text: and Joel the son of Zicri was their overseer, and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.

title: Nehemiah 11:10
text: Of the priests: Jedaiah [the son of] Joiarib, Jachin,

title: Nehemiah 11:11
text: Seraiah the son of Hilkijah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God.

title: Nehemiah 11:12
text: And their brethren that did the work of the house, eight hundred and twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah;

title: Nehemiah 11:13
text: and his brethren, chief fathers, two hundred and forty-two; and Amassai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer;

title: Nehemiah 11:14
text: and their brethren, mighty men of valour, a hundred and twenty-eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel the son of Gedolim.

title: Nehemiah 11:15
text: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

title: Nehemiah 11:16
text: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, [who were] over the outward work of the house of God;

title: Nehemiah 11:17
text: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, [who was] the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer; and Bakbukiah, the second among his brethren; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun:

title: Nehemiah 11:18
text: all the Levites in the holy city were two hundred and eighty-four.

title: Nehemiah 11:19
text: And the doorkeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren, that kept watch at the gates, were a hundred and seventy-two.

title: Nehemiah 11:20
text: ¶And the residue of Israel, the priests, [and] the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.

title: Nehemiah 11:21
text: And the Nethinim dwelt in Ophel; and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinim.

title: Nehemiah 11:22
text: And the overseer of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers, for the work of the house of God.

title: Nehemiah 11:23
text: For it was the king's commandment concerning them, and there was a settled portion for the singers, due for each day.

title: Nehemiah 11:24
text: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.

title: Nehemiah 11:25
text: And as to the hamlets in their fields, [some] of the children of Judah dwelt in Kirjath-Arba and its dependent villages, and in Dibon and its dependent villages, and in Jekabzeel and its dependent villages,

title: Nehemiah 11:26
text: and in Jeshua, and in Moladah, and in Beth-phelet,

title: Nehemiah 11:27
text: and in Hazar-Shual, and in Beer-sheba and its dependent villages,

title: Nehemiah 11:28
text: and in Ziklag, and in Meconah and its dependent villages;

title: Nehemiah 11:29
text: and in En-Rimmon, and in Zorah, and in Jarmuth,

title: Nehemiah 11:30
text: Zanoah, Adullam, and their hamlets, in Lachish and its fields, in Azekah and its dependent villages: and they encamped from Beer-sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.

title: Nehemiah 11:31
text: And the children of Benjamin from Geba [dwelt] in Michmash and Aija and Bethel, and their dependent villages,

title: Nehemiah 11:32
text: in Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

title: Nehemiah 11:33
text: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

title: Nehemiah 11:34
text: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

title: Nehemiah 11:35
text: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

title: Nehemiah 11:36
text: And of the Levites there were divisions of Judah [dwelling] in Benjamin.

title: Nehemiah 12:1
text: ¶And these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

title: Nehemiah 12:2
text: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

title: Nehemiah 12:3
text: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

title: Nehemiah 12:4
text: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,

title: Nehemiah 12:5
text: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

title: Nehemiah 12:6
text: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,

title: Nehemiah 12:7
text: Sallu, Amok, Hilkijah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.

title: Nehemiah 12:8
text: And the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, Mattaniah, [who was] over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren;

title: Nehemiah 12:9
text: and Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them as watches.

title: Nehemiah 12:10
text: And Jeshua begot Joiakim, and Joiakim begot Eliashib, and Eliashib begot Joiada,

title: Nehemiah 12:11
text: and Joiada begot Jonathan, and Jonathan begot Jaddua.

title: Nehemiah 12:12
text: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, chief fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

title: Nehemiah 12:13
text: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

title: Nehemiah 12:14
text: of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

title: Nehemiah 12:15
text: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

title: Nehemiah 12:16
text: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

title: Nehemiah 12:17
text: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin [and] Moadiah, Piltai;

title: Nehemiah 12:18
text: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

title: Nehemiah 12:19
text: and of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

title: Nehemiah 12:20
text: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

title: Nehemiah 12:21
text: of Hilkijah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.

title: Nehemiah 12:22
text: of the Levites, the chief fathers were recorded in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, and the priests, until the reign of Darius the Persian.

title: Nehemiah 12:23
text: The children of Levi, the chief fathers, were recorded in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

title: Nehemiah 12:24
text: And the chief Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise [and] to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.

title: Nehemiah 12:25
text: Mattaniah and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were doorkeepers keeping the ward at the storehouses of the gates.

title: Nehemiah 12:26
text: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.

title: Nehemiah 12:27
text: ¶And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to hold the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, [with] cymbals, lutes and harps.

title: Nehemiah 12:28
text: And the children of the singers were assembled, both from the plain [of Jordan] round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of the Netophathites,

title: Nehemiah 12:29
text: also from Beth-Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth; for the singers had built themselves hamlets round about Jerusalem.

title: Nehemiah 12:30
text: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves; and they purified the people, and the gates and the wall.

title: Nehemiah 12:31
text: And I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great choirs and processions, on the right hand upon the wall towards the dung-gate.

title: Nehemiah 12:32
text: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,

title: Nehemiah 12:33
text: and Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

title: Nehemiah 12:34
text: Judah and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

title: Nehemiah 12:35
text: and [certain] of the priests' sons with trumpets: Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph;

title: Nehemiah 12:36
text: and his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azareel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God; and Ezra the scribe before them.

title: Nehemiah 12:37
text: And at the fountain-gate, and over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the ascent of the wall, above the house of David, even to the water-gate eastward.

title: Nehemiah 12:38
text: And the second choir went in the opposite direction upon the wall, and I after them, and the half of the people, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even to the broad wall;

title: Nehemiah 12:39
text: and from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the gate of the old [wall], and above the fish-gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even to the sheep-gate; and they stood still in the prison-gate.

title: Nehemiah 12:40
text: And both choirs stood in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me;

title: Nehemiah 12:41
text: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, Hananiah, with trumpets;

title: Nehemiah 12:42
text: and Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud; and Jizrahiah was their overseer.

title: Nehemiah 12:43
text: And that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy; and also the women and the children rejoiced. And the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.

title: Nehemiah 12:44
text: ¶And at that time men were appointed over the chambers of the treasures for the heave-offerings, for the first-fruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them, out of the fields of the cities, the portions assigned by the law for the priests and the Levites; for Judah rejoiced over the priests, and over the Levites that waited.

title: Nehemiah 12:45
text: And, with the singers and the doorkeepers, they kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David [and] of Solomon his son.

title: Nehemiah 12:46
text: For of old, in the days of David and Asaph, there were the chiefs of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgivings to God.

title: Nehemiah 12:47
text: And all Israel, in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the doorkeepers, every day what was needed, and they consecrated things for the Levites; and the Levites consecrated for the children of Aaron.

title: Nehemiah 13:1
text: ¶On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and there was found written in it that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;

title: Nehemiah 13:2
text: because they had not met the children of Israel with bread and with water, and had hired Balaam against them, to curse them; but our God turned the curse into blessing.

title: Nehemiah 13:3
text: And it came to pass, when they heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.

title: Nehemiah 13:4
text: And before this, Eliashib the priest, who had the oversight of the chambers of the house of our God, a kinsman of Tobijah,

title: Nehemiah 13:5
text: had prepared for him a great chamber, where formerly they laid the oblations, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine and the oil, which was commanded for the Levites and the singers and the doorkeepers, and the heave-offerings of the priests.

title: Nehemiah 13:6
text: And during all that [time] I was not at Jerusalem; for in the two-and-thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I came to the king; and after some time I obtained leave of the king.

title: Nehemiah 13:7
text: And I came to Jerusalem, and observed the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobijah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.

title: Nehemiah 13:8
text: And it grieved me much, and I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobijah out of the chamber.

title: Nehemiah 13:9
text: And I commanded, and they purified the chambers; and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, the oblation and the frankincense.

title: Nehemiah 13:10
text: ¶And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given, and that the Levites and the singers that did the work had fled every one to his field.

title: Nehemiah 13:11
text: Then I contended with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together and set them in their place.

title: Nehemiah 13:12
text: And all Judah brought the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil into the storehouses.

title: Nehemiah 13:13
text: And I made storekeepers over the storehouses: Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah; and subordinate to them, Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were esteemed faithful, and their office was to distribute to their brethren.

title: Nehemiah 13:14
text: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds which I have done for the house of my God, and for the charges thereof!

title: Nehemiah 13:15
text: ¶In those days I saw in Judah some treading winepresses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading them on asses; as also wine, grapes and figs, and all manner of burdens; and they brought them into Jerusalem on the sabbath day; and I protested in the day on which they sold the victuals.

title: Nehemiah 13:16
text: Men of Tyre also dwelt therein, who brought fish and all manner of ware, and sold it on the sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

title: Nehemiah 13:17
text: And I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, What evil thing is this which ye do, profaning the sabbath day?

title: Nehemiah 13:18
text: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us and upon this city? And ye will bring more wrath against Israel by profaning the sabbath.

title: Nehemiah 13:19
text: And it came to pass, that when it began to be dark in the gates of Jerusalem before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut; and I commanded that they should not be opened till after the sabbath. And I set [some] of my servants at the gates, so that no burden should be brought in on the sabbath day.

title: Nehemiah 13:20
text: And the dealers and sellers of all kind of ware passed the night without Jerusalem once or twice.

title: Nehemiah 13:21
text: And I testified against them, and said to them, Why do ye pass the night before the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth they came not on the sabbath.

title: Nehemiah 13:22
text: And I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to hallow the sabbath day. Remember this also for me, my God, and spare me according to thy great loving-kindness!

title: Nehemiah 13:23
text: ¶In those days also I saw Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, [and] of Moab.

title: Nehemiah 13:24
text: And their children spoke half in the language of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews' language, but according to the language of each people.

title: Nehemiah 13:25
text: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them and plucked off their hair, and adjured them by God [saying], Ye shall not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters for your sons or for yourselves.

title: Nehemiah 13:26
text: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among the many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel; but even him did foreign wives cause to sin.

title: Nehemiah 13:27
text: And should we hearken to you to do all this great evil, to act unfaithfully to our God by marrying foreign wives?

title: Nehemiah 13:28
text: And [one] of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; and I chased him from me.

title: Nehemiah 13:29
text: Remember them, my God, for they are polluters of the priesthood, and of the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites!

title: Nehemiah 13:30
text: And I purified them from all foreigners, and appointed the charges of the priests and the Levites, every one in his service;

title: Nehemiah 13:31
text: and for the wood-offering, at times appointed, and for the first-fruits. Remember me, O my God, for good!

title: Esther 1:1
text: ¶And it came to pass in the days of Ahasuerus (that is, the Ahasuerus that reigned from India even to Ethiopia, over a hundred and twenty-seven provinces),

title: Esther 1:2
text: in those days, when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Shushan the fortress,

title: Esther 1:3
text: in the third year of his reign, he made a feast to all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media, the nobles and the princes of the provinces being before him;

title: Esther 1:4
text: when he shewed the glorious wealth of his kingdom and the splendid magnificence of his grandeur many days, a hundred and eighty days.

title: Esther 1:5
text: And when these days were expired, the king made a feast to all the people that were present in Shushan the fortress, both to great and small, seven days, in the court of the garden of the king's palace.

title: Esther 1:6
text: White, green, and blue [hangings] were fastened with cords of byssus and purple to silver rings and pillars of white marble; couches of gold and silver [lay] upon a pavement of red and white marble, and alabaster, and black marble.

title: Esther 1:7
text: And they gave drink in vessels of gold (the vessels being diverse one from another), and royal wine in abundance, according to the king's bounty.

title: Esther 1:8
text: And the drinking was, according to commandment, without constraint; for so the king had appointed to all the magnates of his house, that they should do according to every man's pleasure.

title: Esther 1:9
text: Also the queen Vashti made a feast for the women of the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus.

title: Esther 1:10
text: ¶On the seventh day, when the king's heart was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of king Ahasuerus,

title: Esther 1:11
text: to bring Vashti the queen before the king with the royal crown to shew the peoples and the princes her beauty; for she was of beautiful countenance.

title: Esther 1:12
text: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the word of the king which was [sent] by the chamberlains; and the king was very wroth, and his fury burned in him.

title: Esther 1:13
text: And the king said to the wise men who knew the times (for so was the king's business [conducted] before all that knew law and judgment;

title: Esther 1:14
text: and the next to him were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, [and] Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, who saw the king's face, and who sat first in the kingdom),

title: Esther 1:15
text: What shall be done to the queen Vashti according to law, because she has not performed the word of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains?

title: Esther 1:16
text: Then said Memucan before the king and the princes, The queen Vashti has not done wrong to the king only, but also to all the princes, and to all the peoples that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus.

title: Esther 1:17
text: For the act of the queen will come abroad to all women, so as to render their husbands contemptible in their eyes, when they shall say, The king Ahasuerus commanded the queen Vashti to be brought in before him, and she came not!

title: Esther 1:18
text: And the princesses of Persia and Media who have heard of the queen's act, will say it this day to all the king's princes, and there will be contempt and anger enough.

title: Esther 1:19
text: If it please the king, let a royal order go forth from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, that it may not pass, That Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate to another that is better than she;

title: Esther 1:20
text: and when the king's edict which he shall make shall be heard throughout his realm--for it is great--all the wives shall give to their husbands honour, from the greatest to the least.

title: Esther 1:21
text: And the saying pleased the king and the princes; and the king did according to the word of Memucan.

title: Esther 1:22
text: And he sent letters into all the king's provinces, into every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people according to their language, That every man should bear rule in his own house, and should speak according to the language of his people.

title: Esther 2:1
text: ¶After these things, when the fury of king Ahasuerus was appeased, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.

title: Esther 2:2
text: Then said the king's servants that attended upon him, Let there be maidens, virgins of beautiful countenance, sought for the king;

title: Esther 2:3
text: and let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the young virgins of beautiful countenance to Shushan the fortress, to the house of the women, unto the custody of Hegai the king's chamberlain, keeper of the women; and let their things for purification be given.

title: Esther 2:4
text: And let the maiden that pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti. And the thing pleased the king; and he did so.

title: Esther 2:5
text: There was in Shushan the fortress a certain Jew, whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjaminite,

title: Esther 2:6
text: who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captives who had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.

title: Esther 2:7
text: And he brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle's daughter; for she had neither father nor mother--and the maiden was fair and beautiful--and when her father and mother were dead, Mordecai took her for his own daughter.

title: Esther 2:8
text: And it came to pass when the king's commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the fortress, unto the custody of Hegai, that Esther also was brought into the king's house, unto the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.

title: Esther 2:9
text: And the maiden pleased him, and obtained favour before him; and he speedily gave her her things for purification, and her portions, and the seven maidens selected to be given her, out of the king's house; and he removed her and her maids to the best [place] of the house of the women.

title: Esther 2:10
text: Esther had not made known her people nor her birth; for Mordecai had charged her that she should not make it known.

title: Esther 2:11
text: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women's house, to know how Esther did, and what should become of her.

title: Esther 2:12
text: And when every maiden's turn came to go in to king Ahasuerus after that she had been treated for twelve months, according to the manner of the women (for so were the days of their purification accomplished--six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with spices, and with things for the purifying of the women,

title: Esther 2:13
text: and thus came the maiden in unto the king), whatever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women to the king's house.

title: Esther 2:14
text: In the evening she went, and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women, unto the custody of Shaashgaz, the king's chamberlain, keeper of the concubines. She came in to the king no more, unless the king delighted in her, and she were called by name.

title: Esther 2:15
text: And when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, came to go in to the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king's chamberlain, keeper of the women, appointed. And Esther obtained grace in the sight of all them that saw her.

title: Esther 2:16
text: So Esther was taken to king Ahasuerus, into his royal house, in the tenth month, that is, the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

title: Esther 2:17
text: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins, and he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

title: Esther 2:18
text: And the king made a great feast to all his princes and his servants, Esther's feast; and he made a release to the provinces, and gave presents according to the king's bounty.

title: Esther 2:19
text: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time, Mordecai sat in the king's gate.

title: Esther 2:20
text: (Esther, as Mordecai had charged her, had not yet made known her birth nor her people; for Esther did what Mordecai told her, like as when she was brought up with him.)

title: Esther 2:21
text: ¶In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king's gate, two of the king's chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those which kept the threshold, were wroth, and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

title: Esther 2:22
text: And the thing became known to Mordecai, and he related it to Esther the queen, and Esther told it to the king in Mordecai's name.

title: Esther 2:23
text: And the matter was investigated and found out; and they were both hanged on a tree. And it was written in the book of the chronicles before the king.

title: Esther 3:1
text: ¶After these things king Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes that were with him.

title: Esther 3:2
text: And all the king's servants that were in the king's gate bowed and did Haman reverence, for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai bowed not, nor did [him] reverence.

title: Esther 3:3
text: Then the king's servants, who were in the king's gate, said to Mordecai, Why transgressest thou the king's commandment?

title: Esther 3:4
text: And it came to pass as they spoke daily to him, and he hearkened not to them, that they informed Haman, to see whether Mordecai's matters would stand; for he had told them that he was a Jew.

title: Esther 3:5
text: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, Haman was full of fury.

title: Esther 3:6
text: But he scorned to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had made known to him the people of Mordecai; therefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were in all the kingdom of Ahasuerus--the people of Mordecai.

title: Esther 3:7
text: ¶In the first month, that is, the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman for each day and for each month, to the twelfth [month], that is, the month Adar.

title: Esther 3:8
text: And Haman said to king Ahasuerus, There is a people scattered abroad and dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of thy kingdom; and their laws are diverse from [those of] every people, and they keep not the king's laws; and it is not for the king's profit to suffer them.

title: Esther 3:9
text: If it please the king, let it be written that they may be destroyed, and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver into the hands of those that have charge of the affairs, to bring [it] into the king's treasuries.

title: Esther 3:10
text: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it to Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews' enemy.

title: Esther 3:11
text: And the king said to Haman, The silver is given to thee, the people also, to do with them as seems good to thee.

title: Esther 3:12
text: Then were the king's scribes called, in the first month, on the thirteenth day of the [month], and there was written according to all that Haman commanded unto the king's satraps, and to the governors over every province, and to the princes of every people; to every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people according to their language: in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written, and sealed with the king's ring.

title: Esther 3:13
text: And the letters were sent by couriers into all the king's provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, upon the thirteenth of the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar, and [to take] the spoil of them for a prey.

title: Esther 3:14
text: That the decree might be given in every province, a copy of the writing was published to all peoples, that they should be ready against that day.

title: Esther 3:15
text: The couriers went out, being hastened by the king's commandment, and the decree was given in Shushan the fortress. And the king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city of Shushan was in consternation.

title: Esther 4:1
text: ¶And when Mordecai knew all that was done, Mordecai rent his garments, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the midst of the city, and cried with a loud and bitter cry,

title: Esther 4:2
text: and came even before the king's gate; for none might enter into the king's gate clothed with sackcloth.

title: Esther 4:3
text: And in every province, wherever the king's commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing: many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

title: Esther 4:4
text: And Esther's maids and her chamberlains came and told [it] her; and the queen was exceedingly grieved: and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him; but he received [it] not.

title: Esther 4:5
text: ¶Then Esther called for Hatach, [one] of the king's chamberlains, whom he had appointed to wait upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to know what it was, and why it was.

title: Esther 4:6
text: And Hatach went forth to Mordecai, unto the public place of the city which was before the king's gate.

title: Esther 4:7
text: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened to him, and of the sum of money that Haman had promised to pay to the king's treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.

title: Esther 4:8
text: And he gave him a copy of the writing of the decree that had been given at Shushan to destroy them, to shew [it] to Esther, and to declare [it] to her, and to charge her that she should go in unto the king, to make supplication to him, and to make request before him, for her people.

title: Esther 4:9
text: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

title: Esther 4:10
text: And Esther spoke to Hatach, and gave him commandment unto Mordecai:

title: Esther 4:11
text: All the king's servants and the people of the king's provinces do know that whoever, whether man or woman, shall come to the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is *one* law, to put [him] to death, except [such] to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live; and I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.

title: Esther 4:12
text: And they told Mordecai Esther's words.

title: Esther 4:13
text: And Mordecai bade to answer Esther: Imagine not in thy heart that thou shalt escape in the king's house, more than all the Jews.

title: Esther 4:14
text: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there arise relief and deliverance to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father's house shall perish. And who knows whether thou art [not] come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

title: Esther 4:15
text: And Esther bade to answer Mordecai:

title: Esther 4:16
text: Go, gather together all the Jews that are found in Shushan, and fast for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise, and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law; and if I perish, I perish.

title: Esther 4:17
text: And Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

title: Esther 5:1
text: ¶And it came to pass on the third day, that Esther put on royal apparel, and stood in the inner court of the king's house, over against the king's house. And the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house, over against the entrance to the house.

title: Esther 5:2
text: And it was so, when the king saw the queen Esther standing in the court, that she obtained grace in his sight; and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand; and Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

title: Esther 5:3
text: And the king said to her, What wilt thou, queen Esther? and what is thy request? it shall be given thee even to the half of the kingdom.

title: Esther 5:4
text: And Esther said, If it seem good to the king, let the king and Haman come this day to the banquet that I have prepared for him.

title: Esther 5:5
text: And the king said, Hasten Haman, that it may be done as Esther has said. And the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

title: Esther 5:6
text: And the king said to Esther at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee; and what is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be done.

title: Esther 5:7
text: And Esther answered and said, My petition and my request is,

title: Esther 5:8
text: If I have found grace in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do to-morrow according to the king's word.

title: Esther 5:9
text: ¶And Haman went forth that day joyful and glad of heart; but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king's gate, that he stood not up nor moved for him, he was full of fury against Mordecai.

title: Esther 5:10
text: But Haman controlled himself, and came home; and he sent and called for his friends, and Zeresh his wife.

title: Esther 5:11
text: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

title: Esther 5:12
text: And Haman said, Yea, Esther the queen let no man come in with the king to the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to-morrow also I am invited to her with the king.

title: Esther 5:13
text: Yet all this is of no avail to me so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate.

title: Esther 5:14
text: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends to him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, and in the morning speak to the king that Mordecai may be hanged on it: then go in merrily with the king to the banquet. And the thing pleased Haman; and he caused the gallows to be made.

title: Esther 6:1
text: ¶On that night sleep fled from the king. And he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.

title: Esther 6:2
text: And it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king's chamberlains, keepers of the threshold, who had sought to lay hand on king Ahasuerus.

title: Esther 6:3
text: And the king said, What honour and dignity has been done to Mordecai for this? And the king's servants that attended upon him said, Nothing has been done for him.

title: Esther 6:4
text: ¶And the king said, Who is in the court? Now Haman had come into the outward court of the king's house, to speak to the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

title: Esther 6:5
text: And the king's servants said to him, Behold, Haman is standing in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.

title: Esther 6:6
text: So Haman came in. And the king said to him, What is to be done with the man whom the king delights to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to me?

title: Esther 6:7
text: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delights to honour,

title: Esther 6:8
text: let the royal apparel be brought with which the king arrays himself, and the horse that the king rides upon, and on the head of which the royal crown is set;

title: Esther 6:9
text: and let the apparel and horse be delivered into the hand of one of the king's most noble princes, and let them array the man whom the king delights to honour, and cause him to ride on the horse through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delights to honour!

title: Esther 6:10
text: And the king said to Haman, Make haste, take the apparel and the horse, as thou hast said, and do so to Mordecai the Jew, who sits at the king's gate: let nothing fail of all that thou hast said.

title: Esther 6:11
text: And Haman took the apparel and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and caused him to ride through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delights to honour!

title: Esther 6:12
text: ¶And Mordecai came again to the king's gate. But Haman hasted to his house, mourning and having his head covered.

title: Esther 6:13
text: And Haman recounted to Zeresh his wife and to all his friends all that had befallen him. Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife to him, If Mordecai be of the seed of the Jews, before whom thou hast begun to fall, thou shalt not prevail against him, but wilt certainly fall before him.

title: Esther 6:14
text: While they were yet talking with him, the king's chamberlains came, and hasted to bring Haman to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

title: Esther 7:1
text: ¶And the king and Haman came to drink with Esther the queen.

title: Esther 7:2
text: And the king said again to Esther on the second day, at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted thee; and what is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be done.

title: Esther 7:3
text: And Esther the queen answered and said, If I have found grace in thy sight, O king, and if it please the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request;

title: Esther 7:4
text: for we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen, I had held my tongue, although the adversary could not compensate the king's damage.

title: Esther 7:5
text: And king Ahasuerus spoke and said to Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he that has filled his heart to do so?

title: Esther 7:6
text: And Esther said, The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was terrified before the king and the queen.

title: Esther 7:7
text: ¶And the king in his wrath rose up from the banquet of wine, [and went] into the palace garden; but Haman stayed to make request for his life to Esther the queen, for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

title: Esther 7:8
text: And the king returned out of the palace garden into the house of the banquet of wine, and Haman was fallen upon the couch on which Esther was. And the king said, Will he even force the queen before me in the house? The word went forth out of the king's mouth, and they covered Haman's face.

title: Esther 7:9
text: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold, also, the gallows fifty cubits high, that Haman made for Mordecai, who spoke good for the king, stands in the house of Haman. And the king said, Hang him on it!

title: Esther 7:10
text: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. And the king's wrath was appeased.

title: Esther 8:1
text: ¶On that day did king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews' oppressor to Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was to her.

title: Esther 8:2
text: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai. And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.

title: Esther 8:3
text: ¶And Esther spoke yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his device which he had devised against the Jews.

title: Esther 8:4
text: And the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. And Esther arose and stood before the king,

title: Esther 8:5
text: and said, If it please the king and if I have found grace before him, and the thing seem right to the king, and I be pleasing in his sight, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews that are in all the king's provinces.

title: Esther 8:6
text: For how shall I endure to see the evil that shall befall my people? and how shall I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?

title: Esther 8:7
text: And king Ahasuerus said to queen Esther and to Mordecai the Jew, Behold, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he stretched forth his hand against the Jews.

title: Esther 8:8
text: Write ye then for the Jews as seems good to you, in the king's name, and seal [it] with the king's ring. For a writing that is written in the king's name, and sealed with the king's ring, cannot be reversed.

title: Esther 8:9
text: Then were the king's scribes called at that time, in the third month, that is, the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth [day] thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded, to the Jews, and to the satraps, and the governors, and the princes of the provinces which are from India even to Ethiopia, a hundred and twenty-seven provinces, to every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people according to their language, and to the Jews according to their writing and according to their language.

title: Esther 8:10
text: And he wrote in the name of king Ahasuerus, and sealed [it] with the king's ring, and sent letters by couriers on horseback riding on coursers, horses of blood reared in the breeding studs:

title: Esther 8:11
text: [stating] that the king granted the Jews that were in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that might assault them, [their] little ones and women, and to [take] the spoil of them for a prey,

title: Esther 8:12
text: upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, upon the thirteenth of the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar.

title: Esther 8:13
text: That the decree might be given in every province, a copy of the writing was published to all the peoples, and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

title: Esther 8:14
text: The couriers mounted on coursers [and] horses of blood went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king's commandment. And the decree was given at Shushan the fortress.

title: Esther 8:15
text: ¶And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a mantle of byssus and purple; and the city of Shushan shouted and was glad.

title: Esther 8:16
text: The Jews had light, and joy, and gladness, and honour.

title: Esther 8:17
text: And in every province, and in every city, wherever the king's commandment and his decree came, the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many among the peoples of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews had fallen upon them.

title: Esther 9:1
text: ¶And in the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar, on the thirteenth day thereof, when the king's commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, in the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have power over them (but it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had power over them that hated them),

title: Esther 9:2
text: the Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout the provinces of king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their hurt. And no man could withstand them; for the fear of them had fallen upon all the peoples.

title: Esther 9:3
text: And all the princes of the provinces, and the satraps, and the governors and officers of the king, helped the Jews; for the fear of Mordecai had fallen upon them.

title: Esther 9:4
text: For Mordecai was great in the king's house, and his fame went forth throughout the provinces; for the man Mordecai became continually greater.

title: Esther 9:5
text: And the Jews smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword and slaughter and destruction, and did what they would to those that hated them.

title: Esther 9:6
text: And in Shushan the fortress the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men.

title: Esther 9:7
text: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,

title: Esther 9:8
text: and Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,

title: Esther 9:9
text: and Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,

title: Esther 9:10
text: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the oppressor of the Jews, they slew; but they laid not their hands on the prey.

title: Esther 9:11
text: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the fortress was brought before the king.

title: Esther 9:12
text: And the king said to Esther the queen, The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the fortress, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king's provinces? And what is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee; and what is thy request further? and it shall be done.

title: Esther 9:13
text: And Esther said, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Jews that are in Shushan to do to-morrow also according to this day's decree, and let Haman's ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.

title: Esther 9:14
text: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman's ten sons.

title: Esther 9:15
text: And the Jews that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but they laid not their hand on the prey.

title: Esther 9:16
text: And the other Jews that were in the king's provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their life, and had rest from their enemies; and they slew of them that hated them seventy-five thousand (but they laid not their hand on the prey),

title: Esther 9:17
text: on the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and joy.

title: Esther 9:18
text: But the Jews that were at Shushan gathered themselves together on the thirteenth [day] thereof, and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and joy.

title: Esther 9:19
text: Therefore the Jews of the villages that dwell in the country towns make the fourteenth of the month Adar a day of joy and feasting, and a good day, and on which they send portions one to another.

title: Esther 9:20
text: ¶And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters to all the Jews near and far that were in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus,

title: Esther 9:21
text: to establish [this] among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,

title: Esther 9:22
text: as the days on which the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month that was turned to them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day; that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.

title: Esther 9:23
text: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written to them.

title: Esther 9:24
text: For Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the oppressor of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is, the lot, to consume them and to destroy them;

title: Esther 9:25
text: and when [Esther] came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he had devised against the Jews, should return upon his own head; and they hanged him and his sons on the gallows.

title: Esther 9:26
text: Therefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore, according to all the words of this letter, and for what they had seen concerning this matter and what had happened to them,

title: Esther 9:27
text: the Jews ordained and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves to them, so that it should not fail, that they would observe these two days according to their writing and according to their fixed time, every year;

title: Esther 9:28
text: and that these days should be remembered and observed throughout every generation, in every family, every province, and every city, and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor the memorial of them cease from among their seed.

title: Esther 9:29
text: And queen Esther the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim.

title: Esther 9:30
text: And he sent letters to all the Jews, to the hundred and twenty-seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, words of peace and truth,

title: Esther 9:31
text: to confirm these days of Purim in their fixed times, according as Mordecai the Jew and queen Esther had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, as to the matters of the fastings and their cry.

title: Esther 9:32
text: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

title: Esther 10:1
text: ¶And king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land and the isles of the sea.

title: Esther 10:2
text: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

title: Esther 10:3
text: For Mordecai the Jew was second to king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the welfare of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.

title: Job 1:1
text: ¶There was a man in the land of Uz whose name was Job; and this man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God and abstained from evil.

title: Job 1:2
text: And there were born to him seven sons and three daughters.

title: Job 1:3
text: And his substance was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she-asses, and very many servants; and this man was greater than all the children of the east.

title: Job 1:4
text: ¶And his sons went and made a feast in the house of each one on his day; and they sent and invited their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

title: Job 1:5
text: And it was so, when the days of the feasting were gone about, that Job sent and hallowed them; and he rose up early in the morning, and offered up burnt-offerings [according to] the number of them all; for Job said, It may be that my children have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.

title: Job 1:6
text: ¶And there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before Jehovah; and Satan came also among them.

title: Job 1:7
text: And Jehovah said to Satan, Whence comest thou? And Satan answered Jehovah and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

title: Job 1:8
text: And Jehovah said to Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him on the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God and abstaineth from evil?

title: Job 1:9
text: And Satan answered Jehovah and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?

title: Job 1:10
text: Hast not thou made a hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? Thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is spread abroad in the land.

title: Job 1:11
text: But put forth thy hand now and touch all that he hath, [and see] if he will not curse thee to thy face!

title: Job 1:12
text: And Jehovah said to Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy hand; only upon himself put not forth thy hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of Jehovah.

title: Job 1:13
text: ¶And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in the house of their brother, the firstborn.

title: Job 1:14
text: And there came a messenger to Job and said, The oxen were ploughing, and the asses feeding beside them;

title: Job 1:15
text: and [they of] Sheba fell [upon them] and took them, and the servants have they smitten with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped, alone, to tell thee.

title: Job 1:16
text: While he was yet speaking, there came another and said, The fire of God fell from heaven and burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped, alone, to tell thee.

title: Job 1:17
text: While he was yet speaking, there came another and said, The Chaldeans made three bands, and fell upon the camels and took them, and the servants have they smitten with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped, alone, to tell thee.

title: Job 1:18
text: While he was yet speaking, there came another and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in the house of their brother, the firstborn;

title: Job 1:19
text: and behold, there came a great wind from over the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they died; and I only am escaped, alone, to tell thee.

title: Job 1:20
text: ¶And Job rose up, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshipped;

title: Job 1:21
text: and he said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: Jehovah gave, and Jehovah hath taken away; blessed be the name of Jehovah!

title: Job 1:22
text: In all this Job sinned not, nor ascribed anything unseemly to God.

title: Job 2:1
text: ¶And there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before Jehovah, and Satan also came among them to present himself before Jehovah.

title: Job 2:2
text: And Jehovah said to Satan, From whence comest thou? And Satan answered Jehovah and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

title: Job 2:3
text: And Jehovah said to Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him on the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God and abstaineth from evil? and still he remaineth firm in his integrity, though thou movedst me against him, to swallow him up without cause.

title: Job 2:4
text: And Satan answered Jehovah and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life;

title: Job 2:5
text: but put forth thy hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, [and see] if he will not curse thee to thy face!

title: Job 2:6
text: And Jehovah said to Satan, Behold, he is in thy hand; only spare his life.

title: Job 2:7
text: ¶And Satan went forth from the presence of Jehovah; and he smote Job with a grievous botch from the sole of his foot unto his crown.

title: Job 2:8
text: And he took a potsherd to scrape himself with; and he sat among the ashes.

title: Job 2:9
text: And his wife said to him, Dost thou still remain firm in thine integrity? curse God and die.

title: Job 2:10
text: But he said to her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. We have also received good from God, and should we not receive evil? In all this Job did not sin with his lips.

title: Job 2:11
text: ¶And three friends of Job heard of all this evil that was come upon him. And they came each one from his place: Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to condole with him and to comfort him.

title: Job 2:12
text: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice and wept. And they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward the heavens.

title: Job 2:13
text: And they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights; and none spoke a word to him; for they saw that [his] anguish was very great.

title: Job 3:1
text: ¶After this, Job opened his mouth and cursed his day.

title: Job 3:2
text: And Job answered and said,

title: Job 3:3
text: Let the day perish in which I was born, and the night that said, There is a man child conceived.

title: Job 3:4
text: That day--let it be darkness, let not +God care for it from above, neither let light shine upon it:

title: Job 3:5
text: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it; let clouds dwell upon it; let darkeners of the day terrify it.

title: Job 3:6
text: That night--let gloom seize upon it; let it not rejoice among the days of the year; let it not come into the number of the months.

title: Job 3:7
text: Behold, let that night be barren; let no joyful sound come therein;

title: Job 3:8
text: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to rouse Leviathan;

title: Job 3:9
text: Let the stars of its twilight be dark; let it wait for light, and have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the dawn:

title: Job 3:10
text: Because it shut not up the doors of the womb that bore me, and hid not trouble from mine eyes.

title: Job 3:11
text: ¶Wherefore did I not die from the womb, --come forth from the belly and expire?

title: Job 3:12
text: Why did the knees meet me? and wherefore the breasts, that I should suck?

title: Job 3:13
text: For now should I have lain down and been quiet; I should have slept: then had I been at rest,

title: Job 3:14
text: With kings and counsellors of the earth, who build desolate places for themselves,

title: Job 3:15
text: Or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

title: Job 3:16
text: Or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants that have not seen the light.

title: Job 3:17
text: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the wearied are at rest.

title: Job 3:18
text: The prisoners together are at ease; they hear not the voice of the taskmaster.

title: Job 3:19
text: The small and great are there, and the bondman freed from his master.

title: Job 3:20
text: ¶Wherefore is light given to him that is in trouble, and life to those bitter of soul,

title: Job 3:21
text: Who long for death, and it [cometh] not, and dig for it more than for hidden treasures;

title: Job 3:22
text: Who rejoice even exultingly and are glad when they find the grave? --

title: Job 3:23
text: To the man whose way is hidden, and whom +God hath hedged in?

title: Job 3:24
text: For my sighing cometh before my bread, and my groanings are poured out like the waters.

title: Job 3:25
text: For I feared a fear, and it hath come upon me, and that which I dreaded hath come to me.

title: Job 3:26
text: I was not in safety, neither had I quietness, neither was I at rest, and trouble came.

title: Job 4:1
text: ¶And Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

title: Job 4:2
text: If a word were essayed to thee, wouldest thou be grieved? But who can refrain from speaking?

title: Job 4:3
text: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands;

title: Job 4:4
text: Thy words have upholden him that was stumbling, and thou hast braced up the bending knees:

title: Job 4:5
text: But now it is come upon thee, and thou grievest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

title: Job 4:6
text: Hath not thy piety been thy confidence, and the perfection of thy ways thy hope?

title: Job 4:7
text: ¶Remember, I pray thee, who that was innocent has perished? and where were the upright cut off?

title: Job 4:8
text: Even as I have seen, they that plough iniquity and sow mischief, reap the same.

title: Job 4:9
text: By the breath of +God they perish, and by the blast of his nostrils are they consumed.

title: Job 4:10
text: The roar of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken;

title: Job 4:11
text: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the whelps of the lioness are scattered.

title: Job 4:12
text: ¶Now to me a word was secretly brought, and mine ear received a whisper thereof.

title: Job 4:13
text: In thoughts from visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men: --

title: Job 4:14
text: Fear came on me, and trembling, and made all my bones to shake;

title: Job 4:15
text: And a spirit passed before my face--the hair of my flesh stood up--

title: Job 4:16
text: It stood still; I could not discern the appearance thereof: a form was before mine eyes; I heard a slight murmur and a voice:

title: Job 4:17
text: Shall [mortal] man be more just than +God? Shall a man be purer than his Maker?

title: Job 4:18
text: Lo, he trusteth not his servants, and his angels he chargeth with folly:

title: Job 4:19
text: How much more them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed as the moth!

title: Job 4:20
text: From morning to evening are they smitten: without any heeding it, they perish for ever.

title: Job 4:21
text: Is not their tent-cord torn away in them? they die, and without wisdom.

title: Job 5:1
text: ¶Call, I pray thee! Is there any that answereth thee? and to which of the holy ones wilt thou turn?

title: Job 5:2
text: For vexation killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the simple.

title: Job 5:3
text: I myself saw the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

title: Job 5:4
text: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, and there is no deliverer:

title: Job 5:5
text: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh even out of the thorns; and the snare gapeth for his substance.

title: Job 5:6
text: ¶For evil cometh not forth from the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

title: Job 5:7
text: For man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upwards.

title: Job 5:8
text: But as for me I will seek unto *God, and unto God commit my cause;

title: Job 5:9
text: Who doeth great things and unsearchable, marvellous things without number;

title: Job 5:10
text: Who giveth rain on the face of the earth, and sendeth waters on the face of the fields;

title: Job 5:11
text: Setting up on high those that are low; and mourners are exalted to prosperity.

title: Job 5:12
text: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, and their hands carry not out the enterprise.

title: Job 5:13
text: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness; and the counsel of the wily is carried headlong:

title: Job 5:14
text: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope at midday as in the night.

title: Job 5:15
text: And he saveth the needy from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.

title: Job 5:16
text: So the poor hath what he hopeth for, and unrighteousness stoppeth her mouth.

title: Job 5:17
text: ¶Behold, happy is the man whom +God correcteth; therefore despise not the chastening of the Almighty.

title: Job 5:18
text: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up; he woundeth, and his hands make whole.

title: Job 5:19
text: He will deliver thee in six troubles, and in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

title: Job 5:20
text: In famine he will redeem thee from death, and in war from the power of the sword.

title: Job 5:21
text: Thou shalt be hidden from the scourge of the tongue; and thou shalt not be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

title: Job 5:22
text: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh, and of the beasts of the earth thou shalt not be afraid.

title: Job 5:23
text: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field, and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

title: Job 5:24
text: And thou shalt know that thy tent is in peace; and thou wilt survey thy fold, and miss nothing.

title: Job 5:25
text: And thou shalt know that thy seed is numerous, and thine offspring as the herb of the earth.

title: Job 5:26
text: Thou shalt come to the grave in a ripe age, as a shock of corn is brought in in its season.

title: Job 5:27
text: Behold this, we have searched it out, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thyself.

title: Job 6:1
text: ¶And Job answered and said,

title: Job 6:2
text: Oh that my grief were thoroughly weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!

title: Job 6:3
text: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas; therefore my words are vehement.

title: Job 6:4
text: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, their poison drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of +God are arrayed against me.

title: Job 6:5
text: Doth the wild ass bray by the grass? loweth an ox over his fodder?

title: Job 6:6
text: Shall that which is insipid be eaten without salt? Is there any taste in the white of an egg?

title: Job 6:7
text: What my soul refuseth to touch, that is as my loathsome food.

title: Job 6:8
text: ¶Oh that I might have my request, and that +God would grant my desire!

title: Job 6:9
text: And that it would please +God to crush me, that he would let loose his hand and cut me off!

title: Job 6:10
text: Then should I yet have comfort; and in the pain which spareth not I would rejoice that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

title: Job 6:11
text: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should have patience?

title: Job 6:12
text: Is my strength the strength of stones? is my flesh of brass?

title: Job 6:13
text: Is it not that there is no help in me, and soundness is driven away from me?

title: Job 6:14
text: ¶For him that is fainting kindness [is meet] from his friend; or he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

title: Job 6:15
text: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a stream, as the channel of streams which pass away,

title: Job 6:16
text: Which are turbid by reason of the ice, in which the snow hideth itself:

title: Job 6:17
text: At the time they diminish, they are dried up; when heat affecteth them, they vanish from their place:

title: Job 6:18
text: They wind about in the paths of their course, they go off into the waste and perish.

title: Job 6:19
text: The caravans of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba counted on them:

title: Job 6:20
text: They are ashamed at their hope; they come thither, and are confounded.

title: Job 6:21
text: So now ye are nothing; ye see a terrible object and are afraid.

title: Job 6:22
text: ¶Did I say, Bring unto me, and make me a present from your substance?

title: Job 6:23
text: Or, rescue me from the hand of the oppressor, and redeem me from the hand of the violent?

title: Job 6:24
text: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue; and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

title: Job 6:25
text: How forcible are right words! but what doth your upbraiding reprove?

title: Job 6:26
text: Do ye imagine to reprove words? The speeches of one that is desperate are indeed for the wind.

title: Job 6:27
text: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and dig [a pit] for your friend.

title: Job 6:28
text: Now therefore if ye will, look upon me; and it shall be to your face if I lie.

title: Job 6:29
text: Return, I pray you, let there be no wrong; yea, return again, my righteousness shall be in it.

title: Job 6:30
text: Is there wrong in my tongue? cannot my taste discern mischievous things?

title: Job 7:1
text: ¶Hath not man a life of labour upon earth? and are not his days like the days of a hireling?

title: Job 7:2
text: As a bondman earnestly desireth the shadow, and a hireling expecteth his wages,

title: Job 7:3
text: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.

title: Job 7:4
text: If I lie down, I say, When shall I rise up, and the darkness be gone? and I am full of tossings until the dawn.

title: Job 7:5
text: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and suppurates.

title: Job 7:6
text: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.

title: Job 7:7
text: ¶Remember thou that my life is wind; mine eye shall no more see good.

title: Job 7:8
text: The eye of him that hath seen me shall behold me no [more]: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.

title: Job 7:9
text: The cloud consumeth and vanisheth away; so he that goeth down to Sheol shall not come up.

title: Job 7:10
text: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him again.

title: Job 7:11
text: Therefore I will not restrain my mouth: I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

title: Job 7:12
text: Am I a sea, or a sea-monster, that thou settest a watch over me?

title: Job 7:13
text: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;

title: Job 7:14
text: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions;

title: Job 7:15
text: So that my soul chooseth strangling, death, rather than my bones.

title: Job 7:16
text: I loathe it; I shall not live always: let me alone, for my days are a breath.

title: Job 7:17
text: ¶What is man, that thou makest much of him? and that thou settest thy heart upon him?

title: Job 7:18
text: And that thou visitest him every morning, triest him every moment?

title: Job 7:19
text: How long wilt thou not look away from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?

title: Job 7:20
text: Have I sinned, what do I unto thee, thou Observer of men? Why hast thou set me as an object of assault for thee, so that I am become a burden to myself?

title: Job 7:21
text: And why dost not thou forgive my transgression and take away mine iniquity? for now shall I lie down in the dust, and thou shalt seek me early, and I shall not be.

title: Job 8:1
text: ¶And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,

title: Job 8:2
text: How long wilt thou speak these things? and the words of thy mouth be a strong wind?

title: Job 8:3
text: Doth *God pervert judgment, and the Almighty pervert justice?

title: Job 8:4
text: If thy children have sinned against him, he hath also given them over into the hand of their transgression.

title: Job 8:5
text: If thou seek earnestly unto *God, and make thy supplication to the Almighty,

title: Job 8:6
text: If thou be pure and upright, surely now he will awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous;

title: Job 8:7
text: And though thy beginning was small, yet thine end shall be very great.

title: Job 8:8
text: ¶For inquire, I pray thee, of the former generation, and attend to the researches of their fathers;

title: Job 8:9
text: For we are [but] of yesterday, and know nothing, for our days upon earth are a shadow.

title: Job 8:10
text: Shall not they teach thee, [and] tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?

title: Job 8:11
text: Doth the papyrus shoot up without mire? doth the reed-grass grow without water?

title: Job 8:12
text: Whilst it is yet in its greenness [and] not cut down, it withereth before any [other] grass.

title: Job 8:13
text: So are the paths of all that forget *God; and the profane man's hope shall perish,

title: Job 8:14
text: Whose confidence shall be cut off, and his reliance is a spider's web.

title: Job 8:15
text: He shall lean upon his house, and it shall not stand; he shall lay hold on it, but it shall not endure.

title: Job 8:16
text: He is full of sap before the sun, and his sprout shooteth forth over his garden;

title: Job 8:17
text: His roots are entwined about the stoneheap; he seeth the place of stones.

title: Job 8:18
text: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him: I have not seen thee!

title: Job 8:19
text: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the dust shall others grow.

title: Job 8:20
text: ¶Behold, *God will not cast off a perfect man, neither will he take evil-doers by the hand.

title: Job 8:21
text: Whilst he would fill thy mouth with laughing and thy lips with shouting,

title: Job 8:22
text: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame, and the tent of the wicked be no more.

title: Job 9:1
text: ¶And Job answered and said,

title: Job 9:2
text: Of a truth I know it is so; but how can man be just with *God?

title: Job 9:3
text: If he shall choose to strive with him, he cannot answer him one thing of a thousand.

title: Job 9:4
text: He is wise in heart and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and had peace?

title: Job 9:5
text: Who removeth mountains, and they know it not, when he overturneth them in his anger;

title: Job 9:6
text: Who shaketh the earth out of its place, and the pillars thereof tremble;

title: Job 9:7
text: Who commandeth the sun, and it riseth not, and he sealeth up the stars;

title: Job 9:8
text: Who alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the high waves of the sea;

title: Job 9:9
text: Who maketh the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the chambers of the south;

title: Job 9:10
text: Who doeth great things past finding out, and wonders without number.

title: Job 9:11
text: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see [him] not; and he passeth along, and I perceive him not.

title: Job 9:12
text: Behold, he taketh away: who will hinder him? Who will say unto him, What doest thou?

title: Job 9:13
text: +God withdraweth not his anger; the proud helpers stoop under him:

title: Job 9:14
text: ¶How much less shall I answer him, choose out my words [to strive] with him?

title: Job 9:15
text: Whom, though I were righteous, [yet] would I not answer; I would make supplication to my judge.

title: Job 9:16
text: If I had called, and he had answered me, I would not believe that he hearkened to my voice, --

title: Job 9:17
text: He, who crusheth me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.

title: Job 9:18
text: He suffereth me not to take my breath, for he filleth me with bitternesses.

title: Job 9:19
text: Be it a question of strength, lo, [he is] strong; and be it of judgment, who will set me a time?

title: Job 9:20
text: If I justified myself, mine own mouth would condemn me; were I perfect, he would prove me perverse.

title: Job 9:21
text: Were I perfect, [yet] would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.

title: Job 9:22
text: ¶It is all one; therefore I said, he destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

title: Job 9:23
text: If the scourge kill suddenly, he mocketh at the trial of the innocent.

title: Job 9:24
text: The earth is given over into the hand of the wicked [man]; he covereth the faces of its judges. If not, who then is it?

title: Job 9:25
text: ¶And my days are swifter than a runner: they flee away, they see no good.

title: Job 9:26
text: They pass by like skiffs of reed; as an eagle that swoops upon the prey.

title: Job 9:27
text: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my [sad] countenance, and brighten up,

title: Job 9:28
text: I am afraid of all my sorrows; I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.

title: Job 9:29
text: Be it that I am wicked, why then do I labour in vain?

title: Job 9:30
text: If I washed myself with snow-water, and cleansed my hands in purity,

title: Job 9:31
