text: Then wouldest thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes would abhor me.

title: Job 9:32
text: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him; that we should come together in judgment.

title: Job 9:33
text: There is not an umpire between us, who should lay his hand upon us both.

title: Job 9:34
text: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his terror make me afraid,

title: Job 9:35
text: [Then] I will speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.

title: Job 10:1
text: ¶My soul is weary of my life: I will give free course to my complaint; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

title: Job 10:2
text: I will say unto +God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou strivest with me.

title: Job 10:3
text: Doth it please thee to oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thy hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

title: Job 10:4
text: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?

title: Job 10:5
text: Are thy days as the days of a mortal? are thy years as a man's days,

title: Job 10:6
text: That thou searchest after mine iniquity, and inquirest into my sin;

title: Job 10:7
text: Since thou knowest that I am not wicked, and that there is none that delivereth out of thy hand?

title: Job 10:8
text: ¶Thy hands have bound me together and made me as one, round about; yet dost thou swallow me up!

title: Job 10:9
text: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as clay, and wilt bring me into dust again.

title: Job 10:10
text: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?

title: Job 10:11
text: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews;

title: Job 10:12
text: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy care hath preserved my spirit;

title: Job 10:13
text: And these things didst thou hide in thy heart; I know that this was with thee.

title: Job 10:14
text: ¶If I sinned, thou wouldest mark me, and thou wouldest not acquit me of mine iniquity.

title: Job 10:15
text: If I were wicked, woe unto me! and righteous, I will not lift up my head, being [so] full of shame, and beholding mine affliction; --

title: Job 10:16
text: And it increaseth: thou huntest me as a fierce lion; and ever again thou shewest thy marvellous power upon me.

title: Job 10:17
text: Thou renewest thy witnesses before me and increasest thy displeasure against me; successions [of evil] and a time of toil are with me.

title: Job 10:18
text: And wherefore didst thou bring me forth out of the womb? I had expired, and no eye had seen me.

title: Job 10:19
text: I should be as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

title: Job 10:20
text: Are not my days few? cease then and let me alone, that I may revive a little,

title: Job 10:21
text: Before I go, and never to return, --to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;

title: Job 10:22
text: A land of gloom, as darkness itself; of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as thick darkness.

title: Job 11:1
text: ¶And Zophar the Naamathite answered and said,

title: Job 11:2
text: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man of much talk be justified?

title: Job 11:3
text: Should thy fictions make men hold their peace? and shouldest thou mock, and no one make [thee] ashamed?

title: Job 11:4
text: For thou sayest, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.

title: Job 11:5
text: But oh that +God would speak, and open his lips against thee;

title: Job 11:6
text: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, how that they are the double of what is realised; and know that +God passeth by [much] of thine iniquity!

title: Job 11:7
text: ¶Canst thou by searching find out +God? canst thou find out the Almighty to perfection?

title: Job 11:8
text: [It is as] the heights of heaven; what wilt thou do? deeper than Sheol; what canst thou know?

title: Job 11:9
text: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

title: Job 11:10
text: If he pass by, and shut up, and call to judgment, who can hinder him?

title: Job 11:11
text: For he knoweth vain men, and seeth wickedness when [man] doth not consider it;

title: Job 11:12
text: Yet a senseless man will make bold, though man be born [like] the foal of a wild ass.

title: Job 11:13
text: ¶If thou prepare thy heart and stretch out thy hands toward him,

title: Job 11:14
text: If thou put far away the iniquity which is in thy hand, and let not wrong dwell in thy tents;

title: Job 11:15
text: Surely then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot, and thou shalt be stedfast and shalt not fear:

title: Job 11:16
text: For thou shalt forget misery; as waters that are passed away shalt thou remember it;

title: Job 11:17
text: And life shall arise brighter than noonday; though thou be enshrouded in darkness, thou shalt be as the morning,

title: Job 11:18
text: And thou shalt have confidence, because there shall be hope; and having searched about [thee], thou shalt take rest in safety.

title: Job 11:19
text: Yea, thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; and many shall seek thy favour.

title: Job 11:20
text: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and [all] refuge shall vanish from them, and their hope [shall be] the breathing out of life.

title: Job 12:1
text: ¶And Job answered and said,

title: Job 12:2
text: Truly ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you!

title: Job 12:3
text: I also have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you; and who knoweth not such things as these?

title: Job 12:4
text: I am to be one that is a derision to his friend, I who call upon +God, and whom he will answer: a derision is the just upright [man].

title: Job 12:5
text: He that is ready to stumble with the foot is a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.

title: Job 12:6
text: ¶The tents of desolators are in peace, and they that provoke *God are secure; into whose hand +God bringeth.

title: Job 12:7
text: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowl of the heavens, and they shall tell thee;

title: Job 12:8
text: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee; and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

title: Job 12:9
text: Who knoweth not in all these, that the hand of Jehovah hath wrought this?

title: Job 12:10
text: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the spirit of all flesh of man.

title: Job 12:11
text: Doth not the ear try words, as the palate tasteth food?

title: Job 12:12
text: ¶With the aged is wisdom, and in length of days understanding.

title: Job 12:13
text: With him is wisdom and might; he hath counsel and understanding.

title: Job 12:14
text: Behold, he breaketh down, and it is not built again; he shutteth up a man, and there is no opening.

title: Job 12:15
text: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up; and he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

title: Job 12:16
text: With him is strength and effectual knowledge; the deceived and the deceiver are his.

title: Job 12:17
text: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and judges maketh he fools;

title: Job 12:18
text: He weakeneth the government of kings, and bindeth their loins with a fetter;

title: Job 12:19
text: He leadeth priests away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty;

title: Job 12:20
text: He depriveth of speech the trusty, and taketh away the judgment of the elders;

title: Job 12:21
text: He poureth contempt upon nobles, and slackeneth the girdle of the mighty;

title: Job 12:22
text: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out into light the shadow of death;

title: Job 12:23
text: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them; he spreadeth out the nations, and bringeth them in;

title: Job 12:24
text: He taketh away the understanding of the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a pathless waste.

title: Job 12:25
text: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunkard.

title: Job 13:1
text: ¶Lo, mine eye hath seen all [this], mine ear hath heard and understood it.

title: Job 13:2
text: What ye know, I know also: I am not inferior to you.

title: Job 13:3
text: But I will speak to the Almighty, and will find pleasure in reasoning with *God;

title: Job 13:4
text: For ye indeed are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.

title: Job 13:5
text: Oh that ye would be altogether silent! and it would be your wisdom.

title: Job 13:6
text: Hear now my defence, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

title: Job 13:7
text: Will ye speak unrighteously for *God? and for him speak deceit?

title: Job 13:8
text: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for *God?

title: Job 13:9
text: Will it be well if he should search you out? or as one mocketh at a man, will ye mock at him?

title: Job 13:10
text: He will certainly reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.

title: Job 13:11
text: Shall not his excellency terrify you? and his dread fall upon you?

title: Job 13:12
text: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes, your bulwarks are bulwarks of mire.

title: Job 13:13
text: ¶Hold your peace from me, and I will speak, and let come on me what [will]!

title: Job 13:14
text: Wherefore should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

title: Job 13:15
text: Behold, if he slay me, yet would I trust in him; but I will defend mine own ways before him.

title: Job 13:16
text: This also shall be my salvation, that a profane man shall not come before his face.

title: Job 13:17
text: Hear attentively my speech and my declaration with your ears.

title: Job 13:18
text: Behold now, I have ordered the cause; I know that I shall be justified.

title: Job 13:19
text: Who is he that contendeth with me? For if I were silent now, I should expire.

title: Job 13:20
text: Only do not two things unto me; then will I not hide myself from thee.

title: Job 13:21
text: Withdraw thy hand far from me; and let not thy terror make me afraid:

title: Job 13:22
text: Then call, and I will answer; or I will speak, and answer thou me.

title: Job 13:23
text: ¶How many are mine iniquities and sins? Make me to know my transgression and my sin.

title: Job 13:24
text: Wherefore dost thou hide thy face, and countest me for thine enemy?

title: Job 13:25
text: Wilt thou terrify a driven leaf? and wilt thou pursue dry stubble?

title: Job 13:26
text: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth;

title: Job 13:27
text: And thou puttest my feet in the stocks, and markest all my paths; thou settest a bound about the soles of my feet; --

title: Job 13:28
text: One who, as a rotten thing consumeth, as a garment that the moth eateth.

title: Job 14:1
text: ¶Man, born of woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.

title: Job 14:2
text: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down; and he fleeth as a shadow, and continueth not.

title: Job 14:3
text: Yet dost thou open thine eyes upon such a one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?

title: Job 14:4
text: Who can bring a clean [man] out of the unclean? Not one!

title: Job 14:5
text: If his days are determined, if the number of his months is with thee, [and] thou hast appointed his bounds which he must not pass,

title: Job 14:6
text: Look away from him; and let him rest, till he accomplish, as a hireling, his day.

title: Job 14:7
text: ¶For there is hope for a tree: if it be cut down, it will sprout again, and its tender branch will not cease;

title: Job 14:8
text: Though its root grow old in the earth, and its stock die in the ground,

title: Job 14:9
text: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and put forth boughs like a young plant.

title: Job 14:10
text: But a man dieth, and is prostrate; yea, man expireth, and where is he?

title: Job 14:11
text: The waters recede from the lake, and the river wasteth and drieth up:

title: Job 14:12
text: So man lieth down, and riseth not again; till the heavens be no more, they do not awake, nor are raised out of their sleep.

title: Job 14:13
text: Oh that thou wouldest hide me in Sheol, that thou wouldest keep me secret until thine anger be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me, --

title: Job 14:14
text: (If a man die, shall he live [again]?) all the days of my time of toil would I wait, till my change should come:

title: Job 14:15
text: Thou wouldest call, and I would answer thee; thou wouldest have a desire after the work of thy hands.

title: Job 14:16
text: ¶For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?

title: Job 14:17
text: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou heapest up mine iniquity.

title: Job 14:18
text: And indeed a mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of its place;

title: Job 14:19
text: The waters wear the stones, the floods thereof wash away the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.

title: Job 14:20
text: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth away; thou changest his countenance, and dismissest him.

title: Job 14:21
text: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, and he perceiveth it not.

title: Job 14:22
text: But his flesh hath pain for himself alone, and his soul mourneth for himself.

title: Job 15:1
text: ¶And Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

title: Job 15:2
text: Should a wise man answer with windy knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind,

title: Job 15:3
text: Reasoning with unprofitable talk, and with speeches which do no good?

title: Job 15:4
text: Yea, thou makest piety of none effect, and restrainest meditation before *God.

title: Job 15:5
text: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou hast chosen the tongue of the crafty.

title: Job 15:6
text: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I; and thy lips testify against thee.

title: Job 15:7
text: Art thou the first man that was born? and wast thou brought forth before the hills?

title: Job 15:8
text: Hast thou listened in the secret council of +God? And hast thou absorbed wisdom for thyself?

title: Job 15:9
text: What knowest thou that we know not? [what] understandest thou which is not in us?

title: Job 15:10
text: Both the greyheaded and the aged are with us, older than thy father.

title: Job 15:11
text: Are the consolations of *God too small for thee? and the word gently spoken to thee?

title: Job 15:12
text: Why doth thy heart carry thee away? and why do thine eyes wink?

title: Job 15:13
text: That thou turnest thy spirit against *God, and lettest words go out of thy mouth?

title: Job 15:14
text: What is man, that he should be pure? and he that is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

title: Job 15:15
text: Behold, he putteth no trust in his holy ones, and the heavens are not pure in his sight:

title: Job 15:16
text: How much less the abominable and corrupt, --man, that drinketh unrighteousness like water!

title: Job 15:17
text: ¶I will shew thee, listen to me; and what I have seen I will declare;

title: Job 15:18
text: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hidden;

title: Job 15:19
text: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.

title: Job 15:20
text: All his days the wicked man is tormented, and numbered years are allotted to the violent.

title: Job 15:21
text: The sound of terrors is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer cometh upon him.

title: Job 15:22
text: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is singled out for the sword.

title: Job 15:23
text: He wandereth abroad for bread, --where may it be? He knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

title: Job 15:24
text: Distress and anguish make him afraid; they prevail against him, as a king ready for the battle.

title: Job 15:25
text: For he hath stretched out his hand against *God, and strengthened himself against the Almighty:

title: Job 15:26
text: He runneth against him, with [outstretched] neck, with the thick bosses of his bucklers;

title: Job 15:27
text: For he hath covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat upon [his] flanks.

title: Job 15:28
text: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, in houses that no man inhabiteth, which are destined to become heaps.

title: Job 15:29
text: He shall not become rich, neither shall his substance continue, and their possessions shall not extend upon the earth.

title: Job 15:30
text: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches; and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

title: Job 15:31
text: Let him not trust in vanity: he is deceived, for vanity shall be his recompense;

title: Job 15:32
text: It shall be complete before his day, and his branch shall not be green.

title: Job 15:33
text: He shall shake off his unripe grapes as a vine, and shall cast his flower as an olive.

title: Job 15:34
text: For the family of the ungodly shall be barren, and fire shall consume the tents of bribery.

title: Job 15:35
text: They conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity, and their belly prepareth deceit.

title: Job 16:1
text: ¶And Job answered and said,

title: Job 16:2
text: I have heard many such things: grievous comforters are ye all.

title: Job 16:3
text: Shall words of wind have an end? or what provoketh thee that thou answerest?

title: Job 16:4
text: I also could speak as ye: if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could join together words against you, and shake my head at you;

title: Job 16:5
text: [But] I would encourage you with my mouth, and the solace of my lips should assuage [your pain].

title: Job 16:6
text: ¶If I speak, my pain is not assuaged; and if I forbear, what am I eased?

title: Job 16:7
text: But now he hath made me weary; ...thou hast made desolate all my family;

title: Job 16:8
text: Thou hast shrivelled me up! it is become a witness; and my leanness riseth up against me, it beareth witness to my face.

title: Job 16:9
text: His anger teareth and pursueth me; he gnasheth with his teeth against me; [as] mine adversary he sharpeneth his eyes at me.

title: Job 16:10
text: They gape upon me with their mouth; they smite my cheeks reproachfully; they range themselves together against me.

title: Job 16:11
text: *God hath delivered me over to the iniquitous man, and hurled me into the hands of the wicked.

title: Job 16:12
text: I was at rest, but he hath shattered me; he hath taken me by the neck and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.

title: Job 16:13
text: His arrows encompass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.

title: Job 16:14
text: He breaketh me with breach upon breach; he runneth upon me like a mighty man.

title: Job 16:15
text: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and rolled my horn in the dust.

title: Job 16:16
text: My face is red with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

title: Job 16:17
text: ¶Although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

title: Job 16:18
text: O earth, cover not my blood, and let there be no place for my cry!

title: Job 16:19
text: Even now, behold, my Witness is in the heavens, and he that voucheth for me is in the heights.

title: Job 16:20
text: My friends are my mockers; mine eye poureth out tears unto +God.

title: Job 16:21
text: Oh that there were arbitration for a man with +God, as a son of man for his friend!

title: Job 16:22
text: For years [few] in number shall pass, --and I shall go the way [whence] I shall not return.

title: Job 17:1
text: ¶My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are mine.

title: Job 17:2
text: Are there not mockers around me? and doth [not] mine eye abide in their provocation?

title: Job 17:3
text: Lay down now [a pledge], be thou surety for me with thyself: who is he that striketh hands with me?

title: Job 17:4
text: For thou hast hidden their heart from understanding; therefore thou wilt not exalt [them].

title: Job 17:5
text: He that betrayeth friends for a prey--even the eyes of his children shall fail.

title: Job 17:6
text: And he hath made me a proverb of the peoples; and I am become one to be spit on in the face.

title: Job 17:7
text: And mine eye is dim by reason of grief, and all my members are as a shadow.

title: Job 17:8
text: Upright men [shall be] astonished at this, and the innocent shall be stirred up against the ungodly;

title: Job 17:9
text: But the righteous shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall increase in strength.

title: Job 17:10
text: ¶But as for you all, pray come on again; and I shall not find one wise man among you.

title: Job 17:11
text: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, the cherished thoughts of my heart.

title: Job 17:12
text: They change the night into day; the light [they imagine] near in presence of the darkness.

title: Job 17:13
text: If I wait, Sheol is my house; I spread my bed in the darkness:

title: Job 17:14
text: I cry to the grave, Thou art my father! to the worm, My mother, and my sister!

title: Job 17:15
text: And where is then my hope? yea, my hope, who shall see it?

title: Job 17:16
text: It shall go down to the bars of Sheol, when [our] rest shall be together in the dust.

title: Job 18:1
text: ¶And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,

title: Job 18:2
text: How long will ye hunt for words? Be intelligent, and then we will speak.

title: Job 18:3
text: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed stupid in your sight?

title: Job 18:4
text: Thou that tearest thyself in thine anger, shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of its place?

title: Job 18:5
text: ¶Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the flame of his fire shall not shine.

title: Job 18:6
text: The light shall become dark in his tent, and his lamp over him shall be put out.

title: Job 18:7
text: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

title: Job 18:8
text: For he is sent into the net by his own feet, and he walketh on the meshes;

title: Job 18:9
text: The gin taketh [him] by the heel, the snare layeth hold on him;

title: Job 18:10
text: A cord is hidden for him in the ground, and his trap in the way.

title: Job 18:11
text: ¶Terrors make him afraid on every side, and chase him at his footsteps.

title: Job 18:12
text: His strength is hunger-bitten, and calamity is ready at his side.

title: Job 18:13
text: The firstborn of death devoureth the members of his body; it will devour his members.

title: Job 18:14
text: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tent, and it shall lead him away to the king of terrors:

title: Job 18:15
text: They who are none of his shall dwell in his tent; brimstone shall be showered upon his habitation:

title: Job 18:16
text: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off;

title: Job 18:17
text: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name on the pasture-grounds.

title: Job 18:18
text: He is driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

title: Job 18:19
text: He hath neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining in the places of his sojourn.

title: Job 18:20
text: They that come after shall be astonished at his day, as they that went before [them] were affrighted.

title: Job 18:21
text: Surely, such are the dwellings of the unrighteous man, and such the place of him that knoweth not *God.

title: Job 19:1
text: ¶And Job answered and said,

title: Job 19:2
text: How long will ye vex my soul, and crush me with words?

title: Job 19:3
text: These ten times have ye reproached me; ye are not ashamed to stupefy me.

title: Job 19:4
text: And be it [that] I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.

title: Job 19:5
text: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and prove against me my reproach,

title: Job 19:6
text: Know now that +God hath overthrown me, and hath surrounded me with his net.

title: Job 19:7
text: Behold, I cry out of wrong, and I am not heard; I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.

title: Job 19:8
text: ¶He hath hedged up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.

title: Job 19:9
text: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

title: Job 19:10
text: He breaketh me down on every side, and I am gone; and my hope hath he torn up as a tree.

title: Job 19:11
text: And he hath kindled his anger against me, and hath counted me unto him as one of his enemies.

title: Job 19:12
text: His troops have come together and cast up their way against me, and have encamped round about my tent.

title: Job 19:13
text: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are quite estranged from me.

title: Job 19:14
text: My kinsfolk have failed, and my known friends have forgotten me.

title: Job 19:15
text: The sojourners in my house and my maids count me as a stranger; I am an alien in their sight.

title: Job 19:16
text: I called my servant, and he answered not; I entreated him with my mouth.

title: Job 19:17
text: My breath is strange to my wife, and my entreaties to the children of my [mother's] womb.

title: Job 19:18
text: Even young children despise me; I rise up, and they speak against me.

title: Job 19:19
text: All my intimate friends abhor me, and they whom I loved are turned against me.

title: Job 19:20
text: My bones cleave to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

title: Job 19:21
text: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, ye my friends; for the hand of +God hath touched me.

title: Job 19:22
text: Why do ye persecute me as *God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

title: Job 19:23
text: ¶Oh would that my words were written! oh that they were inscribed in a book!

title: Job 19:24
text: That with an iron style and lead they were graven in the rock for ever!

title: Job 19:25
text: And [as for] me, I know that my Redeemer liveth, and the Last, he shall stand upon the earth;

title: Job 19:26
text: And [if] after my skin this shall be destroyed, yet from out of my flesh shall I see +God;

title: Job 19:27
text: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another: --my reins are consumed within me.

title: Job 19:28
text: If ye say, How shall we persecute him? when the root of the matter is found in me,

title: Job 19:29
text: Be ye yourselves afraid of the sword! for the sword is fury against misdeeds, that ye may know there is a judgment.

title: Job 20:1
text: ¶And Zophar the Naamathite answered and said,

title: Job 20:2
text: Therefore do my thoughts give me an answer, and for this is my haste within me.

title: Job 20:3
text: I hear a reproof putting me to shame; and [my] spirit answereth me by mine understanding.

title: Job 20:4
text: Knowest thou [not] this, that of old, since man was placed upon earth,

title: Job 20:5
text: The exultation of the wicked is short, and the joy of the ungodly man but for a moment?

title: Job 20:6
text: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds,

title: Job 20:7
text: Like his own dung doth he perish for ever; they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?

title: Job 20:8
text: He flieth away as a dream, and is not found; and is chased away as a vision of the night.

title: Job 20:9
text: The eye which saw him shall [see him] not again; and his place beholdeth him no more.

title: Job 20:10
text: ¶His children shall seek the favour of the poor, and his hands restore his wealth.

title: Job 20:11
text: His bones were full of his youthful strength; but it shall lie down with him in the dust.

title: Job 20:12
text: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth [and] he hide it under his tongue,

title: Job 20:13
text: [Though] he spare it, and forsake it not, but keep it within his mouth,

title: Job 20:14
text: His food is turned in his bowels; it is the gall of asps within him.

title: Job 20:15
text: He hath swallowed down riches, but he shall vomit them up again: *God shall cast them out of his belly.

title: Job 20:16
text: He shall suck the poison of asps; the viper's tongue shall kill him.

title: Job 20:17
text: He shall not see streams, rivers, brooks of honey and butter.

title: Job 20:18
text: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and not swallow down; its restitution shall be according to the value, and he shall not rejoice [therein].

title: Job 20:19
text: For he hath oppressed, hath forsaken the poor; he hath violently taken away a house that he did not build.

title: Job 20:20
text: Because he knew no rest in his craving, he shall save nought of what he most desired.

title: Job 20:21
text: Nothing escaped his greediness; therefore his prosperity shall not endure.

title: Job 20:22
text: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits; every hand of the wretched shall come upon him.

title: Job 20:23
text: ¶It shall be that, to fill his belly, he will cast his fierce anger upon him, and will rain it upon him into his flesh.

title: Job 20:24
text: If he have fled from the iron weapon, the bow of brass shall strike him through.

title: Job 20:25
text: He draweth it forth; it cometh out of his body, and the glittering point out of his gall: terrors are upon him.

title: Job 20:26
text: All darkness is laid up for his treasures: a fire not blown shall devour him; it shall feed upon what is left in his tent.

title: Job 20:27
text: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity, and the earth shall rise up against him.

title: Job 20:28
text: The increase of his house shall depart, flowing away in the day of his anger.

title: Job 20:29
text: This is the portion of the wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed to him by *God.

title: Job 21:1
text: ¶And Job answered and said,

title: Job 21:2
text: Hear attentively my speech, and let this replace your consolations.

title: Job 21:3
text: Suffer me and I will speak; and after I have spoken, mock on!

title: Job 21:4
text: As for me, is my complaint to a man? or wherefore should not my spirit be impatient?

title: Job 21:5
text: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay the hand upon the mouth.

title: Job 21:6
text: Even when I think [thereon], I am affrighted, and trembling taketh hold of my flesh.

title: Job 21:7
text: ¶Wherefore do the wicked live, grow old, yea, become mighty in power?

title: Job 21:8
text: Their seed is established with them in their sight, and their offspring before their eyes.

title: Job 21:9
text: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of +God upon them.

title: Job 21:10
text: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

title: Job 21:11
text: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

title: Job 21:12
text: They shout to the tambour and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

title: Job 21:13
text: They spend their days in prosperity, and in a moment go down to Sheol.

title: Job 21:14
text: And they say unto *God, Depart from us, for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways!

title: Job 21:15
text: What is the Almighty that we should serve him? and what are we profited if we pray unto him?

title: Job 21:16
text: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked be far from me!

title: Job 21:17
text: ¶How often is the lamp of the wicked put out, and cometh their calamity upon them? Doth he distribute sorrows [to them] in his anger?

title: Job 21:18
text: Do they become as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away?

title: Job 21:19
text: +God layeth up [the punishment of] his iniquity for his children; he rewardeth him, and he shall know [it]:

title: Job 21:20
text: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the fury of the Almighty.

title: Job 21:21
text: For what pleasure should he have in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

title: Job 21:22
text: Can any teach *God knowledge? And he it is that judgeth those that are high.

title: Job 21:23
text: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet;

title: Job 21:24
text: His sides are full of fat, and the marrow of his bones is moistened;

title: Job 21:25
text: And another dieth in bitterness of soul, and hath not tasted good:

title: Job 21:26
text: Together they lie down in the dust, and the worms cover them.

title: Job 21:27
text: ¶Lo, I know your thoughts, and the devices ye wrongfully imagine against me.

title: Job 21:28
text: For ye say, Where is the house of the noble? and where the tent of the dwellings of the wicked?

title: Job 21:29
text: Have ye not asked the wayfarers? and do ye not regard their tokens:

title: Job 21:30
text: That the wicked is reserved for the day of calamity? They are led forth to the day of wrath.

title: Job 21:31
text: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?

title: Job 21:32
text: Yet is he carried to the graves, and watch is kept over the tomb.

title: Job 21:33
text: The clods of the valley are sweet unto him; and every man followeth suit after him, as there were innumerable before him.

title: Job 21:34
text: How then comfort ye me in vain? Your answers remain perfidious.

title: Job 22:1
text: ¶And Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

title: Job 22:2
text: Can a man be profitable to *God? surely it is unto himself that the wise man is profitable.

title: Job 22:3
text: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty if thou art righteous? And is it gain [to him] that thou makest thy ways perfect?

title: Job 22:4
text: Will he reason with thee for fear of thee? Will he enter with thee into judgment?

title: Job 22:5
text: ¶Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities without end?

title: Job 22:6
text: For thou hast taken a pledge of thy brother for nought, and stripped off the clothing of the naked.

title: Job 22:7
text: Thou hast not given water to the fainting to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

title: Job 22:8
text: But the powerful man, he had the land; and the man of high rank dwelt in it.

title: Job 22:9
text: Widows hast thou sent empty away, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

title: Job 22:10
text: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;

title: Job 22:11
text: Or darkness, that thou canst not see, and floods of waters cover thee.

title: Job 22:12
text: Is not +God in the height of the heavens? And behold the summit of the stars: how exalted are they!

title: Job 22:13
text: And thou sayest, What doth *God know? will he judge through the dark cloud?

title: Job 22:14
text: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh on the vault of the heavens.

title: Job 22:15
text: ¶Dost thou mark the ancient path which wicked men have trodden?

title: Job 22:16
text: Who were carried off before the time, whose foundation was overflowed with a flood;

title: Job 22:17
text: Who said unto *God, Depart from us! and what could the Almighty do to them?

title: Job 22:18
text: Yet he filled their houses with good. But the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

title: Job 22:19
text: The righteous see it, and are glad; and the innocent laugh them to scorn:

title: Job 22:20
text: Is not he who rose against us destroyed, and doth not the fire consume his residue?

title: Job 22:21
text: ¶Reconcile thyself now with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.

title: Job 22:22
text: Receive, I pray thee, instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in thy heart.

title: Job 22:23
text: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up. If thou remove unrighteousness far from thy tents,

title: Job 22:24
text: And put the precious ore with the dust, and [the gold of] Ophir among the stones of the torrents,

title: Job 22:25
text: Then the Almighty will be thy precious ore, and silver heaped up unto thee;

title: Job 22:26
text: Yea, then shalt thou delight thyself in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto +God:

title: Job 22:27
text: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he will hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows;

title: Job 22:28
text: And thou shalt decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee; and light shall shine upon thy ways.

title: Job 22:29
text: When they are made low, then thou shalt say, Rise up! and he shall save him that is of downcast eyes.

title: Job 22:30
text: [Even] him that is not innocent shall he deliver; yea, he shall be delivered by the pureness of thy hands.

title: Job 23:1
text: ¶And Job answered and said,

title: Job 23:2
text: Even to-day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.

title: Job 23:3
text: Oh that I knew where I might find him, that I might come to his seat!

title: Job 23:4
text: I would order the cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments;

title: Job 23:5
text: I would know the words he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.

title: Job 23:6
text: Would he plead against me with [his] great power? Nay; but he would give heed unto me.

title: Job 23:7
text: There would an upright man reason with him; and I should be delivered for ever from my judge.

title: Job 23:8
text: ¶Lo, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I do not perceive him;

title: Job 23:9
text: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I behold [him] not; he hideth himself on the right hand, and I see [him] not.

title: Job 23:10
text: But he knoweth the way that I take; he trieth me, I shall come forth as gold.

title: Job 23:11
text: My foot hath held to his steps; his way have I kept, and not turned aside.

title: Job 23:12
text: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have laid up the words of his mouth more than the purpose of my own heart.

title: Job 23:13
text: ¶But he is in one [mind], and who can turn him? And what his soul desireth, that will he do.

title: Job 23:14
text: For he will perform [what] is appointed for me; and many such things are with him.

title: Job 23:15
text: Therefore am I troubled at his presence; I consider, and I am afraid of him.

title: Job 23:16
text: For *God hath made my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me;

title: Job 23:17
text: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he hidden the gloom from me.

title: Job 24:1
text: ¶Why are not times treasured up with the Almighty? why do not they that know him see his days?

title: Job 24:2
text: They remove the landmarks; they violently take away the flocks and pasture them;

title: Job 24:3
text: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge;

title: Job 24:4
text: They turn the needy out of the way: the afflicted of the land all hide themselves.

title: Job 24:5
text: Lo, [as] wild asses in the desert, they go forth to their work, seeking early for the prey: the wilderness [yieldeth] them food for [their] children.

title: Job 24:6
text: They reap in the field the fodder thereof, and they gather the vintage of the wicked;

title: Job 24:7
text: They pass the night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold;

title: Job 24:8
text: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and for want of a shelter embrace the rock...

title: Job 24:9
text: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor:

title: Job 24:10
text: These go naked without clothing, and, hungry, they bear the sheaf;

title: Job 24:11
text: They press out oil within their walls, they tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.

title: Job 24:12
text: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out; and +God imputeth not the impiety.

title: Job 24:13
text: ¶There are those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

title: Job 24:14
text: The murderer riseth with the light, killeth the afflicted and needy, and in the night is as a thief.

title: Job 24:15
text: And the eye of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me; and he putteth a covering on [his] face.

title: Job 24:16
text: In the dark they dig through houses; by day they shut themselves in; they know not the light:

title: Job 24:17
text: For the morning is to them all [as] the shadow of death; for they are familiar with the terrors of the shadow of death.

title: Job 24:18
text: ¶He is swift on the face of the waters; their portion is cursed on the earth: he turneth not unto the way of the vineyards.

title: Job 24:19
text: Drought and heat consume snow waters; so doth Sheol those that have sinned.

title: Job 24:20
text: The womb forgetteth him; the worm feedeth sweetly on him: he shall be no more remembered; and unrighteousness is broken as a tree, --

title: Job 24:21
text: He that despoileth the barren that beareth not, and doeth not good to the widow:

title: Job 24:22
text: He draweth also the mighty with his power; he riseth up, and no [man] is sure of life.

title: Job 24:23
text: [God] setteth him in safety, and he resteth thereon; but his eyes are upon their ways.

title: Job 24:24
text: They are exalted for a little, and are no more; they are laid low; like all [other] are they gathered, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.

title: Job 24:25
text: If it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?

title: Job 25:1
text: ¶And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,

title: Job 25:2
text: Dominion and fear are with him; he maketh peace in his high places.

title: Job 25:3
text: Is there any number of his troops? and upon whom doth not his light arise?

title: Job 25:4
text: And how should man be just with *God? Or how should he be clean that is born of a woman?

title: Job 25:5
text: Lo, even the moon is not bright; and the stars are not pure in his sight:

title: Job 25:6
text: How much less man, a worm, and the son of man, a worm!

title: Job 26:1
text: ¶And Job answered and said,

title: Job 26:2
text: How hast thou helped the powerless; how saved the arm that is without strength!

title: Job 26:3
text: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom, and abundantly declared the thing as it is!

title: Job 26:4
text: For whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?

title: Job 26:5
text: ¶The shades tremble beneath the waters and the inhabitants thereof;

title: Job 26:6
text: Sheol is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.

title: Job 26:7
text: He stretcheth out the north over empty space, he hangeth the earth upon nothing;

title: Job 26:8
text: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not rent under them.

title: Job 26:9
text: He covereth the face of his throne, he spreadeth his cloud upon it.

title: Job 26:10
text: He hath traced a fixed circle over the waters, unto the confines of light and darkness.

title: Job 26:11
text: The pillars of the heavens tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

title: Job 26:12
text: He stirreth up the sea by his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through Rahab.

title: Job 26:13
text: By his Spirit the heavens are adorned; his hand hath formed the fleeing serpent.

title: Job 26:14
text: Lo, these are the borders of his ways; but what a whisper of a word do we hear of him! And the thunder of his power, who can understand?

title: Job 27:1
text: ¶And Job continued his parable and said,

title: Job 27:2
text: [As] *God liveth, who hath taken away my right, and the Almighty, who hath embittered my soul,

title: Job 27:3
text: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of +God is in my nostrils,

title: Job 27:4
text: My lips shall not speak unrighteousness, nor my tongue utter deceit!

title: Job 27:5
text: Be it far from me that I should justify you; till I die I will not remove my blamelessness from me.

title: Job 27:6
text: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart reproacheth [me] not one of my days.

title: Job 27:7
text: ¶Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.

title: Job 27:8
text: For what is the hope of the ungodly, when [God] cutteth him off, when +God taketh away his soul?

title: Job 27:9
text: Will *God hear his cry when distress cometh upon him?

title: Job 27:10
text: Doth he delight himself in the Almighty? will he at all times call upon +God?

title: Job 27:11
text: ¶I will teach you concerning the hand of *God; what is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

title: Job 27:12
text: Behold, ye yourselves have all seen [it]; and why are ye thus altogether vain?

title: Job 27:13
text: This is the portion of the wicked man with *God, and the heritage of the violent, which they receive from the Almighty: --

title: Job 27:14
text: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword, and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread;

title: Job 27:15
text: Those that remain of him shall be buried by death, and his widows shall not weep.

title: Job 27:16
text: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

title: Job 27:17
text: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on; and the innocent shall divide the silver.

title: Job 27:18
text: He buildeth his house as the moth, and as a booth that a keeper maketh.

title: Job 27:19
text: He lieth down rich, but will do so no more; he openeth his eyes, and he is not.

title: Job 27:20
text: Terrors overtake him like waters; a whirlwind stealeth him away in the night.

title: Job 27:21
text: The east wind carrieth him away and he is gone; and as a storm it hurleth him out of his place.

title: Job 27:22
text: And [God] shall cast upon him and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.

title: Job 27:23
text: [Men] shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.

title: Job 28:1
text: ¶Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold which they refine;

title: Job 28:2
text: Iron is taken out of the dust, and copper is molten out of the stone.

title: Job 28:3
text: [Man] putteth an end to the darkness, and exploreth to the utmost limit, the stones of darkness and of the shadow of death.

title: Job 28:4
text: He openeth a shaft far from the inhabitants [of the earth]: forgotten of the foot, they hang suspended; away below men they hover.

title: Job 28:5
text: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread, and underneath it is turned up as by fire;

title: Job 28:6
text: The stones of it are the place of sapphires, and it hath dust of gold.

title: Job 28:7
text: It is a path no bird of prey knoweth, and the vulture's eye hath not seen it;

title: Job 28:8
text: The proud beasts have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed over it.

title: Job 28:9
text: [Man] putteth forth his hand upon the flinty rock, he overturneth the mountains by the root.

title: Job 28:10
text: He cutteth out channels in the rocks, and his eye seeth every precious thing.

title: Job 28:11
text: He bindeth the streams that they drip not, and what is hidden he bringeth forth to light.

title: Job 28:12
text: But wisdom, where shall it be found? and where is the place of understanding?

title: Job 28:13
text: Man knoweth not the value thereof; and it is not found in the land of the living.

title: Job 28:14
text: ¶The deep saith, It is not in me; and the sea saith, It is not with me.

title: Job 28:15
text: Choice gold cannot be given for it, nor silver be weighed for its price.

title: Job 28:16
text: It is not set in the balance with gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, and the sapphire.

title: Job 28:17
text: Gold and glass cannot be compared to it, nor vessels of fine gold be its exchange.

title: Job 28:18
text: Corals and crystal are no more remembered; yea, the acquisition of wisdom is above rubies.

title: Job 28:19
text: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not be compared to it, neither shall it be set in the balance with pure gold.

title: Job 28:20
text: ¶Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?

title: Job 28:21
text: For it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and concealed from the fowl of the heavens.

title: Job 28:22
text: Destruction and death say, We have heard its report with our ears.

title: Job 28:23
text: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth its place:

title: Job 28:24
text: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, he seeth under the whole heaven.

title: Job 28:25
text: In making a weight for the wind, and meting out the waters by measure,

title: Job 28:26
text: In appointing a statute for the rain, and a way for the thunder's flash:

title: Job 28:27
text: Then did he see it, and declare it; he established it, yea, and searched it out;

title: Job 28:28
text: And unto man he said, Lo, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.

title: Job 29:1
text: ¶And Job continued his parable and said,

title: Job 29:2
text: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when +God preserved me;

title: Job 29:3
text: When his lamp shone over my head, [and] by his light I walked through darkness;

title: Job 29:4
text: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret counsel of +God was over my tent,

title: Job 29:5
text: When the Almighty was yet with me, my young men round about me;

title: Job 29:6
text: When my steps were bathed in milk, and the rock poured out beside me rivers of oil! ...

title: Job 29:7
text: ¶When I went out to the gate by the city, when I prepared my seat on the broadway,

title: Job 29:8
text: The young men saw me, and hid themselves; and the aged arose [and] stood up;

title: Job 29:9
text: Princes refrained from talking, and laid the hand on their mouth;

title: Job 29:10
text: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue cleaved to their palate.

title: Job 29:11
text: When the ear heard [me], then it blessed me, and when the eye saw [me], it gave witness to me;

title: Job 29:12
text: For I delivered the afflicted that cried, and the fatherless who had no helper.

title: Job 29:13
text: The blessing of him that was perishing came upon me, and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.

title: Job 29:14
text: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; my justice was as a mantle and a turban.

title: Job 29:15
text: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame;

title: Job 29:16
text: I was a father to the needy, and the cause which I knew not I searched out;

title: Job 29:17
text: And I broke the jaws of the unrighteous, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.

title: Job 29:18
text: ¶And I said, I shall die in my nest, and multiply my days as the sand;

title: Job 29:19
text: My root shall be spread out to the waters, and the dew will lie all night on my branch;

title: Job 29:20
text: My glory shall be fresh in me, and my bow be renewed in my hand.

title: Job 29:21
text: Unto me they listened, and waited, and kept silence for my counsel:

title: Job 29:22
text: After my words they spoke not again, and my speech dropped upon them;

title: Job 29:23
text: And they waited for me as for the rain, and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

title: Job 29:24
text: [If] I laughed on them, they believed [it] not; and they troubled not the serenity of my countenance.

title: Job 29:25
text: I chose their way, and sat as chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth mourners.

title: Job 30:1
text: ¶But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to set with the dogs of my flock.

title: Job 30:2
text: Yea, whereto [should] the strength of their hands [profit] me, [men] in whom vigour hath perished?

title: Job 30:3
text: Withered up through want and hunger, they flee into waste places long since desolate and desert:

title: Job 30:4
text: They gather the salt-wort among the bushes, and the roots of the broom for their food.

title: Job 30:5
text: They are driven forth from among [men] --they cry after them as after a thief--

title: Job 30:6
text: To dwell in gloomy gorges, in caves of the earth and the rocks:

title: Job 30:7
text: They bray among the bushes; under the brambles they are gathered together:

title: Job 30:8
text: Sons of fools, and sons of nameless sires, they are driven out of the land.

title: Job 30:9
text: And now I am their song, yea, I am their byword.

title: Job 30:10
text: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, yea, they spare not to spit in my face.

title: Job 30:11
text: For he hath loosed my cord and afflicted me; so they cast off the bridle before me.

title: Job 30:12
text: At [my] right hand rise the young brood; they push away my feet, and raise up against me their pernicious ways;

title: Job 30:13
text: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, without any to help them;

title: Job 30:14
text: They come in as through a wide breach: amid the confusion they roll themselves onward.

title: Job 30:15
text: ¶Terrors are turned against me; they pursue mine honour as the wind; and my welfare is passed away like a cloud.

title: Job 30:16
text: And now my soul is poured out in me; days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

title: Job 30:17
text: The night pierceth through my bones [and detacheth them] from me, and my gnawing pains take no rest:

title: Job 30:18
text: By their great force they have become my raiment; they bind me about as the collar of my coat.

title: Job 30:19
text: He hath cast me into the mire, and I have become like dust and ashes.

title: Job 30:20
text: I cry unto thee, and thou answerest me not; I stand up, and thou lookest at me.

title: Job 30:21
text: Thou art changed to a cruel one to me; with the strength of thy hand thou pursuest me.

title: Job 30:22
text: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to be borne away, and dissolvest my substance.

title: Job 30:23
text: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and into the house of assemblage for all living.

title: Job 30:24
text: Indeed, no prayer [availeth] when he stretcheth out [his] hand: though they cry when he destroyeth.

title: Job 30:25
text: Did not I weep for him whose days were hard? was not my soul grieved for the needy?

title: Job 30:26
text: For I expected good, and there came evil; and I waited for light, but there came darkness.

title: Job 30:27
text: My bowels well up, and rest not; days of affliction have confronted me.

title: Job 30:28
text: I go about blackened, but not by the sun; I stand up, I cry in the congregation.

title: Job 30:29
text: I am become a brother to jackals, and a companion of ostriches.

title: Job 30:30
text: My skin is become black [and falleth] off me, and my bones are parched with heat.

title: Job 30:31
text: My harp also is [turned] to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of weepers.

title: Job 31:1
text: ¶I made a covenant with mine eyes; and how should I fix my regard upon a maid?

title: Job 31:2
text: For what would have been [my] portion of +God from above, and what the heritage of the Almighty from on high?

title: Job 31:3
text: Is not calamity for the unrighteous? and misfortune for the workers of iniquity?

title: Job 31:4
text: Doth not he see my ways, and number all my steps?

title: Job 31:5
text: If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot hath hasted to deceit,

title: Job 31:6
text: (Let me be weighed in an even balance, and +God will take knowledge of my blamelessness;)

title: Job 31:7
text: If my step have turned out of the way, and my heart followed mine eyes, and if any blot cleaveth to my hands;

title: Job 31:8
text: Let me sow, and another eat; and let mine offspring be rooted out.

title: Job 31:9
text: ¶If my heart have been enticed unto a woman, so that I laid wait at my neighbour's door,

title: Job 31:10
text: Let my wife grind for another, and let others bow down upon her.

title: Job 31:11
text: For this is an infamy; yea, it is an iniquity [to be judged by] the judges:

title: Job 31:12
text: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.

title: Job 31:13
text: If I have despised the cause of my bondman or of my bondmaid, when they contended with me,

title: Job 31:14
text: What then should I do when *God riseth up? and if he visited, what should I answer him?

title: Job 31:15
text: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not One fashion us in the womb?

title: Job 31:16
text: ¶If I have withheld the poor from [their] desire, or caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

title: Job 31:17
text: Or have eaten my morsel alone, so that the fatherless ate not thereof,

title: Job 31:18
text: (For from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, and I have guided the [widow] from my mother's womb;)

title: Job 31:19
text: If I have seen any perishing for want of clothing, or any needy without covering;

title: Job 31:20
text: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my lambs;

title: Job 31:21
text: If I have lifted up my hand against an orphan, because I saw my help in the gate:

title: Job 31:22
text: [Then] let my shoulder fall from the shoulder-blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone!

title: Job 31:23
text: For calamity from *God was a terror to me, and by reason of his excellency I was powerless.

title: Job 31:24
text: ¶If I have made gold my hope, or said to the fine gold, My confidence!

title: Job 31:25
text: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

title: Job 31:26
text: If I beheld the sun when it shone, or the moon walking in brightness,

title: Job 31:27
text: And my heart have been secretly enticed, so that my mouth kissed my hand:

title: Job 31:28
text: This also would be an iniquity for the judge, for I should have denied the *God who is above.

title: Job 31:29
text: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, and exulted when evil befell him;

title: Job 31:30
text: (Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse;)

title: Job 31:31
text: If the men of my tent said not, Who shall find one that hath not been satisfied with his meat? --

title: Job 31:32
text: The stranger did not lodge without; I opened my doors to the pathway.

title: Job 31:33
text: ¶If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom,

title: Job 31:34
text: Because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and went not out of the door, ...

title: Job 31:35
text: Oh that I had one to hear me! Behold my signature: let the Almighty answer me! And let mine opponent write an accusation!

title: Job 31:36
text: Would I not take it upon my shoulder? I would bind it on to me [as] a crown;

title: Job 31:37
text: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I come near to him.

title: Job 31:38
text: If my land cry out against me, and its furrows weep together;

title: Job 31:39
text: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, and have tormented to death the souls of its owners:

title: Job 31:40
text: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and tares instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.

title: Job 32:1
text: ¶And these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

title: Job 32:2
text: Then was kindled the anger of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram: against Job was his anger kindled, because he justified himself rather than God;

title: Job 32:3
text: and against his three friends was his anger kindled, because they found no answer, and [yet] condemned Job.

title: Job 32:4
text: But Elihu had waited till Job had finished speaking, because they were older than he.

title: Job 32:5
text: And Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of the three men, and his anger was kindled.

title: Job 32:6
text: ¶And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are aged; wherefore I was timid, and feared to shew you what I know.

title: Job 32:7
text: I said, Let days speak, and multitude of years teach wisdom.

title: Job 32:8
text: But there is a spirit which is in man; and the breath of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

title: Job 32:9
text: It is not the great that are wise; neither do the aged understand judgment.

title: Job 32:10
text: Therefore I say, Hearken to me; I also will shew what I know.

title: Job 32:11
text: Lo, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasonings, until ye searched out what to say.

title: Job 32:12
text: Yea, I gave you mine attention, and behold, there was none of you that confuted Job, that answered his words;

title: Job 32:13
text: That ye may not say, We have found out wisdom; *God will make him yield, not man.

title: Job 32:14
text: Now he hath not directed [his] words against me; and I will not answer him with your speeches. ...

title: Job 32:15
text: ¶They were amazed, they answered no more; words failed them.

title: Job 32:16
text: And I waited, for they spoke not, but stood still, and answered no more; --

title: Job 32:17
text: I will answer, I also in my turn, I also will shew what I know:

title: Job 32:18
text: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.

title: Job 32:19
text: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; like new flasks, it is ready to burst.

title: Job 32:20
text: I will speak, that I may find relief; I will open my lips and answer.

title: Job 32:21
text: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person; neither will I give flattery to man.

title: Job 32:22
text: For I know not how to flatter; my Maker would soon take me away.

title: Job 33:1
text: ¶Howbeit, Job, I pray thee, hear mine utterances, and hearken to all my words.

title: Job 33:2
text: Behold now, I have opened my mouth, my tongue speaketh in my palate,

title: Job 33:3
text: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart, and my lips shall utter knowledge purely.

title: Job 33:4
text: The Spirit of *God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.

title: Job 33:5
text: If thou canst, answer me; array [thy words] before me: take thy stand.

title: Job 33:6
text: Behold, before *God I am as thou; I also am formed out of the clay.

title: Job 33:7
text: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, nor my burden be heavy upon thee.

title: Job 33:8
text: ¶Surely thou hast spoken in my hearing, and I have heard the voice of [thy] words: --

title: Job 33:9
text: I am clean without transgression; I am pure, and there is no iniquity in me;

title: Job 33:10
text: Lo, he findeth occasions of hostility against me, he counteth me for his enemy;

title: Job 33:11
text: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.

title: Job 33:12
text: Behold, I will answer thee in this, thou art not right; for +God is greater than man.

title: Job 33:13
text: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.

title: Job 33:14
text: ¶For *God speaketh once, and twice, --[and man] perceiveth it not--

title: Job 33:15
text: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;

title: Job 33:16
text: Then he openeth men's ears, and sealeth their instruction,

title: Job 33:17
text: That he may withdraw man [from his] work, and hide pride from man.

title: Job 33:18
text: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from passing away by the sword.

title: Job 33:19
text: ¶He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and with constant strife in his bones;

title: Job 33:20
text: And his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty food;

title: Job 33:21
text: His flesh is consumed away from view, and his bones that were not seen stick out;

title: Job 33:22
text: And his soul draweth near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

title: Job 33:23
text: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his duty;

title: Job 33:24
text: Then he will be gracious unto him, and say, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

title: Job 33:25
text: His flesh shall be fresher than in childhood; he shall return to the days of his youth.

title: Job 33:26
text: He shall pray unto +God, and he will receive him with favour; and he shall see his face with shoutings, and he will render unto man his righteousness.

title: Job 33:27
text: He will sing before men, and say, I have sinned, and perverted what was right, and it hath not been requited to me;

title: Job 33:28
text: He hath delivered my soul from going into the pit, and my life shall see the light.

title: Job 33:29
text: ¶Lo, all these [things] worketh *God twice, thrice, with man,

title: Job 33:30
text: To bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

title: Job 33:31
text: Mark well, Job, hearken unto me; be silent, and I will speak.

title: Job 33:32
text: If thou hast anything to say, answer me; speak, for I desire to justify thee.

title: Job 33:33
text: If not, hearken thou unto me; be silent, and I will teach thee wisdom.

title: Job 34:1
text: ¶Moreover Elihu answered and said,

title: Job 34:2
text: Hear my words, ye wise [men]; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

title: Job 34:3
text: For the ear trieth words, as the palate tasteth food.

title: Job 34:4
text: Let us choose for ourselves what is right; let us know among ourselves what is good!

title: Job 34:5
text: For Job hath said, I am righteous, and *God hath taken away my judgment:

title: Job 34:6
text: Should I lie against my right? My wound is incurable without transgression.

title: Job 34:7
text: What man is like Job? he drinketh up scorning like water,

title: Job 34:8
text: And goeth in company with workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.

title: Job 34:9
text: For he hath said, It profiteth not a man if he delight himself in God.

title: Job 34:10
text: ¶Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: Far be wickedness from *God, and wrong from the Almighty!

title: Job 34:11
text: For a man's work will he render to him, and cause every one to find according to [his] way.

title: Job 34:12
text: Yea, surely, *God acteth not wickedly, and the Almighty perverteth not judgment.

title: Job 34:13
text: Who hath entrusted to him the earth? and who hath disposed the whole world?

title: Job 34:14
text: If he only thought of himself, [and] gathered unto him his spirit and his breath,

title: Job 34:15
text: All flesh would expire together, and man would return to the dust.

title: Job 34:16
text: ¶If now [thou hast] understanding, hear this: give ear to the voice of my words!

title: Job 34:17
text: Should he that hateth right indeed govern? and wilt thou condemn the All-just?

title: Job 34:18
text: Shall one say to a king, Belial? to nobles, Wicked?

title: Job 34:19
text: [How then to him] that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich man more than the poor? for they are all the work of his hands.

title: Job 34:20
text: In a moment they die, even at midnight the people are convulsed and pass away; and the strong are taken away without hand.

title: Job 34:21
text: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his steps.

title: Job 34:22
text: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

title: Job 34:23
text: For he doth not long consider a man, to bring him before *God in judgment.

title: Job 34:24
text: He breaketh in pieces mighty men without inquiry, and setteth others in their stead;

title: Job 34:25
text: Since he knoweth their actions; and he overthroweth [them] in the night, and they are crushed.

title: Job 34:26
text: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others,

title: Job 34:27
text: Because they have turned back from him, and would consider none of his ways;

title: Job 34:28
text: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.

title: Job 34:29
text: When he giveth quietness, who then will disturb? and when he hideth [his] face, who shall behold him? and this towards a nation, or towards a man alike;

title: Job 34:30
text: That the ungodly man reign not, that the people be not ensnared.

title: Job 34:31
text: ¶For hath he said unto *God, I bear [chastisement], I will not offend;

title: Job 34:32
text: What I see not, teach thou me; if I have done wrong, I will do so no more?

title: Job 34:33
text: Shall he recompense according to thy mind? for thou hast refused [his judgment]; for thou so choosest, and not I; speak then what thou knowest.

title: Job 34:34
text: Men of understanding will say to me, and a wise man who heareth me:

title: Job 34:35
text: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were not with intelligence.

title: Job 34:36
text: Would that Job may be tried unto the end, because of [his] answers after the manner of evil men!

title: Job 34:37
text: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth [his hands] among us, and multiplieth his words against *God.

title: Job 35:1
text: ¶Moreover Elihu answered and said,

title: Job 35:2
text: Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than *God's?

title: Job 35:3
text: For thou hast asked of what profit it is unto thee: what do I gain more than if I had sinned?

title: Job 35:4
text: I will reply to thee in words, and to thy companions with thee.

title: Job 35:5
text: Look unto the heavens and see; and survey the skies: they are higher than thou.

title: Job 35:6
text: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? If thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?

title: Job 35:7
text: If thou be righteous, what givest thou to him? or what doth he receive of thy hand?

title: Job 35:8
text: Thy wickedness [may affect] a man as thou [art], and thy righteousness a son of man.

title: Job 35:9
text: ¶By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry; they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty:

title: Job 35:10
text: But none saith, Where is +God my Maker, who giveth songs in the night,

title: Job 35:11
text: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowl of the heavens?

title: Job 35:12
text: There they cry, and he answereth not, because of the pride of evil men.

title: Job 35:13
text: Surely *God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.

title: Job 35:14
text: ¶Although thou sayest thou dost not see him, judgment is before him, therefore wait for him.

title: Job 35:15
text: But now, because he hath not visited in his anger, doth not [Job] know [his] great arrogancy?

title: Job 35:16
text: For Job hath opened his mouth in vanity, and made words abundant without knowledge.

title: Job 36:1
text: ¶And Elihu proceeded and said,

title: Job 36:2
text: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet words for +God.

title: Job 36:3
text: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Creator.

title: Job 36:4
text: For truly my words shall be no falsehood: one perfect in knowledge is with thee.

title: Job 36:5
text: ¶Lo, *God is mighty, but despiseth not [any]; mighty in strength of understanding:

title: Job 36:6
text: He saveth not the wicked alive; but he doeth justice to the afflicted.

title: Job 36:7
text: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne doth he even set them for ever; and they are exalted.

title: Job 36:8
text: And if, bound in fetters, they be held in cords of affliction,

title: Job 36:9
text: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions, because they have increased.

title: Job 36:10
text: And he openeth their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.

title: Job 36:11
text: If they hearken and serve [him], they shall accomplish their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

title: Job 36:12
text: But if they hearken not, they shall pass away by the sword, and expire without knowledge.

title: Job 36:13
text: But the godless in heart heap up anger; they cry not when he bindeth them:

title: Job 36:14
text: Their soul dieth in youth, and their life is among the unclean.

title: Job 36:15
text: ¶But he delivereth the afflicted in his affliction, and openeth their ear in [their] oppression.

title: Job 36:16
text: Even so would he have allured thee out of the jaws of distress into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and the supply of thy table [would be] full of fatness.

title: Job 36:17
text: But thou art full of the judgments of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold [on thee].

title: Job 36:18
text: Because there is wrath, [beware] lest it take thee away through chastisement: then a great ransom could not avail thee.

title: Job 36:19
text: Will he esteem thy riches? Not gold, nor all the resources of strength!

title: Job 36:20
text: Desire not the night, when peoples are cut off from their place.

title: Job 36:21
text: Take heed, turn not to iniquity; for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

title: Job 36:22
text: Lo, *God is exalted in his power: who teacheth as he?

title: Job 36:23
text: Who hath appointed him his way? or who hath said, Thou hast wrought unrighteousness?

title: Job 36:24
text: ¶Remember that thou magnify his work, which men celebrate.

title: Job 36:25
text: All men look at it; man beholdeth [it] afar off.

title: Job 36:26
text: Lo, *God is great, and we comprehend [him] not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.

title: Job 36:27
text: For he draweth up the drops of water: they distil in rain from the vapour which he formeth,

title: Job 36:28
text: Which the skies pour down [and] drop upon man abundantly.

title: Job 36:29
text: But can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, [or] the crashing of his pavilion?

title: Job 36:30
text: Lo, he spreadeth his light around him, and covereth the bottom of the sea.

title: Job 36:31
text: For with them he judgeth the peoples; he giveth food in abundance.

title: Job 36:32
text: [His] hands he covereth with lightning, and commandeth it where it is to strike.

title: Job 36:33
text: His thundering declareth concerning him; the cattle even, concerning its coming.

title: Job 37:1
text: ¶Aye, my heart trembleth at this also, and leapeth up out of its place:

title: Job 37:2
text: Hear attentively the roar of his voice, and the murmur going forth from his mouth.

title: Job 37:3
text: He sendeth it forth under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.

title: Job 37:4
text: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency, and holdeth not back the flashes when his voice is heard.

title: Job 37:5
text: *God thundereth marvellously with his voice, doing great things which we do not comprehend.

title: Job 37:6
text: ¶For he saith to the snow, Fall on the earth! and to the pouring rain, even the pouring rains of his might.

title: Job 37:7
text: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.

title: Job 37:8
text: And the wild beast goeth into its lair, and they remain in their dens.

title: Job 37:9
text: From the chamber [of the south] cometh the whirlwind; and cold from the winds of the north.

title: Job 37:10
text: By the breath of *God ice is given; and the breadth of the waters is straitened.

title: Job 37:11
text: Also with plentiful moisture he loadeth the thick clouds, his light dispels the cloud;

title: Job 37:12
text: And they are turned every way by his guidance, that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the circuit of the earth,

title: Job 37:13
text: Whether he cause it to come as a rod, or for his land, or in mercy.

title: Job 37:14
text: ¶Hearken unto this, Job; stand still and discern the wondrous works of *God.

title: Job 37:15
text: Dost thou know how +God hath disposed them, and how he causeth the lightning of his cloud to flash?

title: Job 37:16
text: Dost thou know about the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him that is perfect in knowledge?

title: Job 37:17
text: How thy garments become warm when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?

title: Job 37:18
text: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, firm, like a molten mirror?

title: Job 37:19
text: Teach us what we shall say unto him! We cannot order [our words] by reason of darkness.

title: Job 37:20
text: Shall it be told him if I would speak? if a man [so] say, surely he shall be swallowed up.

title: Job 37:21
text: ¶And now [men] see not the light as it gleameth, it is [hidden] in the skies. But the wind passeth by and cleareth them.

title: Job 37:22
text: From the north cometh gold; with +God is terrible majesty.

title: Job 37:23
text: The Almighty, we cannot find him out: excellent in power, and in judgment, and in abundance of justice, he doth not afflict.

title: Job 37:24
text: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.

title: Job 38:1
text: ¶And Jehovah answered Job out of the whirlwind and said,

title: Job 38:2
text: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?

title: Job 38:3
text: Gird up now thy loins like a man; and I will demand of thee, and inform thou me.

title: Job 38:4
text: ¶Where wast thou when I founded the earth? Declare, if thou hast understanding.

title: Job 38:5
text: Who set the measures thereof--if thou knowest? or who stretched a line upon it?

title: Job 38:6
text: Whereupon were the foundations thereof sunken? or who laid its corner-stone,

title: Job 38:7
text: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

title: Job 38:8
text: And who shut up the sea with doors, when it burst forth, issuing out of the womb?

title: Job 38:9
text: When I made the cloud its garment, and thick darkness a swaddling band for it;

title: Job 38:10
text: When I cut out for it my boundary, and set bars and doors,

title: Job 38:11
text: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come and no further, and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

title: Job 38:12
text: ¶Hast thou since thy days commanded the morning? hast thou caused the dawn to know its place,

title: Job 38:13
text: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and the wicked might be shaken out of it?

title: Job 38:14
text: It is changed like the signet-clay; and [all things] stand forth as in a garment:

title: Job 38:15
text: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the uplifted arm is broken.

title: Job 38:16
text: Hast thou entered as far as the springs of the sea? and hast thou walked in the recesses of the deep?

title: Job 38:17
text: Have the gates of death been revealed unto thee? and hast thou seen the gates of the shadow of death?

title: Job 38:18
text: Hath thine understanding compassed the breadths of the earth? Declare if thou knowest it all.

title: Job 38:19
text: Where is the way to where light dwelleth? and the darkness, where is its place,

title: Job 38:20
text: That thou shouldest take it to its bound, and that thou shouldest know the paths to its house?

title: Job 38:21
text: Thou knowest, for thou wast then born, and the number of thy days is great!

title: Job 38:22
text: Hast thou entered into the storehouses of the snow, and hast thou seen the treasuries of the hail,

title: Job 38:23
text: Which I have reserved for the time of distress, for the day of battle and war?

title: Job 38:24
text: By what way is the light parted, [and] the east wind scattered upon the earth?

title: Job 38:25
text: ¶Who hath divided a channel for the rain-flood, and a way for the thunder's flash;

title: Job 38:26
text: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no one is; on the wilderness wherein there is not a man;
