title: Job 38:27
text: To satisfy the desolate and waste [ground], and to cause the sprout of the grass to spring forth?

title: Job 38:28
text: Hath the rain a father? or who begetteth the drops of dew?

title: Job 38:29
text: Out of whose womb cometh the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who bringeth it forth?

title: Job 38:30
text: When the waters lie hidden as in stone, and the face of the deep holdeth fast together.

title: Job 38:31
text: Canst thou fasten the bands of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

title: Job 38:32
text: Dost thou bring forth the constellations each in its season? or dost thou guide the Bear with her sons?

title: Job 38:33
text: Knowest thou the ordinances of the heavens? dost thou determine their rule over the earth?

title: Job 38:34
text: Dost thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that floods of waters may cover thee?

title: Job 38:35
text: Dost thou send forth lightnings that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?

title: Job 38:36
text: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the mind?

title: Job 38:37
text: Who numbereth the clouds with wisdom? or who poureth out the bottles of the heavens,

title: Job 38:38
text: When the dust runneth as into a molten mass, and the clods cleave fast together?

title: Job 38:39
text: Dost thou hunt the prey for the lioness, and dost thou satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

title: Job 38:40
text: When they crouch in [their] dens, [and] abide in the thicket to lie in wait?

title: Job 38:41
text: Who provideth for the raven his food, when his young ones cry unto *God, [and] they wander for lack of meat?

title: Job 39:1
text: ¶Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? dost thou mark the calving of the hinds?

title: Job 39:2
text: Dost thou number the months that they fulfil? and knowest thou the time when they bring forth?

title: Job 39:3
text: They bow themselves, they give birth to their young ones, they cast out their pains;

title: Job 39:4
text: Their young ones become strong, they grow up in the open field, they go forth, and return not unto them.

title: Job 39:5
text: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? and who hath loosed the bands of the onager,

title: Job 39:6
text: Whose house I made the wilderness, and the salt plain his dwellings?

title: Job 39:7
text: He laugheth at the tumult of the city, and heareth not the shouts of the driver;

title: Job 39:8
text: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.

title: Job 39:9
text: Will the buffalo be willing to serve thee, or will he lodge by thy crib?

title: Job 39:10
text: Canst thou bind the buffalo with his cord in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

title: Job 39:11
text: Wilt thou put confidence in him, because his strength is great? and wilt thou leave thy labour to him?

title: Job 39:12
text: Wilt thou trust him to bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy threshing-floor?

title: Job 39:13
text: ¶The wing of the ostrich beats joyously--But is it the stork's pinion and plumage?

title: Job 39:14
text: For she leaveth her eggs to the earth, and warmeth them in the dust,

title: Job 39:15
text: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the beast of the field may trample them.

title: Job 39:16
text: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers; her labour is in vain, without her concern.

title: Job 39:17
text: For +God hath deprived her of wisdom, and hath not furnished her with understanding.

title: Job 39:18
text: What time she lasheth herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.

title: Job 39:19
text: ¶Hast thou given strength to the horse? hast thou clothed his neck with the quivering mane?

title: Job 39:20
text: Dost thou make him to leap as a locust? His majestic snorting is terrible.

title: Job 39:21
text: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in [his] strength; he goeth forth to meet the armed host.

title: Job 39:22
text: He laugheth at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from before the sword.

title: Job 39:23
text: The quiver rattleth upon him, the glittering spear and the javelin.

title: Job 39:24
text: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage, and cannot contain himself at the sound of the trumpet:

title: Job 39:25
text: At the noise of the trumpets he saith, Aha! and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

title: Job 39:26
text: ¶Doth the hawk fly by thine intelligence, [and] stretch his wings toward the south?

title: Job 39:27
text: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make his nest on high?

title: Job 39:28
text: He inhabiteth the rock and maketh his dwelling on the point of the cliff, and the fastness:

title: Job 39:29
text: From thence he spieth out the prey, his eyes look into the distance;

title: Job 39:30
text: And his young ones suck up blood; and where the slain are, there is he.

title: Job 40:1
text: ¶And Jehovah answered Job and said,

title: Job 40:2
text: Shall he that will contend with the Almighty instruct [him]? he that reproveth +God, let him answer it.

title: Job 40:3
text: And Job answered Jehovah and said,

title: Job 40:4
text: Behold, I am nought: what shall I answer thee? I will lay my hand upon my mouth.

title: Job 40:5
text: Once have I spoken, and I will not answer; yea twice, but I will proceed no further.

title: Job 40:6
text: ¶And Jehovah answered Job out of the whirlwind and said,

title: Job 40:7
text: Gird up now thy loins like a man: I will demand of thee, and inform thou me.

title: Job 40:8
text: Wilt thou also annul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me that thou mayest be righteous?

title: Job 40:9
text: Hast thou an arm like *God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?

title: Job 40:10
text: Deck thyself now with glory and excellency, and clothe thyself with majesty and splendour.

title: Job 40:11
text: Cast abroad the ragings of thine anger, and look on every one that is proud, and abase him:

title: Job 40:12
text: Look on every one that is proud, bring him low, and tread down the wicked in their place:

title: Job 40:13
text: Hide them in the dust together; bind their faces in secret.

title: Job 40:14
text: Then will I also praise thee, because thy right hand saveth thee.

title: Job 40:15
text: ¶See now the behemoth, which I made with thee: he eateth grass as an ox.

title: Job 40:16
text: Behold now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the muscles of his belly.

title: Job 40:17
text: He bendeth his tail like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are woven together.

title: Job 40:18
text: His bones are tubes of bronze, his members are like bars of iron.

title: Job 40:19
text: He is the chief of *God's ways: he that made him gave him his sword.

title: Job 40:20
text: For the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.

title: Job 40:21
text: He lieth under lotus-bushes, in the covert of the reed and fen:

title: Job 40:22
text: Lotus-bushes cover him with their shade; the willows of the brook surround him.

title: Job 40:23
text: Lo, the river overfloweth--he startleth not: he is confident though a Jordan break forth against his mouth.

title: Job 40:24
text: Shall he be taken in front? will they pierce through [his] nose in the trap?

title: Job 41:1
text: ¶Wilt thou draw out the leviathan with the hook, and press down his tongue with a cord?

title: Job 41:2
text: Wilt thou put a rush-rope into his nose, and pierce his jaw with a spike?

title: Job 41:3
text: Will he make many supplications unto thee? or will he speak softly unto thee?

title: Job 41:4
text: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him as a bondman for ever?

title: Job 41:5
text: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird, and wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?

title: Job 41:6
text: Shall partners make traffic of him, will they divide him among merchants?

title: Job 41:7
text: Wilt thou fill his skin with darts, and his head with fish-spears?

title: Job 41:8
text: Lay thy hand upon him; remember the battle, --do no more!

title: Job 41:9
text: Lo, hope as to him is belied: is not one cast down even at the sight of him?

title: Job 41:10
text: None is so bold as to stir him up; and who is he that will stand before me?

title: Job 41:11
text: ¶Who hath first given to me, that I should repay [him]? [Whatsoever is] under the whole heaven is mine.

title: Job 41:12
text: I will not be silent as to his parts, the story of his power, and the beauty of his structure.

title: Job 41:13
text: Who can uncover the surface of his garment? who can come within his double jaws?

title: Job 41:14
text: Who can open the doors of his face? Round about his teeth is terror.

title: Job 41:15
text: The rows of his shields are a pride, shut up together [as with] a close seal.

title: Job 41:16
text: One is so near to another that no air can come between them;

title: Job 41:17
text: They are joined each to its fellow; they stick together, and cannot be sundered.

title: Job 41:18
text: His sneezings flash light, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

title: Job 41:19
text: Out of his mouth go forth flames; sparks of fire leap out:

title: Job 41:20
text: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a boiling pot and cauldron.

title: Job 41:21
text: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.

title: Job 41:22
text: In his neck lodgeth strength, and terror danceth before him.

title: Job 41:23
text: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are fused upon him, they cannot be moved.

title: Job 41:24
text: His heart is firm as a stone, yea, firm as the nether [millstone].

title: Job 41:25
text: When he raiseth himself up, the mighty are afraid: they are beside themselves with consternation.

title: Job 41:26
text: If any reach him with a sword, it cannot hold; neither spear, nor dart, nor harpoon.

title: Job 41:27
text: He esteemeth iron as straw, bronze as rotten wood.

title: Job 41:28
text: The arrow will not make him flee; slingstones are turned with him into stubble.

title: Job 41:29
text: Clubs are counted as stubble; he laugheth at the shaking of a javelin.

title: Job 41:30
text: His under parts are sharp potsherds: he spreadeth a threshing-sledge upon the mire.

title: Job 41:31
text: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot; he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment;

title: Job 41:32
text: He maketh the path to shine after him: one would think the deep to be hoary.

title: Job 41:33
text: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.

title: Job 41:34
text: He beholdeth all high things; he is king over all the proud beasts.

title: Job 42:1
text: ¶And Job answered Jehovah and said,

title: Job 42:2
text: I know that thou canst do everything, and that thou canst be hindered in no thought of thine.

title: Job 42:3
text: Who is he that obscureth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered what I did not understand; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.

title: Job 42:4
text: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and inform me.

title: Job 42:5
text: I had heard of thee by the hearing of the ear, but now mine eye seeth thee:

title: Job 42:6
text: Wherefore I abhor [myself], and repent in dust and ashes.

title: Job 42:7
text: ¶And it came to pass after Jehovah had spoken these words to Job, that Jehovah said to Eliphaz the Temanite, Mine anger is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends; for ye have not spoken rightly of me, like my servant Job.

title: Job 42:8
text: And now, take for yourselves seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt-offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for him will I accept: lest I deal with you [after your] folly, for ye have not spoken of me rightly, like my servant Job.

title: Job 42:9
text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite, went and did according as Jehovah had said unto them; and Jehovah accepted Job.

title: Job 42:10
text: ¶And Jehovah turned the captivity of Job, when he had prayed for his friends; and Jehovah gave Job twice as much as he had before.

title: Job 42:11
text: And all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, came to him, and they ate bread with him in his house, and they condoled with him, and comforted him concerning all the evil that Jehovah had brought upon him; and every one gave him a piece of money, and every one a golden ring.

title: Job 42:12
text: And Jehovah blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning; and he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she-asses.

title: Job 42:13
text: And he had seven sons and three daughters.

title: Job 42:14
text: And he called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.

title: Job 42:15
text: And in all the land were no women found [so] fair as the daughters of Job; and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.

title: Job 42:16
text: And Job lived after this a hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, four generations.

title: Job 42:17
text: And Job died, old and full of days.

title: Psalms 1:1
text: ¶Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the wicked, and standeth not in the way of sinners, and sitteth not in the seat of scorners;

title: Psalms 1:2
text: But his delight is in Jehovah's law, and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

title: Psalms 1:3
text: And he [is] as a tree planted by brooks of water, which giveth its fruit in its season, and whose leaf fadeth not; and all that he doeth prospereth.

title: Psalms 1:4
text: ¶The wicked are not so; but are as the chaff which the wind driveth away.

title: Psalms 1:5
text: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

title: Psalms 1:6
text: For Jehovah knoweth the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

title: Psalms 2:1
text: ¶Why are the nations in tumultuous agitation, and [why] do the peoples meditate a vain thing?

title: Psalms 2:2
text: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the princes plot together, against Jehovah and against his anointed:

title: Psalms 2:3
text: Let us break their bonds asunder, and cast away their cords from us!

title: Psalms 2:4
text: He that dwelleth in the heavens shall laugh, the Lord shall have them in derision.

title: Psalms 2:5
text: Then will he speak to them in his anger, and in his fierce displeasure will he terrify them:

title: Psalms 2:6
text: And *I* have anointed my king upon Zion, the hill of my holiness.

title: Psalms 2:7
text: ¶I will declare the decree: Jehovah hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; *I* this day have begotten thee.

title: Psalms 2:8
text: Ask of me, and I will give thee nations for an inheritance, and for thy possession the ends of the earth:

title: Psalms 2:9
text: Thou shalt break them with a sceptre of iron, as a potter's vessel thou shalt dash them in pieces.

title: Psalms 2:10
text: ¶And now, O kings, be ye wise, be admonished, ye judges of the earth.

title: Psalms 2:11
text: Serve Jehovah with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

title: Psalms 2:12
text: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish in the way, though his anger burn but a little. Blessed are all who have their trust in him.

title: Psalms 3:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.>> Jehovah, how many are they that trouble me, many they that rise up against me!

title: Psalms 3:2
text: Many say of my soul, There is no salvation for him in God. Selah.

title: Psalms 3:3
text: But thou, Jehovah, art a shield about me; my glory, and the lifter up of my head.

title: Psalms 3:4
text: ¶With my voice will I call to Jehovah, and he will answer me from the hill of his holiness. Selah.

title: Psalms 3:5
text: I laid me down and slept; I awaked, for Jehovah sustaineth me.

title: Psalms 3:6
text: I will not fear for myriads of the people that have set themselves against me round about.

title: Psalms 3:7
text: Arise, Jehovah; save me, my God! For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheekbone, thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.

title: Psalms 3:8
text: Salvation is of Jehovah; thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.

title: Psalms 4:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm of David.>> When I call, answer me, O God of my righteousness: in pressure thou hast enlarged me; be gracious unto me, and hear my prayer.

title: Psalms 4:2
text: Ye sons of men, till when is my glory [to be put] to shame? [How long] will ye love vanity, will ye seek after a lie? Selah.

title: Psalms 4:3
text: But know that Jehovah hath set apart the pious [man] for himself: Jehovah will hear when I call unto him.

title: Psalms 4:4
text: Be moved with anger, and sin not; meditate in your own hearts upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

title: Psalms 4:5
text: Offer sacrifices of righteousness, and confide in Jehovah.

title: Psalms 4:6
text: ¶Many say, Who shall cause us to see good? Lift up upon us the light of thy countenance, O Jehovah.

title: Psalms 4:7
text: Thou hast put joy in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their new wine was in abundance.

title: Psalms 4:8
text: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; for thou, Jehovah, alone makest me to dwell in safety.

title: Psalms 5:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon Nehiloth. A Psalm of David.>> Give ear to my words, O Jehovah; consider my meditation.

title: Psalms 5:2
text: Hearken unto the voice of my crying, my king and my God; for to thee will I pray.

title: Psalms 5:3
text: Jehovah, in the morning shalt thou hear my voice; in the morning will I address myself to thee, and will look up.

title: Psalms 5:4
text: For thou art not a *God that hath pleasure in wickedness; evil shall not sojourn with thee.

title: Psalms 5:5
text: Insolent fools shall not stand before thine eyes; thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

title: Psalms 5:6
text: Thou wilt destroy them that speak lies: Jehovah abhorreth a man of blood and deceit.

title: Psalms 5:7
text: ¶But as for me, in the greatness of thy loving-kindness will I enter thy house; I will bow down toward the temple of thy holiness in thy fear.

title: Psalms 5:8
text: Lead me, Jehovah, in thy righteousness, because of my foes; make thy way plain before me.

title: Psalms 5:9
text: For there is no certainty in their mouth; their inward part is perversion, their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

title: Psalms 5:10
text: Bring guilt upon them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels: drive them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against thee.

title: Psalms 5:11
text: And all that trust in thee shall rejoice: for ever shall they shout joyously, and thou wilt protect them; and they that love thy name shall exult in thee.

title: Psalms 5:12
text: For thou, Jehovah, wilt bless the righteous [man]; with favour wilt thou surround him as [with] a shield.

title: Psalms 6:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments, upon Sheminith. A Psalm of David.>> Jehovah, rebuke me not in thine anger, and chasten me not in thy hot displeasure.

title: Psalms 6:2
text: Be gracious unto me, Jehovah, for I am withered; Jehovah, heal me, for my bones tremble.

title: Psalms 6:3
text: And my soul trembleth exceedingly: and thou, Jehovah, till how long?

title: Psalms 6:4
text: Return, Jehovah, free my soul; save me for thy loving-kindness' sake.

title: Psalms 6:5
text: For in death there is no remembrance of thee; in Sheol who shall give thanks unto thee?

title: Psalms 6:6
text: I am wearied with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I dissolve my couch with my tears.

title: Psalms 6:7
text: Mine eye wasteth away through grief; it hath grown old because of all mine oppressors.

title: Psalms 6:8
text: ¶Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for Jehovah hath heard the voice of my weeping.

title: Psalms 6:9
text: Jehovah hath heard my supplication; Jehovah receiveth my prayer.

title: Psalms 6:10
text: All mine enemies shall be ashamed and tremble exceedingly; they will turn, they will be ashamed suddenly.

title: Psalms 7:1
text: ¶<<Shiggaion of David, which he sang to Jehovah, concerning the words of Cush the Benjaminite.>> Jehovah my God, in thee have I trusted: save me from all my pursuers, and deliver me;

title: Psalms 7:2
text: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, crushing it while there is no deliverer.

title: Psalms 7:3
text: Jehovah my God, if I have done this, if there be iniquity in my hands;

title: Psalms 7:4
text: If I have rewarded evil to him that was at peace with me; (indeed I have freed him that without cause oppressed me;)

title: Psalms 7:5
text: Let the enemy pursue after my soul, and take [it], and let him tread down my life to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

title: Psalms 7:6
text: Arise, Jehovah, in thine anger; lift thyself up against the raging of mine oppressors, and awake for me: thou hast commanded judgment.

title: Psalms 7:7
text: And the assembly of the peoples shall encompass thee; and for their sakes return thou on high.

title: Psalms 7:8
text: Jehovah shall minister judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Jehovah, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity which is in me.

title: Psalms 7:9
text: Oh let the wrong of the wicked come to an end, and establish thou the righteous [man]; even thou that triest the hearts and reins, the righteous God.

title: Psalms 7:10
text: ¶My shield is with God, who saveth the upright in heart.

title: Psalms 7:11
text: God is a righteous judge, and a *God who is indignant all the day.

title: Psalms 7:12
text: If one turn not, he will sharpen his sword; he hath bent his bow and made it ready,

title: Psalms 7:13
text: And he hath prepared for him instruments of death; his arrows hath he made burning.

title: Psalms 7:14
text: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, yea, he hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood:

title: Psalms 7:15
text: He digged a pit, and hollowed it out, and is fallen into the hole that he made.

title: Psalms 7:16
text: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violence shall come down upon his own pate.

title: Psalms 7:17
text: I will praise Jehovah according to his righteousness, and will sing forth the name of Jehovah the Most High.

title: Psalms 8:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon the Gittith. A Psalm of David.>> Jehovah our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy majesty above the heavens.

title: Psalms 8:2
text: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou established praise because of thine adversaries, to still the enemy and the avenger.

title: Psalms 8:3
text: ¶When I see thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and stars, which thou hast established;

title: Psalms 8:4
text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

title: Psalms 8:5
text: Thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and splendour.

title: Psalms 8:6
text: Thou hast made him to rule over the works of thy hands; thou hast put everything under his feet:

title: Psalms 8:7
text: Sheep and oxen, all of them, and also the beasts of the field;

title: Psalms 8:8
text: The fowl of the heavens, and the fishes of the sea, [whatever] passeth through the paths of the seas.

title: Psalms 8:9
text: Jehovah our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!

title: Psalms 9:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon Muthlabben. A Psalm of David.>> I will praise Jehovah with my whole heart; I will recount all thy marvellous works.

title: Psalms 9:2
text: I will be glad and rejoice in thee; I will sing forth thy name, O Most High.

title: Psalms 9:3
text: When mine enemies turned back, they stumbled and perished at thy presence:

title: Psalms 9:4
text: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause. Thou sittest on the throne, judging righteously.

title: Psalms 9:5
text: Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked; thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 9:6
text: O enemy! destructions are ended for ever. --Thou hast also destroyed cities, even the remembrance of them hath perished.

title: Psalms 9:7
text: But Jehovah sitteth for ever; he hath ordained his throne for judgment.

title: Psalms 9:8
text: And it is he that will judge the world with righteousness; he shall execute judgment upon the peoples with equity.

title: Psalms 9:9
text: And Jehovah will be a refuge to the oppressed one, a refuge in times of distress.

title: Psalms 9:10
text: And they that know thy name will confide in thee; for thou, Jehovah, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

title: Psalms 9:11
text: ¶Sing psalms to Jehovah who dwelleth in Zion; tell among the peoples his doings.

title: Psalms 9:12
text: For when he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them; the cry of the afflicted ones hath he not forgotten.

title: Psalms 9:13
text: Be gracious unto me, O Jehovah; consider mine affliction from them that hate me, lifting me up from the gates of death:

title: Psalms 9:14
text: That I may declare all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion. I will be joyful in thy salvation.

title: Psalms 9:15
text: The nations are sunk down in the pit [that] they made; in the net that they hid is their own foot taken.

title: Psalms 9:16
text: Jehovah is known [by] the judgment he hath executed: the wicked is ensnared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

title: Psalms 9:17
text: The wicked shall be turned into Sheol, all the nations that forget God.

title: Psalms 9:18
text: For the needy one shall not be forgotten alway; the hope of the meek shall not perish for ever.

title: Psalms 9:19
text: Arise, Jehovah; let not man prevail: let the nations be judged in thy sight.

title: Psalms 9:20
text: Put them in fear, Jehovah: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

title: Psalms 10:1
text: ¶Why, Jehovah, standest thou afar off? [Why] hidest thou thyself in times of distress?

title: Psalms 10:2
text: The wicked, in his pride, doth hotly pursue the afflicted. They shall be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

title: Psalms 10:3
text: For the wicked boasteth of his soul's desire, and he blesseth the covetous; he contemneth Jehovah.

title: Psalms 10:4
text: The wicked [saith], in the haughtiness of his countenance, He doth not search out: all his thoughts are, There is no God!

title: Psalms 10:5
text: His ways always succeed; thy judgments are far above out of his sight; [as for] all his adversaries, he puffeth at them.

title: Psalms 10:6
text: He saith in his heart, I shall not be moved; from generation to generation I shall be in no adversity.

title: Psalms 10:7
text: His mouth is full of cursing, and deceit, and oppression; under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

title: Psalms 10:8
text: He sitteth in the lurking-places of the villages; in the secret places doth he slay the innocent: his eyes watch for the wretched.

title: Psalms 10:9
text: He lieth in wait secretly, like a lion in his thicket; he lieth in wait to catch the afflicted: he doth catch the afflicted, drawing him into his net.

title: Psalms 10:10
text: He croucheth, he boweth down, that the wretched may fall by his strong ones.

title: Psalms 10:11
text: He saith in his heart, *God hath forgotten, he hideth his face, he will never see [it].

title: Psalms 10:12
text: ¶Arise, Jehovah; O *God, lift up thy hand: forget not the afflicted.

title: Psalms 10:13
text: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? He hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require [it].

title: Psalms 10:14
text: Thou hast seen [it], for thou thyself beholdest trouble and vexation, to requite by thy hand. The wretched committeth himself unto thee; thou hast been the helper of the fatherless.

title: Psalms 10:15
text: Break thou the arm of the wicked, and as for the evil man, seek out his wickedness [till] thou find none.

title: Psalms 10:16
text: Jehovah is King for ever and ever: the nations have perished out of his land.

title: Psalms 10:17
text: Jehovah, thou hast heard the desire of the meek, thou hast established their heart: thou causest thine ear to hear,

title: Psalms 10:18
text: To do justice to the fatherless and the oppressed one, that the man of the earth may terrify no more.

title: Psalms 11:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David.>> In Jehovah have I put my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee [as] a bird to your mountain?

title: Psalms 11:2
text: For behold, the wicked bend the bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may in darkness shoot at the upright in heart.

title: Psalms 11:3
text: If the foundations be destroyed, what shall the righteous do?

title: Psalms 11:4
text: ¶Jehovah [is] in the temple of his holiness; Jehovah, --his throne is in the heavens: his eyes behold, his eyelids try the children of men.

title: Psalms 11:5
text: Jehovah trieth the righteous one; but the wicked, and him that loveth violence, his soul hateth.

title: Psalms 11:6
text: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone; and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

title: Psalms 11:7
text: For righteous is Jehovah; he loveth righteousness, his countenance doth behold the upright.

title: Psalms 12:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon Sheminith. A Psalm of David.>> Save, Jehovah, for the godly man is gone; for the faithful have failed from among the children of men.

title: Psalms 12:2
text: They speak falsehood every one with his neighbour: [with] flattering lip, with a double heart, do they speak.

title: Psalms 12:3
text: Jehovah will cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that speaketh proud things,

title: Psalms 12:4
text: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail, our lips are our own: who [is] lord over us?

title: Psalms 12:5
text: Because of the oppression of the afflicted, because of the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith Jehovah, I will set [him] in safety, at whom they puff.

title: Psalms 12:6
text: The words of Jehovah are pure words, silver tried in the furnace of earth, purified seven times.

title: Psalms 12:7
text: Thou, Jehovah, wilt keep them, thou wilt preserve them from this generation for ever.

title: Psalms 12:8
text: The wicked walk about on every side, when vileness is exalted among the children of men.

title: Psalms 13:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> How long, Jehovah, wilt thou forget me for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

title: Psalms 13:2
text: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, with sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

title: Psalms 13:3
text: Consider, answer me, O Jehovah my God! lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the [sleep of] death;

title: Psalms 13:4
text: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him! [lest] mine adversaries be joyful when I am moved.

title: Psalms 13:5
text: As for me, I have confided in thy loving-kindness; my heart shall be joyful in thy salvation.

title: Psalms 13:6
text: I will sing unto Jehovah, for he hath dealt bountifully with me.

title: Psalms 14:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David.>> The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They have corrupted themselves, they have done abominable works: there is none that doeth good.

title: Psalms 14:2
text: Jehovah looked down from the heavens upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.

title: Psalms 14:3
text: They have all gone aside, they are together become corrupt: there is none that doeth good, not even one.

title: Psalms 14:4
text: ¶Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, eating up my people [as] they eat bread? They call not upon Jehovah.

title: Psalms 14:5
text: There were they in great fear; for God is in the generation of the righteous.

title: Psalms 14:6
text: Ye have shamed the counsel of the afflicted, because Jehovah [was] his refuge.

title: Psalms 14:7
text: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When Jehovah turneth again the captivity of his people, Jacob shall be glad, Israel shall rejoice.

title: Psalms 15:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Jehovah, who shall sojourn in thy tent? who shall dwell in the hill of thy holiness?

title: Psalms 15:2
text: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth from his heart.

title: Psalms 15:3
text: [He that] slandereth not with his tongue, doeth not evil to his companion, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour;

title: Psalms 15:4
text: In whose eyes the depraved person is contemned, and who honoureth them that fear Jehovah; who, if he have sworn to his own hurt, changeth it not;

title: Psalms 15:5
text: [He that] putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these [things] shall never be moved.

title: Psalms 16:1
text: ¶<<Michtam of David.>> Preserve me, O *God: for I trust in thee.

title: Psalms 16:2
text: Thou [my soul] hast said to Jehovah, Thou art the Lord: my goodness [extendeth] not to thee; --

title: Psalms 16:3
text: To the saints that are on the earth, and to the excellent [thou hast said], In them is all my delight.

title: Psalms 16:4
text: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another: their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, and I will not take up their names into my lips.

title: Psalms 16:5
text: Jehovah is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

title: Psalms 16:6
text: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

title: Psalms 16:7
text: I will bless Jehovah, who giveth me counsel; even in the nights my reins instruct me.

title: Psalms 16:8
text: ¶I have set Jehovah continually before me; because [he is] at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

title: Psalms 16:9
text: Therefore my heart rejoiceth, and my glory exulteth; my flesh moreover shall dwell in hope.

title: Psalms 16:10
text: For thou wilt not leave my soul to Sheol, neither wilt thou allow thy Holy One to see corruption.

title: Psalms 16:11
text: Thou wilt make known to me the path of life: thy countenance is fulness of joy; at thy right hand are pleasures for evermore.

title: Psalms 17:1
text: ¶<<A Prayer of David.>> Hear the right, O Jehovah, attend unto my cry; give ear unto my prayer, which is not out of feigned lips.

title: Psalms 17:2
text: Let my judgment come forth from thy presence, let thine eyes regard equity.

title: Psalms 17:3
text: Thou hast proved my heart, thou hast visited me by night; thou hast tried me, thou hast found nothing: my thought goeth not beyond my word.

title: Psalms 17:4
text: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept from the paths of the violent [man].

title: Psalms 17:5
text: When thou holdest my goings in thy paths, my footsteps slip not.

title: Psalms 17:6
text: I have called upon thee, for thou answerest me, O *God. Incline thine ear unto me, hear my speech.

title: Psalms 17:7
text: Shew wondrously thy loving-kindnesses, O thou that savest by thy right hand them that trust [in thee] from those that rise up [against them].

title: Psalms 17:8
text: ¶Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

title: Psalms 17:9
text: From the wicked that destroy me, my deadly enemies, who compass me about.

title: Psalms 17:10
text: They are enclosed in their own fat; with their mouth they speak proudly.

title: Psalms 17:11
text: They have now encompassed us in our steps; their eyes have they set, bowing down to the earth.

title: Psalms 17:12
text: He is like a lion that is greedy of its prey, and as a young lion lurking in secret places.

title: Psalms 17:13
text: Arise, Jehovah, anticipate him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, thy sword;

title: Psalms 17:14
text: From men [who are] thy hand, O Jehovah, from men of this age: their portion is in [this] life, and their belly thou fillest with thy hid [treasure]; they have their fill of sons, and leave the rest of their [substance] to their children.

title: Psalms 17:15
text: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

title: Psalms 18:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David, the servant of Jehovah, who spoke to Jehovah the words of this song in the day that Jehovah had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies and out of the hand of Saul. And he said,>> I will love thee, O Jehovah, my strength.

title: Psalms 18:2
text: Jehovah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my *God, my rock, in whom I will trust; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

title: Psalms 18:3
text: I will call upon Jehovah, who is to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

title: Psalms 18:4
text: The bands of death encompassed me, and torrents of Belial made me afraid.

title: Psalms 18:5
text: The bands of Sheol surrounded me, the cords of death encountered me.

title: Psalms 18:6
text: In my distress I called upon Jehovah, and I cried out to my God; he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, into his ears.

title: Psalms 18:7
text: Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled and shook, because he was wroth.

title: Psalms 18:8
text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals burned forth from it.

title: Psalms 18:9
text: And he bowed the heavens, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.

title: Psalms 18:10
text: And he rode upon a cherub and did fly; yea, he flew fast upon the wings of the wind.

title: Psalms 18:11
text: He made darkness his secret place, his tent round about him: darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

title: Psalms 18:12
text: From the brightness before him his thick clouds passed forth: hail and coals of fire.

title: Psalms 18:13
text: And Jehovah thundered in the heavens, and the Most High uttered his voice: hail and coals of fire.

title: Psalms 18:14
text: And he sent his arrows, and scattered [mine enemies]; and he shot forth lightnings, and discomfited them.

title: Psalms 18:15
text: And the beds of the waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were uncovered at thy rebuke, Jehovah, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

title: Psalms 18:16
text: He reached forth from above, he took me, he drew me out of great waters:

title: Psalms 18:17
text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me; for they were mightier than I.

title: Psalms 18:18
text: They encountered me in the day of my calamity, but Jehovah was my stay.

title: Psalms 18:19
text: And he brought me forth into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

title: Psalms 18:20
text: ¶Jehovah hath rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

title: Psalms 18:21
text: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

title: Psalms 18:22
text: For all his ordinances were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me;

title: Psalms 18:23
text: And I was upright with him, and kept myself from mine iniquity.

title: Psalms 18:24
text: And Jehovah hath recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.

title: Psalms 18:25
text: With the gracious thou dost shew thyself gracious; with the upright man thou dost shew thyself upright;

title: Psalms 18:26
text: With the pure thou dost shew thyself pure; and with the perverse thou dost shew thyself contrary.

title: Psalms 18:27
text: For it is thou that savest the afflicted people; but the haughty eyes wilt thou bring down.

title: Psalms 18:28
text: For it is thou that makest my lamp to shine: Jehovah my God enlighteneth my darkness.

title: Psalms 18:29
text: ¶For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

title: Psalms 18:30
text: As for *God, his way is perfect; the word of Jehovah is tried: he is a shield to all that trust in him.

title: Psalms 18:31
text: For who is +God save Jehovah? and who is a rock if not our God?

title: Psalms 18:32
text: The *God who girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect,

title: Psalms 18:33
text: Who maketh my feet like hinds' [feet], and setteth me upon my high places;

title: Psalms 18:34
text: Who teacheth my hands to war, and mine arms bend a bow of brass;

title: Psalms 18:35
text: And thou didst give me the shield of thy salvation, and thy right hand held me up; and thy condescending gentleness hath made me great.

title: Psalms 18:36
text: Thou didst enlarge my steps under me, and mine ankles have not wavered.

title: Psalms 18:37
text: I pursued mine enemies, and overtook them; and I turned not again till they were consumed.

title: Psalms 18:38
text: I crushed them, and they were not able to rise: they fell under my feet.

title: Psalms 18:39
text: And thou girdedst me with strength to battle; thou didst subdue under me those that rose up against me.

title: Psalms 18:40
text: And mine enemies didst thou make to turn their backs unto me, and those that hated me I destroyed.

title: Psalms 18:41
text: They cried, and there was none to save; --unto Jehovah, and he answered them not.

title: Psalms 18:42
text: And I did beat them small as dust before the wind; I did cast them out as the mire of the streets.

title: Psalms 18:43
text: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; thou hast made me the head of the nations: a people I knew not doth serve me.

title: Psalms 18:44
text: At the hearing of the ear, they obey me: strangers come cringing unto me.

title: Psalms 18:45
text: Strangers have faded away, and they come trembling forth from their close places.

title: Psalms 18:46
text: Jehovah liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of my salvation,

title: Psalms 18:47
text: The *God who hath avenged me, and hath subjected the peoples to me;

title: Psalms 18:48
text: Who hath delivered me from mine enemies: yea, thou hast lifted me up above them that rose up against me; from the man of violence hast thou delivered me.

title: Psalms 18:49
text: Therefore will I give thanks to thee, Jehovah, among the nations, and will sing psalms to thy name.

title: Psalms 18:50
text: [It is he] who giveth great deliverances to his king, and sheweth loving-kindness to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

title: Psalms 19:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> The heavens declare the glory of *God; and the expanse sheweth the work of his hands.

title: Psalms 19:2
text: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

title: Psalms 19:3
text: There is no speech and there are no words, yet their voice is heard.

title: Psalms 19:4
text: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their language to the extremity of the world. In them hath he set a tent for the sun,

title: Psalms 19:5
text: And he is as a bridegroom going forth from his chamber; he rejoiceth as a strong man to run the race.

title: Psalms 19:6
text: His going forth is from the end of the heavens, and his circuit unto the ends of it; and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

title: Psalms 19:7
text: ¶The law of Jehovah is perfect, restoring the soul; the testimony of Jehovah is sure, making wise the simple;

title: Psalms 19:8
text: The precepts of Jehovah are right, rejoicing the heart; the commandment of Jehovah is pure, enlightening the eyes;

title: Psalms 19:9
text: The fear of Jehovah is clean, enduring for ever; the judgments of Jehovah are truth, they are righteous altogether:

title: Psalms 19:10
text: They are more precious than gold, yea, than much fine gold; and sweeter than honey and the dropping of the honeycomb.

title: Psalms 19:11
text: Moreover, by them is thy servant enlightened; in keeping them there is great reward.

title: Psalms 19:12
text: Who understandeth [his] errors? Purify me from secret [faults].

title: Psalms 19:13
text: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous [sins]; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be perfect, and I shall be innocent from great transgression.

title: Psalms 19:14
text: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer.

title: Psalms 20:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Jehovah answer thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob protect thee;

title: Psalms 20:2
text: May he send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

title: Psalms 20:3
text: Remember all thine oblations, and accept thy burnt-offering; Selah.

title: Psalms 20:4
text: Grant thee according to thy heart, and fulfil all thy counsels.

title: Psalms 20:5
text: We will triumph in thy salvation, and in the name of our God will we set up our banners. Jehovah fulfil all thy petitions!

title: Psalms 20:6
text: ¶Now know I that Jehovah saveth his anointed; he answereth him from the heavens of his holiness, with the saving strength of his right hand.

title: Psalms 20:7
text: Some make mention of chariots, and some of horses, but we of the name of Jehovah our God.

title: Psalms 20:8
text: They are bowed down and fallen; but we are risen and stand upright.

title: Psalms 20:9
text: Save, Jehovah! Let the king answer us in the day we call.

title: Psalms 21:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> The king shall joy in thy strength, Jehovah; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice.

title: Psalms 21:2
text: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

title: Psalms 21:3
text: For thou hast met him with the blessings of goodness; thou hast set a crown of pure gold on his head.

title: Psalms 21:4
text: He asked life of thee; thou gavest [it] him, length of days for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 21:5
text: His glory is great through thy salvation; majesty and splendour hast thou laid upon him.

title: Psalms 21:6
text: For thou hast made him to be blessings for ever; thou hast filled him with joy by thy countenance.

title: Psalms 21:7
text: ¶For the king confideth in Jehovah: and through the loving-kindness of the Most High he shall not be moved.

title: Psalms 21:8
text: Thy hand shall find out all thine enemies; thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

title: Psalms 21:9
text: Thou shalt make them as a fiery furnace in the time of thy presence; Jehovah shall swallow them up in his anger, and the fire shall devour them:

title: Psalms 21:10
text: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

title: Psalms 21:11
text: For they intended evil against thee; they imagined a mischievous device, which they could not execute.

title: Psalms 21:12
text: For thou wilt make them turn their back; thou wilt make ready thy bowstring against their face.

title: Psalms 21:13
text: Be thou exalted, Jehovah, in thine own strength: we will sing and celebrate thy power.

title: Psalms 22:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon Aijeleth-Shahar. A Psalm of David.>> My *God, my *God, why hast thou forsaken me? [why art thou] far from my salvation, from the words of my groaning?

title: Psalms 22:2
text: My God, I cry by day, and thou answerest not; and by night, and there is no rest for me:

title: Psalms 22:3
text: And thou art holy, thou that dwellest amid the praises of Israel.

title: Psalms 22:4
text: Our fathers confided in thee: they confided, and thou didst deliver them.

title: Psalms 22:5
text: They cried unto thee, and were delivered; they confided in thee, and were not confounded.

title: Psalms 22:6
text: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and the despised of the people.

title: Psalms 22:7
text: All they that see me laugh me to scorn; they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, [saying:]

title: Psalms 22:8
text: Commit it to Jehovah--let him rescue him; let him deliver him, because he delighteth in him!

title: Psalms 22:9
text: But thou art he that took me out of the womb; thou didst make me trust, upon my mother's breasts.

title: Psalms 22:10
text: I was cast upon thee from the womb; thou art my *God from my mother's belly.

title: Psalms 22:11
text: ¶Be not far from me, for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

title: Psalms 22:12
text: Many bulls have encompassed me; Bashan's strong ones have beset me round.

title: Psalms 22:13
text: They gape upon me with their mouth, [as] a ravening and a roaring lion.

title: Psalms 22:14
text: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is become like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

title: Psalms 22:15
text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue cleaveth to my palate; and thou hast laid me in the dust of death.

title: Psalms 22:16
text: For dogs have encompassed me; an assembly of evil-doers have surrounded me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

title: Psalms 22:17
text: I may count all my bones. They look, they stare upon me;

title: Psalms 22:18
text: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

title: Psalms 22:19
text: But thou, Jehovah, be not far [from me]; O my strength, haste thee to help me.

title: Psalms 22:20
text: Deliver my soul from the sword; my only one from the power of the dog;

title: Psalms 22:21
text: Save me from the lion's mouth. Yea, from the horns of the buffaloes hast thou answered me.

title: Psalms 22:22
text: ¶I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

title: Psalms 22:23
text: Ye that fear Jehovah, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and revere him, all ye the seed of Israel.

title: Psalms 22:24
text: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him: but when he cried unto him, he heard.

title: Psalms 22:25
text: My praise is from thee, in the great congregation; I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

title: Psalms 22:26
text: The meek shall eat and be satisfied; they shall praise Jehovah that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

title: Psalms 22:27
text: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn unto Jehovah, and all the families of the nations shall worship before thee:

title: Psalms 22:28
text: For the kingdom is Jehovah's, and he ruleth among the nations.

title: Psalms 22:29
text: All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and worship; all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him, and he that cannot keep alive his own soul.

title: Psalms 22:30
text: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

title: Psalms 22:31
text: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done [it].

title: Psalms 23:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.

title: Psalms 23:2
text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; he leadeth me beside still waters.

title: Psalms 23:3
text: He restoreth my soul; he leadeth me in paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

title: Psalms 23:4
text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.

title: Psalms 23:5
text: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies; thou hast anointed my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

title: Psalms 23:6
text: Surely, goodness and loving-kindness shall follow me all the days of my life; and I will dwell in the house of Jehovah for the length of the days.

title: Psalms 24:1
text: ¶<<Of David. A Psalm.>> The earth is Jehovah's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

title: Psalms 24:2
text: For it was he that founded it upon seas, and established it upon floods.

title: Psalms 24:3
text: ¶Who shall ascend into the mount of Jehovah? and who shall stand in his holy place?

title: Psalms 24:4
text: He that hath blameless hands and a pure heart; who lifteth not up his soul unto vanity, nor sweareth deceitfully:

title: Psalms 24:5
text: He shall receive blessing from Jehovah, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

title: Psalms 24:6
text: This is the generation of them that seek unto him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

title: Psalms 24:7
text: ¶Lift up your heads, ye gates, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in.

title: Psalms 24:8
text: Who is this King of glory? Jehovah strong and mighty, Jehovah mighty in battle.

title: Psalms 24:9
text: Lift up your heads, ye gates; yea, lift up, ye everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in.

title: Psalms 24:10
text: Who is he, this King of glory? Jehovah of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.

title: Psalms 25:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Unto thee, Jehovah, do I lift up my soul.

title: Psalms 25:2
text: My God, I confide in thee; let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

title: Psalms 25:3
text: Yea, none that wait on thee shall be ashamed: they shall be ashamed that deal treacherously without cause.

title: Psalms 25:4
text: Make me to know thy ways, O Jehovah; teach me thy paths.

title: Psalms 25:5
text: Make me to walk in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

title: Psalms 25:6
text: Remember, Jehovah, thy tender mercies and thy loving-kindnesses; for they are from everlasting.

title: Psalms 25:7
text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions; according to thy loving-kindness remember thou me, for thy goodness' sake, Jehovah.

title: Psalms 25:8
text: ¶Good and upright is Jehovah; therefore will he instruct sinners in the way:

title: Psalms 25:9
text: The meek will he guide in judgment, and the meek will he teach his way.

title: Psalms 25:10
text: All the paths of Jehovah are loving-kindness and truth for such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

title: Psalms 25:11
text: For thy name's sake, O Jehovah, thou wilt indeed pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

title: Psalms 25:12
text: What man is he that feareth Jehovah? him will he instruct in the way [that] he should choose.

title: Psalms 25:13
text: His soul shall dwell in prosperity, and his seed shall inherit the earth.

title: Psalms 25:14
text: The secret of Jehovah is with them that fear him, that he may make known his covenant to them.

title: Psalms 25:15
text: ¶Mine eyes are ever toward Jehovah; for he will bring my feet out of the net.

title: Psalms 25:16
text: Turn toward me, and be gracious unto me; for I am solitary and afflicted.

title: Psalms 25:17
text: The troubles of my heart are increased: bring me out of my distresses;

title: Psalms 25:18
text: Consider mine affliction and my travail, and forgive all my sins.

title: Psalms 25:19
text: Consider mine enemies, for they are many, and they hate me [with] cruel hatred.

title: Psalms 25:20
text: Keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I trust in thee.

title: Psalms 25:21
text: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

title: Psalms 25:22
text: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

title: Psalms 26:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Judge me, O Jehovah, for I have walked in mine integrity, and I have confided in Jehovah: I shall not slip.

title: Psalms 26:2
text: Prove me, Jehovah, and test me; try my reins and my heart:

title: Psalms 26:3
text: For thy loving-kindness is before mine eyes, and I have walked in thy truth.

title: Psalms 26:4
text: I have not sat with vain persons, neither have I gone in with dissemblers;

title: Psalms 26:5
text: I have hated the congregation of evil-doers, and I have not sat with the wicked.

title: Psalms 26:6
text: ¶I will wash my hands in innocency, and will encompass thine altar, O Jehovah,

title: Psalms 26:7
text: That I may cause the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, and declare all thy marvellous works.

title: Psalms 26:8
text: Jehovah, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thy glory dwelleth.

title: Psalms 26:9
text: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with men of blood;

title: Psalms 26:10
text: In whose hands are evil devices, and their right hand is full of bribes.

title: Psalms 26:11
text: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity. Redeem me, and be gracious unto me.

title: Psalms 26:12
text: My foot standeth in an even place; in the congregations will I bless Jehovah.

title: Psalms 27:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Jehovah is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? Jehovah is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

title: Psalms 27:2
text: When evil-doers, mine adversaries and mine enemies, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

title: Psalms 27:3
text: If a host encamp against me, my heart shall not fear; if war rise against me, in this will I be confident.

title: Psalms 27:4
text: One [thing] have I asked of Jehovah, that will I seek after: that I may dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of Jehovah, and to inquire [of him] in his temple.

title: Psalms 27:5
text: For in the day of evil he will hide me in his pavilion; in the secret of his tent will he keep me concealed: he will set me high upon a rock.

title: Psalms 27:6
text: And now shall my head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me; and I will offer in his tent sacrifices of shouts of joy: I will sing, yea, I will sing psalms unto Jehovah.

title: Psalms 27:7
text: ¶Hear, Jehovah; with my voice do I call; be gracious unto me, and answer me.

title: Psalms 27:8
text: My heart said for thee, Seek ye my face. Thy face, O Jehovah, will I seek.

title: Psalms 27:9
text: Hide not thy face from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; cast me not off, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

title: Psalms 27:10
text: For had my father and my mother forsaken me, then had Jehovah taken me up.

title: Psalms 27:11
text: Teach me thy way, Jehovah, and lead me in an even path, because of mine enemies.

title: Psalms 27:12
text: Deliver me not over to the will of mine adversaries; for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out violence.

title: Psalms 27:13
text: Unless I had believed to see the goodness of Jehovah in the land of the living...!

title: Psalms 27:14
text: Wait for Jehovah; be strong and let thy heart take courage: yea, wait for Jehovah.

title: Psalms 28:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Unto thee, Jehovah, do I call; my rock, be not silent unto me, lest, [if] thou keep silence toward me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

title: Psalms 28:2
text: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward the oracle of thy holiness.

title: Psalms 28:3
text: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbours, and mischief is in their heart.

title: Psalms 28:4
text: Give them according to their doing, and according to the wickedness of their deeds; give them after the work of their hands, render to them their desert.

title: Psalms 28:5
text: For they regard not the deeds of Jehovah, nor the work of his hands: he will destroy them, and not build them up.

title: Psalms 28:6
text: ¶Blessed be Jehovah, for he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

title: Psalms 28:7
text: Jehovah is my strength and my shield; my heart confided in him, and I was helped: therefore my heart exulteth, and with my song will I praise him.

title: Psalms 28:8
text: Jehovah is their strength; and he is the stronghold of salvation to his anointed one.

title: Psalms 28:9
text: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance; and feed them, and lift them up for ever.

title: Psalms 29:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Give unto Jehovah, ye sons of the mighty ones, give unto Jehovah glory and strength;

title: Psalms 29:2
text: Give unto Jehovah the glory of his name; worship Jehovah in holy splendour.

title: Psalms 29:3
text: The voice of Jehovah is upon the waters: the *God of glory thundereth, --Jehovah upon great waters.

title: Psalms 29:4
text: The voice of Jehovah is powerful; the voice of Jehovah is full of majesty.

title: Psalms 29:5
text: The voice of Jehovah breaketh cedars; yea, Jehovah breaketh the cedars of Lebanon:

title: Psalms 29:6
text: And he maketh them to skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young buffalo.

title: Psalms 29:7
text: The voice of Jehovah cleaveth out flames of fire.

title: Psalms 29:8
text: The voice of Jehovah shaketh the wilderness; Jehovah shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

title: Psalms 29:9
text: The voice of Jehovah maketh the hinds to calve, and layeth bare the forests; and in his temple doth every one say, Glory!

title: Psalms 29:10
text: Jehovah sitteth upon the flood; yea, Jehovah sitteth as king for ever.

title: Psalms 29:11
text: Jehovah will give strength unto his people; Jehovah will bless his people with peace.

title: Psalms 30:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of David: dedication-song of the house.>> I will extol thee, Jehovah; for thou hast delivered me, and hast not made mine enemies to rejoice over me.

title: Psalms 30:2
text: Jehovah my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

title: Psalms 30:3
text: Jehovah, thou hast brought up my soul from Sheol, thou hast quickened me from among those that go down to the pit.

title: Psalms 30:4
text: Sing psalms unto Jehovah, ye saints of his, and give thanks in remembrance of his holiness.

title: Psalms 30:5
text: For a moment [is passed] in his anger, a life in his favour; at even weeping cometh for the night, and at morn there is rejoicing.

title: Psalms 30:6
text: ¶As for me, I said in my prosperity, I shall never be moved.

title: Psalms 30:7
text: Jehovah, by thy favour thou hadst made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face; I was troubled.

title: Psalms 30:8
text: I called to thee, Jehovah, and unto the Lord did I make supplication:

title: Psalms 30:9
text: What profit is there in my blood, in my going down to the pit? shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

title: Psalms 30:10
text: Hear, O Jehovah, and be gracious unto me; Jehovah, be my helper.

title: Psalms 30:11
text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing; thou hast loosed my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

title: Psalms 30:12
text: That [my] glory may sing psalms of thee, and not be silent. Jehovah my God, I will praise thee for ever.

title: Psalms 31:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> In thee, Jehovah, do I trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

title: Psalms 31:2
text: Incline thine ear to me, deliver me speedily; be a strong rock to me, a house of defence to save me.

title: Psalms 31:3
text: For thou art my rock and my fortress; and, for thy name's sake, thou wilt lead me and guide me.

title: Psalms 31:4
text: Draw me out of the net that they have hidden for me; for thou art my strength.

title: Psalms 31:5
text: Into thy hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, Jehovah, [thou] *God of truth.

title: Psalms 31:6
text: I have hated them that observe lying vanities; and as for me, I have confided in Jehovah.

title: Psalms 31:7
text: I will be glad and rejoice in thy loving-kindness, for thou hast seen mine affliction; thou hast known the troubles of my soul,

title: Psalms 31:8
text: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large place.

title: Psalms 31:9
text: ¶Be gracious unto me, Jehovah, for I am in trouble: mine eye wasteth away with vexation, my soul and my belly.

title: Psalms 31:10
text: For my life is spent with sorrow, and my years with sighing; my strength faileth through mine iniquity, and my bones are wasted.

title: Psalms 31:11
text: More than to all mine oppressors, I am become exceedingly a reproach, even to my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that see me without flee from me.

title: Psalms 31:12
text: I am forgotten in [their] heart as a dead man; I am become like a broken vessel.

title: Psalms 31:13
text: For I have heard the slander of many--terror on every side--when they take counsel together against me: they plot to take away my life.

title: Psalms 31:14
text: But I confided in thee, Jehovah; I said, thou art my God.

title: Psalms 31:15
text: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from my persecutors.

title: Psalms 31:16
text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; save me in thy loving-kindness.

title: Psalms 31:17
text: Jehovah, let me not be ashamed; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, let them be silent in Sheol.

title: Psalms 31:18
text: Let the lying lips become dumb, which speak insolently against the righteous in pride and contempt.

title: Psalms 31:19
text: ¶[Oh] how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee, [which] thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee, before the sons of men!

title: Psalms 31:20
text: Thou keepest them concealed in the secret of thy presence from the conspiracies of man; thou hidest them in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

title: Psalms 31:21
text: Blessed be Jehovah; for he hath shewn me wondrously his loving-kindness in a strong city.

title: Psalms 31:22
text: As for me, I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes; nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

title: Psalms 31:23
text: Love Jehovah, all ye his saints. Jehovah preserveth the faithful, and plentifully requiteth the proud doer.

title: Psalms 31:24
text: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all ye that hope in Jehovah.

title: Psalms 32:1
text: ¶<<Of David. Instruction.>> Blessed is he [whose] transgression is forgiven, [whose] sin is covered!

title: Psalms 32:2
text: Blessed is the man unto whom Jehovah reckoneth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile!

title: Psalms 32:3
text: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old, through my groaning all the day long.

title: Psalms 32:4
text: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me; my moisture was turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

title: Psalms 32:5
text: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity I covered not; I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Jehovah, and *thou* forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

title: Psalms 32:6
text: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee at a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they will not reach him.

title: Psalms 32:7
text: ¶Thou art a hiding-place for me; thou preservest me from trouble; thou dost encompass me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

title: Psalms 32:8
text: I will instruct thee and teach thee the way in which thou shalt go; I will counsel [thee] with mine eye upon thee.

title: Psalms 32:9
text: Be ye not as a horse, as a mule, which have no understanding: whose trappings must be bit and bridle, for restraint, or they will not come unto thee.

title: Psalms 32:10
text: Many sorrows hath the wicked; but he that confideth in Jehovah, loving-kindness shall encompass him.

title: Psalms 32:11
text: Rejoice in Jehovah, and be glad, ye righteous; and shout for joy, all ye upright in heart.

title: Psalms 33:1
text: ¶Exult, ye righteous, in Jehovah: praise is comely for the upright.

title: Psalms 33:2
text: Give thanks unto Jehovah with the harp; sing psalms unto him with the ten-stringed lute.

title: Psalms 33:3
text: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud sound.

title: Psalms 33:4
text: For the word of Jehovah is right, and all his work is in faithfulness.

title: Psalms 33:5
text: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the loving-kindness of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 33:6
text: By the word of Jehovah were the heavens made, and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

title: Psalms 33:7
text: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap; he layeth up the deeps in storehouses.

title: Psalms 33:8
text: Let all the earth fear Jehovah; let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

title: Psalms 33:9
text: For *he* spoke, and it was [done]; *he* commanded, and it stood fast.

title: Psalms 33:10
text: Jehovah frustrateth the counsel of the nations; he maketh the thoughts of the peoples of none effect.

title: Psalms 33:11
text: The counsel of Jehovah standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart from generation to generation.

title: Psalms 33:12
text: ¶Blessed is the nation whose God is Jehovah, the people that he hath chosen for his inheritance!

title: Psalms 33:13
text: Jehovah looketh from the heavens; he beholdeth all the sons of men:

title: Psalms 33:14
text: From the place of his habitation he looketh forth upon all the inhabitants of the earth;

title: Psalms 33:15
text: He who fashioneth the hearts of them all, who considereth all their works.

title: Psalms 33:16
text: The king is not saved by the multitude of [his] forces; a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

title: Psalms 33:17
text: The horse is a vain thing for safety; neither doth he deliver by his great power.

title: Psalms 33:18
text: Behold, the eye of Jehovah is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his loving-kindness,

title: Psalms 33:19
text: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

title: Psalms 33:20
text: Our soul waiteth for Jehovah: he is our help and our shield.

title: Psalms 33:21
text: For in him shall our heart rejoice, because we have confided in his holy name.

title: Psalms 33:22
text: Let thy loving-kindness, O Jehovah, be upon us, according as we have hoped in thee.

title: Psalms 34:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David; when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.>> I will bless Jehovah at all times; his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

title: Psalms 34:2
text: My soul shall make its boast in Jehovah: the meek shall hear, and rejoice.

title: Psalms 34:3
text: Magnify Jehovah with me, and let us exalt his name together.

title: Psalms 34:4
text: I sought Jehovah, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

title: Psalms 34:5
text: They looked unto him, and were enlightened, and their faces were not confounded.

title: Psalms 34:6
text: This afflicted one called, and Jehovah heard [him], and saved him out of all his troubles.

title: Psalms 34:7
text: The angel of Jehovah encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

title: Psalms 34:8
text: Taste and see that Jehovah is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him!

title: Psalms 34:9
text: Fear Jehovah, ye his saints; for there is no want to them that fear him.

title: Psalms 34:10
text: The young lions are in need and suffer hunger; but they that seek Jehovah shall not want any good.

title: Psalms 34:11
text: ¶Come, ye sons, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 34:12
text: What man is he that desireth life, [and] loveth days, that he may see good?

title: Psalms 34:13
text: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile;

title: Psalms 34:14
text: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

title: Psalms 34:15
text: The eyes of Jehovah are upon the righteous, and his ears are toward their cry;

title: Psalms 34:16
text: The face of Jehovah is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth:

title: Psalms 34:17
text: [The righteous] cry, and Jehovah heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

title: Psalms 34:18
text: Jehovah is nigh to those that are of a broken heart, and saveth them that are of a contrite spirit.

title: Psalms 34:19
text: Many are the adversities of the righteous, but Jehovah delivereth him out of them all:

title: Psalms 34:20
text: He keepeth all his bones; not one of them is broken.

title: Psalms 34:21
text: Evil shall destroy the wicked; and they that hate the righteous shall bear their guilt.

title: Psalms 34:22
text: Jehovah redeemeth the soul of his servants; and none of them that trust in him shall bear guilt.

title: Psalms 35:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Strive, O Jehovah, with them that strive with me; fight against them that fight against me:

title: Psalms 35:2
text: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help;

title: Psalms 35:3
text: And draw out the spear, and stop [the way] against my pursuers: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.

title: Psalms 35:4
text: Let them be put to shame and confounded that seek after my life; let them be turned backward and brought to confusion that devise my hurt:

title: Psalms 35:5
text: Let them be as chaff before the wind, and let the angel of Jehovah drive [them] away;

title: Psalms 35:6
text: Let their way be dark and slippery, and let the angel of Jehovah pursue them.

title: Psalms 35:7
text: For without cause have they hidden for me their net [in] a pit; without cause they have digged [it] for my soul.

title: Psalms 35:8
text: Let destruction come upon him unawares, and let his net which he hath hidden catch himself: for destruction let him fall therein.

title: Psalms 35:9
text: And my soul shall be joyful in Jehovah; it shall rejoice in his salvation.

title: Psalms 35:10
text: All my bones shall say, Jehovah, who is like unto thee, who deliverest the afflicted from one stronger than he, yea, the afflicted and the needy from him that spoileth him!

title: Psalms 35:11
text: ¶Unrighteous witnesses rise up; they lay to my charge things which I know not.

title: Psalms 35:12
text: They reward me evil for good, [to] the bereavement of my soul.

title: Psalms 35:13
text: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth; I chastened my soul with fasting, and my prayer returned into mine own bosom:

title: Psalms 35:14
text: I behaved myself as though [he had been] a friend, a brother to me; I bowed down in sadness, as one that mourneth [for] a mother.

title: Psalms 35:15
text: But at my halting they rejoiced, and gathered together: the slanderers gathered themselves together against me, and I knew [it] not; they did tear [me], and ceased not:

title: Psalms 35:16
text: With profane jesters for bread, they have gnashed their teeth against me.

title: Psalms 35:17
text: ¶Lord, how long wilt thou look on? Rescue my soul from their destructions, my only one from the young lions.

title: Psalms 35:18
text: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation; I will praise thee among much people.

title: Psalms 35:19
text: Let not them that are wrongfully mine enemies rejoice over me; let them not wink with the eye that hate me without cause.

title: Psalms 35:20
text: For they speak not peace; and they devise deceitful words against the quiet in the land.

title: Psalms 35:21
text: And they opened their mouth wide against me; they said, Aha! aha! our eye hath seen [it].

title: Psalms 35:22
text: Thou hast seen [it], Jehovah: keep not silence; O Lord, be not far from me.

title: Psalms 35:23
text: Stir up thyself, and awake for my right, for my cause, my God and Lord!

title: Psalms 35:24
text: Judge me, Jehovah my God, according to thy righteousness, and let them not rejoice over me.

title: Psalms 35:25
text: Let them not say in their heart, Aha! so would we have it. Let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

title: Psalms 35:26
text: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine adversity; let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.

title: Psalms 35:27
text: Let them exult and rejoice that delight in my righteousness; and let them say continually, Jehovah be magnified, who delighteth in the prosperity of his servant.

title: Psalms 35:28
text: And my tongue shall talk of thy righteousness, [and] of thy praise, all the day.

title: Psalms 36:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. [A Psalm] of the servant of Jehovah; of David.>> The transgression of the wicked uttereth within my heart, There is no fear of God before his eyes.

title: Psalms 36:2
text: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, [even] when his iniquity is found to be hateful.

title: Psalms 36:3
text: The words of his mouth are wickedness and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, to do good.

title: Psalms 36:4
text: He deviseth wickedness up on his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good: he abhorreth not evil.

title: Psalms 36:5
text: ¶Jehovah, thy loving-kindness is in the heavens, and thy faithfulness [reacheth] unto the clouds.

title: Psalms 36:6
text: Thy righteousness is like the high mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: thou, Jehovah, preservest man and beast.

title: Psalms 36:7
text: How precious is thy loving-kindness, O God! So the sons of men take refuge under the shadow of thy wings.

title: Psalms 36:8
text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou wilt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

title: Psalms 36:9
text: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

title: Psalms 36:10
text: Continue thy loving-kindness unto them that know thee, and thy righteousness to the upright in heart;

title: Psalms 36:11
text: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.

title: Psalms 36:12
text: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and are not able to rise.

title: Psalms 37:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, and be not envious of them that work unrighteousness;

title: Psalms 37:2
text: for they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and fade as the green herb.

title: Psalms 37:3
text: Confide in Jehovah, and do good; dwell in the land, and feed on faithfulness;

title: Psalms 37:4
text: and delight thyself in Jehovah, and he will give thee the desires of thy heart.

title: Psalms 37:5
text: Commit thy way unto Jehovah, and rely upon him: he will bring [it] to pass;

title: Psalms 37:6
text: and he will bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

title: Psalms 37:7
text: ¶Rest in Jehovah, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him that prospereth in his way, because of the man that bringeth mischievous devices to pass.

title: Psalms 37:8
text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath; fret not thyself: it [would be] only to do evil.

title: Psalms 37:9
text: For evil-doers shall be cut off; but those that wait on Jehovah, they shall possess the land.

title: Psalms 37:10
text: For yet a little while, and the wicked is not; and thou considerest his place, but he is not.

title: Psalms 37:11
text: But the meek shall possess the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of prosperity.

title: Psalms 37:12
text: The wicked plotteth against the righteous, and gnasheth his teeth against him.

title: Psalms 37:13
text: The Lord laugheth at him; for he seeth that his day is coming.

title: Psalms 37:14
text: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the afflicted and needy, to slay those that are upright in [the] way:

title: Psalms 37:15
