text: their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

title: Psalms 37:16
text: The little that the righteous hath is better than the abundance of many wicked;

title: Psalms 37:17
text: for the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Jehovah upholdeth the righteous.

title: Psalms 37:18
text: Jehovah knoweth the days of the perfect; and their inheritance shall be for ever:

title: Psalms 37:19
text: they shall not be ashamed in the time of evil, and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

title: Psalms 37:20
text: For the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of Jehovah shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume, like smoke shall they consume away.

title: Psalms 37:21
text: ¶The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again; but the righteous is gracious and giveth:

title: Psalms 37:22
text: for those blessed of him shall possess the land, and they that are cursed of him shall be cut off.

title: Psalms 37:23
text: The steps of a man are established by Jehovah, and he delighteth in his way:

title: Psalms 37:24
text: though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down, for Jehovah upholdeth his hand.

title: Psalms 37:25
text: I have been young, and now am old, and I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread:

title: Psalms 37:26
text: all the day he is gracious and lendeth, and his seed shall be a blessing.

title: Psalms 37:27
text: Depart from evil, and do good, and dwell for evermore;

title: Psalms 37:28
text: for Jehovah loveth judgment, and will not forsake his saints: They are preserved for ever; but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

title: Psalms 37:29
text: The righteous shall possess the land, and dwell therein for ever.

title: Psalms 37:30
text: The mouth of the righteous proffereth wisdom, and his tongue speaketh judgment;

title: Psalms 37:31
text: the law of his God is in his heart; his goings shall not slide.

title: Psalms 37:32
text: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him:

title: Psalms 37:33
text: Jehovah will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

title: Psalms 37:34
text: ¶Wait for Jehovah, and keep his way, and he will exalt thee to possess the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see [it].

title: Psalms 37:35
text: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading like a green tree in its native soil:

title: Psalms 37:36
text: but he passed away, and behold, he was not; and I sought him, but he was not found.

title: Psalms 37:37
text: Mark the perfect, and behold the upright, for the end of [that] man is peace;

title: Psalms 37:38
text: but the transgressors shall be destroyed together; the future of the wicked shall be cut off.

title: Psalms 37:39
text: But the salvation of the righteous is of Jehovah: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

title: Psalms 37:40
text: And Jehovah will help them and deliver them: he will deliver them from the wicked, and save them; for they trust in him.

title: Psalms 38:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.>> Jehovah, rebuke me not in thy wrath; neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

title: Psalms 38:2
text: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand cometh down upon me.

title: Psalms 38:3
text: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine indignation; no peace in my bones, because of my sin.

title: Psalms 38:4
text: For mine iniquities are gone over my head: as a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

title: Psalms 38:5
text: My wounds stink, they are corrupt, because of my foolishness.

title: Psalms 38:6
text: I am depressed; I am bowed down beyond measure; I go mourning all the day.

title: Psalms 38:7
text: For my loins are full of burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.

title: Psalms 38:8
text: I am faint and broken beyond measure; I roar by reason of the agitation of my heart.

title: Psalms 38:9
text: Lord, all my desire is before thee, and my sighing is not hid from thee.

title: Psalms 38:10
text: My heart throbbeth, my strength hath left me; and the light of mine eyes, it also is no more with me.

title: Psalms 38:11
text: My lovers and mine associates stand aloof from my stroke; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

title: Psalms 38:12
text: ¶And they that seek after my life lay snares [for me]; and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all the day long.

title: Psalms 38:13
text: But I, as a deaf [man], hear not; and am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

title: Psalms 38:14
text: Yea, I am as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

title: Psalms 38:15
text: For in thee, Jehovah, do I hope: *thou* wilt answer, O Lord my God.

title: Psalms 38:16
text: For I said, Let them not rejoice over me! When my foot slipped, they magnified [themselves] against me.

title: Psalms 38:17
text: For I am ready to halt, and my pain is continually before me.

title: Psalms 38:18
text: For I will declare mine iniquity, I am grieved for my sin.

title: Psalms 38:19
text: But mine enemies are lively, they are strong; and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied:

title: Psalms 38:20
text: And they that render evil for good are adversaries unto me; because I pursue what is good.

title: Psalms 38:21
text: Forsake me not, Jehovah; O my God, be not far from me.

title: Psalms 38:22
text: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.

title: Psalms 39:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.>> I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a muzzle, while the wicked is before me.

title: Psalms 39:2
text: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

title: Psalms 39:3
text: My heart burned within me; the fire was kindled in my musing: I spoke with my tongue,

title: Psalms 39:4
text: Make me to know, Jehovah, mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is: I shall know how frail I am.

title: Psalms 39:5
text: Behold, thou hast made my days [as] hand-breadths, and my lifetime is as nothing before thee; verily, every man, [even] the high placed, is altogether vanity. Selah.

title: Psalms 39:6
text: Verily, man walketh in a vain show; verily they are disquieted in vain; he heapeth up [riches], and knoweth not who shall gather them.

title: Psalms 39:7
text: ¶And now, what wait I for, Lord? my hope is in thee.

title: Psalms 39:8
text: Deliver me from all my transgressions; make me not the reproach of the foolish.

title: Psalms 39:9
text: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; for *thou* hast done [it].

title: Psalms 39:10
text: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thy hand.

title: Psalms 39:11
text: When thou with rebukes dost correct a man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely, every man is vanity. Selah.

title: Psalms 39:12
text: Hear my prayer, Jehovah, and give ear unto my cry; be not silent at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, a sojourner, like all my fathers.

title: Psalms 39:13
text: Look away from me, and let me recover strength, before I go hence and be no more.

title: Psalms 40:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of David. A Psalm.>> I waited patiently for Jehovah; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

title: Psalms 40:2
text: And he brought me up out of the pit of destruction, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock; he hath established my goings:

title: Psalms 40:3
text: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, praise unto our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall confide in Jehovah.

title: Psalms 40:4
text: Blessed is the man that hath made Jehovah his confidence, and turneth not to the proud, and to such as turn aside to lies.

title: Psalms 40:5
text: Thou, O Jehovah my God, hast multiplied thy marvellous works, and thy thoughts toward us: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee; would I declare and speak [them], they are more than can be numbered.

title: Psalms 40:6
text: ¶Sacrifice and oblation thou didst not desire: ears hast thou prepared me. Burnt-offering and sin-offering hast thou not demanded;

title: Psalms 40:7
text: Then said I, Behold, I come, in the volume of the book it is written of me--

title: Psalms 40:8
text: To do thy good pleasure, my God, is my delight, and thy law is within my heart.

title: Psalms 40:9
text: I have published righteousness in the great congregation: behold, I have not withheld my lips, Jehovah, *thou* knowest.

title: Psalms 40:10
text: I have not hidden thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy loving-kindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

title: Psalms 40:11
text: ¶Withhold not thou, Jehovah, thy tender mercies from me; let thy loving-kindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

title: Psalms 40:12
text: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I cannot see; they are more than the hairs of my head: and my heart hath failed me.

title: Psalms 40:13
text: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me; Jehovah, make haste to my help.

title: Psalms 40:14
text: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be turned backward and confounded that take pleasure in mine adversity;

title: Psalms 40:15
text: Let them be desolate, because of their shame, that say unto me, Aha! Aha!

title: Psalms 40:16
text: Let all those that seek thee be glad and rejoice in thee; let such as love thy salvation say continually, Jehovah be magnified!

title: Psalms 40:17
text: But I am afflicted and needy: the Lord thinketh upon me. Thou art my help and my deliverer: my God, make no delay.

title: Psalms 41:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Blessed is he that understandeth the poor: Jehovah will deliver him in the day of evil.

title: Psalms 41:2
text: Jehovah will preserve him, and keep him alive; he shall be made happy in the land; and thou wilt not deliver him to the will of his enemies.

title: Psalms 41:3
text: Jehovah will sustain him upon the bed of languishing: thou turnest all his bed in his sickness.

title: Psalms 41:4
text: As for me, I said, Jehovah, be gracious unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

title: Psalms 41:5
text: ¶Mine enemies wish me evil: When will he die, and his name perish?

title: Psalms 41:6
text: And if one come to see [me], he speaketh falsehood; his heart gathereth wickedness to itself: he goeth abroad, he telleth [it].

title: Psalms 41:7
text: All that hate me whisper together against me; against me do they devise my hurt.

title: Psalms 41:8
text: A thing of Belial cleaveth fast unto him; and now that he is laid down, he will rise up no more.

title: Psalms 41:9
text: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I confided, who did eat of my bread, hath lifted up [his] heel against me.

title: Psalms 41:10
text: But thou, Jehovah, be gracious unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

title: Psalms 41:11
text: By this I know that thou delightest in me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

title: Psalms 41:12
text: But as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

title: Psalms 41:13
text: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, from eternity to eternity! Amen, and Amen.

title: Psalms 42:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. An instruction; of the sons of Korah.>> As the hart panteth after the water-brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

title: Psalms 42:2
text: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living *God: when shall I come and appear before God?

title: Psalms 42:3
text: My tears have been my bread day and night, while they say unto me all the day, Where is thy God?

title: Psalms 42:4
text: These things I remember and have poured out my soul within me: how I passed along with the multitude, how I went on with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, a festive multitude.

title: Psalms 42:5
text: Why art thou cast down, my soul, and art disquieted in me? hope in God; for I shall yet praise him, [for] the health of his countenance.

title: Psalms 42:6
text: ¶My God, my soul is cast down within me; therefore do I remember thee from the land of the Jordan, and the Hermons, from mount Mizar.

title: Psalms 42:7
text: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy cataracts; all thy breakers and thy billows are gone over me.

title: Psalms 42:8
text: In the day-time will Jehovah command his loving-kindness, and in the night his song shall be with me, a prayer unto the *God of my life.

title: Psalms 42:9
text: I will say unto *God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

title: Psalms 42:10
text: As with a crushing in my bones mine adversaries reproach me, while they say unto me all the day, Where is thy God?

title: Psalms 42:11
text: Why art thou cast down, my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God; for I shall yet praise him, [who is] the health of my countenance, and my God.

title: Psalms 43:1
text: ¶Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation; deliver me from the deceitful and unrighteous man.

title: Psalms 43:2
text: For thou art the God of my strength: why hast thou cast me off? why go I about mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

title: Psalms 43:3
text: Send out thy light and thy truth: *they* shall lead me, *they* shall bring me to thy holy mount, and unto thy habitations.

title: Psalms 43:4
text: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto the *God of the gladness of my joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God, my God.

title: Psalms 43:5
text: Why art thou cast down, my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God; for I shall yet praise him, [who is] the health of my countenance, and my God.

title: Psalms 44:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. An instruction.>> O God, with our ears have we heard, our fathers have told us, the work thou wroughtest in their days, in the days of old:

title: Psalms 44:2
text: Thou, by thy hand, didst dispossess the nations, but them thou didst plant; thou didst afflict the peoples, but them didst thou cause to spread out.

title: Psalms 44:3
text: For not by their own sword did they take possession of the land, neither did their own arm save them; but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst delight in them.

title: Psalms 44:4
text: Thou thyself art my king, O God: command deliverance for Jacob.

title: Psalms 44:5
text: Through thee will we push down our adversaries; through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

title: Psalms 44:6
text: For I will not put confidence in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

title: Psalms 44:7
text: For thou hast saved us from our adversaries, and hast put them to shame that hate us.

title: Psalms 44:8
text: In God will we boast all the day, and we will praise thy name for ever. Selah.

title: Psalms 44:9
text: ¶But thou hast cast off, and put us to confusion, and dost not go forth with our armies;

title: Psalms 44:10
text: Thou hast made us to turn back from the adversary, and they that hate us spoil for themselves;

title: Psalms 44:11
text: Thou hast given us over like sheep [appointed] for meat, and hast scattered us among the nations;

title: Psalms 44:12
text: Thou hast sold thy people for nought, and hast not increased [thy wealth] by their price;

title: Psalms 44:13
text: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a mockery and a derision for them that are round about us;

title: Psalms 44:14
text: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

title: Psalms 44:15
text: All the day my confusion is before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

title: Psalms 44:16
text: Because of the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and the avenger.

title: Psalms 44:17
text: ¶All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely against thy covenant:

title: Psalms 44:18
text: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy path;

title: Psalms 44:19
text: Though thou hast crushed us in the place of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

title: Psalms 44:20
text: If we had forgotten the name of our God, and stretched out our hands to a strange *god,

title: Psalms 44:21
text: Would not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

title: Psalms 44:22
text: But for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are reckoned as sheep for slaughter.

title: Psalms 44:23
text: Awake, why sleepest thou, Lord? arise, cast [us] not off for ever.

title: Psalms 44:24
text: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, [and] forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

title: Psalms 44:25
text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

title: Psalms 44:26
text: Rise up for our help, and redeem us for thy loving-kindness' sake.

title: Psalms 45:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon Shoshannim. Of the sons of Korah. An instruction; --a song of the Beloved.>> My heart is welling forth [with] a good matter: I say what I have composed touching the king. My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

title: Psalms 45:2
text: Thou art fairer than the sons of men; grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

title: Psalms 45:3
text: Gird thy sword upon [thy] thigh, O mighty one, [in] thy majesty and thy splendour;

title: Psalms 45:4
text: And [in] thy splendour ride prosperously, because of truth and meekness [and] righteousness: and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

title: Psalms 45:5
text: Thine arrows are sharp--peoples fall under thee--in the heart of the king's enemies.

title: Psalms 45:6
text: ¶Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever; a sceptre of uprightness is the sceptre of thy kingdom:

title: Psalms 45:7
text: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated wickedness; therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy companions.

title: Psalms 45:8
text: Myrrh and aloes, cassia, are all thy garments; out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.

title: Psalms 45:9
text: Kings' daughters are among thine honourable women; upon thy right hand doth stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

title: Psalms 45:10
text: ¶Hearken, daughter, and see, and incline thine ear; and forget thine own people and thy father's house:

title: Psalms 45:11
text: And the king will desire thy beauty; for he is thy Lord, and worship thou him.

title: Psalms 45:12
text: And the daughter of Tyre with a gift, the rich ones among the people, shall court thy favour.

title: Psalms 45:13
text: All glorious is the king's daughter within; her clothing is of wrought gold:

title: Psalms 45:14
text: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of embroidery; the virgins behind her, her companions, shall be brought in unto thee:

title: Psalms 45:15
text: With joy and gladness shall they be brought; they shall enter into the king's palace.

title: Psalms 45:16
text: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy sons; princes shalt thou make them in all the earth.

title: Psalms 45:17
text: I will make thy name to be remembered throughout all generations; therefore shall the peoples praise thee for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 46:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. On Alamoth. A song.>> God is our refuge and strength, a help in distresses, very readily found.

title: Psalms 46:2
text: Therefore will we not fear though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the heart of the seas;

title: Psalms 46:3
text: Though the waters thereof roar [and] foam, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

title: Psalms 46:4
text: There is a river the streams whereof make glad the city of God, the sanctuary of the habitations of the Most High.

title: Psalms 46:5
text: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her at the dawn of the morning.

title: Psalms 46:6
text: ¶The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved; he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

title: Psalms 46:7
text: Jehovah of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our high fortress. Selah.

title: Psalms 46:8
text: Come, behold the works of Jehovah, what desolations he hath made in the earth:

title: Psalms 46:9
text: He hath made wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariots in the fire.

title: Psalms 46:10
text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.

title: Psalms 46:11
text: Jehovah of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our high fortress. Selah.

title: Psalms 47:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm.>> All ye peoples, clap your hands; shout unto God with the voice of triumph!

title: Psalms 47:2
text: For Jehovah, the Most High, is terrible, a great king over all the earth.

title: Psalms 47:3
text: He subdueth the peoples under us, and the nations under our feet.

title: Psalms 47:4
text: He hath chosen our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

title: Psalms 47:5
text: ¶God is gone up amid shouting, Jehovah amid the sound of the trumpet.

title: Psalms 47:6
text: Sing psalms of God, sing psalms; sing psalms unto our King, sing psalms!

title: Psalms 47:7
text: For God is the King of all the earth; sing psalms with understanding.

title: Psalms 47:8
text: God reigneth over the nations; God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

title: Psalms 47:9
text: The willing-hearted of the peoples have gathered together, [with] the people of the God of Abraham. For unto God [belong] the shields of the earth: he is greatly exalted.

title: Psalms 48:1
text: ¶<<A Song; a Psalm. Of the sons of Korah.>> Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the hill of his holiness.

title: Psalms 48:2
text: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, [on] the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

title: Psalms 48:3
text: God is known in her palaces as a high fortress.

title: Psalms 48:4
text: For behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together;

title: Psalms 48:5
text: They saw, --so they marvelled; they were troubled, they fled in consternation:

title: Psalms 48:6
text: Trembling took hold upon them there; anguish, as of a woman in travail.

title: Psalms 48:7
text: With an east wind thou hast broken the ships of Tarshish.

title: Psalms 48:8
text: ¶As we have heard, so have we seen, in the city of Jehovah of hosts, in the city of our God: God doth establish it for ever. Selah.

title: Psalms 48:9
text: We have thought, O God, of thy loving-kindness, in the midst of thy temple.

title: Psalms 48:10
text: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

title: Psalms 48:11
text: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

title: Psalms 48:12
text: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: count the towers thereof;

title: Psalms 48:13
text: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces: that ye may tell it to the generation following.

title: Psalms 48:14
text: For this God is our God for ever and ever; he will be our guide until death.

title: Psalms 49:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm.>> Hear this, all ye peoples; give ear, all inhabitants of the world:

title: Psalms 49:2
text: Both men of low and men of high degree, rich and poor alike.

title: Psalms 49:3
text: My mouth shall speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding:

title: Psalms 49:4
text: I will incline mine ear to a parable, I will open my riddle upon the harp.

title: Psalms 49:5
text: Wherefore should I fear in the days of adversity, [when] the iniquity of my supplanters encompasseth me? --

title: Psalms 49:6
text: ¶They depend upon their wealth, and boast themselves in the abundance of their riches. ...

title: Psalms 49:7
text: None can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him,

title: Psalms 49:8
text: (For the redemption of their soul is costly, and must be given up for ever,)

title: Psalms 49:9
text: That he should still live perpetually, [and] not see corruption.

title: Psalms 49:10
text: For he seeth that wise men die; all alike, the fool and the brutish perish, and they leave their wealth to others.

title: Psalms 49:11
text: Their inward thought is, that their houses are for ever, their dwelling-places from generation to generation: they call the lands after their own names.

title: Psalms 49:12
text: Nevertheless, man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

title: Psalms 49:13
text: This their way is their folly, yet they that come after them delight in their sayings. Selah.

title: Psalms 49:14
text: Like sheep are they laid in Sheol: Death feedeth on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their comeliness shall be for Sheol to consume, that there be no habitation for them.

title: Psalms 49:15
text: ¶But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol: for he will receive me. Selah.

title: Psalms 49:16
text: Be not afraid when a man becometh rich, when the glory of his house is increased:

title: Psalms 49:17
text: For when he dieth, he shall carry nothing away; his glory shall not descend after him.

title: Psalms 49:18
text: Though he blessed his soul in his lifetime, --and men will praise thee when thou doest well to thyself, --

title: Psalms 49:19
text: It shall go to the generation of his fathers: they shall never see light.

title: Psalms 49:20
text: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.

title: Psalms 50:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm. Of Asaph.>> *God, Elohim-Jehovah, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

title: Psalms 50:2
text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined forth.

title: Psalms 50:3
text: Our God will come, and will not keep silence: fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

title: Psalms 50:4
text: He will call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people:

title: Psalms 50:5
text: Gather unto me my godly ones, those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice!

title: Psalms 50:6
text: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness; for God executeth judgment himself. Selah.

title: Psalms 50:7
text: ¶Hear, my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify unto thee: I am God, thy God.

title: Psalms 50:8
text: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices, or thy burnt-offerings, continually before me;

title: Psalms 50:9
text: I will take no bullock out of thy house, [nor] he-goats out of thy folds:

title: Psalms 50:10
text: For every beast of the forest is mine, the cattle upon a thousand hills;

title: Psalms 50:11
text: I know all the fowl of the mountains, and the roaming creatures of the field are mine:

title: Psalms 50:12
text: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee; for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

title: Psalms 50:13
text: Should I eat the flesh of bulls, and drink the blood of goats?

title: Psalms 50:14
text: Offer unto God thanksgiving, and perform thy vows unto the Most High;

title: Psalms 50:15
text: And call upon me in the day of trouble; I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

title: Psalms 50:16
text: ¶But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant into thy mouth,

title: Psalms 50:17
text: Seeing thou hast hated correction and hast cast my words behind thee?

title: Psalms 50:18
text: When thou sawest a thief, thou didst take pleasure in him, and thy portion was with adulterers;

title: Psalms 50:19
text: Thou lettest thy mouth loose to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit;

title: Psalms 50:20
text: Thou sittest [and] speakest against thy brother, thou revilest thine own mother's son:

title: Psalms 50:21
text: These [things] hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether as thyself: [but] I will reprove thee, and set [them] in order before thine eyes.

title: Psalms 50:22
text: Now consider this, ye that forget +God, lest I tear in pieces, and there be no deliverer.

title: Psalms 50:23
text: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me; and to him that ordereth [his] way will I shew the salvation of God.

title: Psalms 51:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David; when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bath-sheba.>> Be gracious unto me, O God, according to thy loving-kindness; according to the abundance of thy tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

title: Psalms 51:2
text: Wash me fully from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

title: Psalms 51:3
text: For I acknowledge my transgressions, and my sin is continually before me.

title: Psalms 51:4
text: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done what is evil in thy sight; that thou mayest be justified when thou speakest, be clear when thou judgest.

title: Psalms 51:5
text: Behold, in iniquity was I brought forth, and in sin did my mother conceive me.

title: Psalms 51:6
text: Behold, thou wilt have truth in the inward parts; and in the hidden [part] thou wilt make me to know wisdom.

title: Psalms 51:7
text: ¶Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

title: Psalms 51:8
text: Make me to hear gladness and joy; [that] the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

title: Psalms 51:9
text: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

title: Psalms 51:10
text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

title: Psalms 51:11
text: Cast me not away from thy presence, and take not the spirit of thy holiness from me.

title: Psalms 51:12
text: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation, and let a willing spirit sustain me.

title: Psalms 51:13
text: I will teach transgressors thy ways, and sinners shall return unto thee.

title: Psalms 51:14
text: ¶Deliver me from blood-guiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

title: Psalms 51:15
text: Lord, open my lips, and my mouth shall declare thy praise.

title: Psalms 51:16
text: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou hast no pleasure in burnt-offering.

title: Psalms 51:17
text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

title: Psalms 51:18
text: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion; build the walls of Jerusalem.

title: Psalms 51:19
text: Then shalt thou have sacrifices of righteousness, burnt-offering, and whole burnt-offering; then shall they offer up bullocks upon thine altar.

title: Psalms 52:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician: an instruction. Of David; when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David came to the house of Ahimelech.>> Why boastest thou thyself in evil, thou mighty man? The loving-kindness of *God [abideth] continually.

title: Psalms 52:2
text: Thy tongue deviseth mischievous things, like a sharp razor, practising deceit.

title: Psalms 52:3
text: Thou hast loved evil rather than good, lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

title: Psalms 52:4
text: Thou hast loved all devouring words, O deceitful tongue!

title: Psalms 52:5
text: *God shall likewise destroy thee for ever; he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of [thy] tent, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

title: Psalms 52:6
text: ¶The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him, [saying,]

title: Psalms 52:7
text: Behold the man that made not God his strength, but put confidence in the abundance of his riches, [and] strengthened himself in his avarice.

title: Psalms 52:8
text: But as for me, I am like a green olive-tree in the house of God: I will confide in the loving-kindness of God for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 52:9
text: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done [it]; and I will wait on thy name, before thy godly ones, for it is good.

title: Psalms 53:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On Mahalath: an instruction. Of David.>> The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God! They have corrupted themselves, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.

title: Psalms 53:2
text: God looked down from the heavens upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.

title: Psalms 53:3
text: Every one of them is gone back, they are together become corrupt: there is none that doeth good, not even one.

title: Psalms 53:4
text: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, eating up my people [as] they eat bread? they call not upon God.

title: Psalms 53:5
text: There were they in great fear, where no fear was; for God scattereth the bones of him that encampeth against thee. Thou hast put [them] to shame, for God hath despised them.

title: Psalms 53:6
text: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God turneth again the captivity of his people, Jacob shall be glad, Israel shall rejoice.

title: Psalms 54:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments: an instruction. Of David; when the Ziphites came, and said to Saul, Is not David hiding himself with us?>> O God, by thy name save me, and by thy strength do me justice.

title: Psalms 54:2
text: O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.

title: Psalms 54:3
text: For strangers are risen up against me, and the violent seek after my life: they have not set God before them. Selah.

title: Psalms 54:4
text: ¶Behold, God is my helper; the Lord is among them that uphold my soul.

title: Psalms 54:5
text: He will requite evil to mine enemies: in thy truth cut them off.

title: Psalms 54:6
text: I will freely sacrifice unto thee; I will praise thy name, O Jehovah, because it is good.

title: Psalms 54:7
text: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble; and mine eye hath seen [its desire] upon mine enemies.

title: Psalms 55:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments: an instruction. Of David.>> Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

title: Psalms 55:2
text: Attend unto me, and answer me: I wander about in my plaint, and I moan aloud,

title: Psalms 55:3
text: Because of the voice of the enemy; because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in anger they persecute me.

title: Psalms 55:4
text: My heart is writhing within me, and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

title: Psalms 55:5
text: Fear and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

title: Psalms 55:6
text: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away, and be at rest;

title: Psalms 55:7
text: Behold, I would flee afar off, I would lodge in the wilderness; Selah;

title: Psalms 55:8
text: I would hasten my escape from the stormy wind, from the tempest.

title: Psalms 55:9
text: ¶Swallow [them] up, Lord; divide their tongue: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

title: Psalms 55:10
text: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof; and iniquity and mischief are in the midst of it.

title: Psalms 55:11
text: Perversities are in the midst thereof; and oppression and deceit depart not from its streets.

title: Psalms 55:12
text: For it is not an enemy that hath reproached me--then could I have borne it; neither is it he that hateth me that hath magnified [himself] against me--then would I have hidden myself from him;

title: Psalms 55:13
text: But it was thou, a man mine equal, mine intimate, my familiar friend. ...

title: Psalms 55:14
text: We who held sweet intercourse together. To the house of God we walked amid the throng.

title: Psalms 55:15
text: Let death seize upon them, let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is in their dwellings, in their midst.

title: Psalms 55:16
text: ¶As for me, unto God will I call; and Jehovah will save me.

title: Psalms 55:17
text: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray and moan aloud; and he will hear my voice.

title: Psalms 55:18
text: He hath redeemed my soul in peace from the battle against me: for there were many about me.

title: Psalms 55:19
text: *God will hear, and afflict them: he that is seated of old, (Selah) ...because there is no change in them, and they fear not God.

title: Psalms 55:20
text: He hath put forth his hands against such as are at peace with him; he hath profaned his covenant.

title: Psalms 55:21
text: Smooth were the milky [words] of his mouth, but his heart was war; his words were softer than oil, yet are they drawn swords.

title: Psalms 55:22
text: Cast thy burden upon Jehovah, and *he* will sustain thee: he will never suffer the righteous to be moved.

title: Psalms 55:23
text: And thou, O God, wilt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days. But as for me, I will confide in thee.

title: Psalms 56:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On Jonathelem-rechokim. Of David. Michtam; when the Philistines took him in Gath.>> Be gracious unto me, O God; for man would swallow me up: all the day long fighting he oppresseth me.

title: Psalms 56:2
text: Mine enemies would swallow [me] up all the day long; for they are many that fight against me haughtily.

title: Psalms 56:3
text: In the day that I am afraid, I will confide in thee.

title: Psalms 56:4
text: In God will I praise his word, in God I put my confidence: I will not fear; what can flesh do unto me?

title: Psalms 56:5
text: All the day long they wrest my words; all their thoughts are against me for evil.

title: Psalms 56:6
text: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves; they mark my steps, because they wait for my soul.

title: Psalms 56:7
text: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God.

title: Psalms 56:8
text: ¶*Thou* countest my wanderings; put my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?

title: Psalms 56:9
text: Then shall mine enemies return backward in the day when I call: this I know, for God is for me.

title: Psalms 56:10
text: In God will I praise [his] word; in Jehovah will I praise [his] word.

title: Psalms 56:11
text: In God have I put my confidence: I will not fear; what can man do unto me?

title: Psalms 56:12
text: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render thanks unto thee.

title: Psalms 56:13
text: For thou hast delivered my soul from death; [wilt thou] not [keep] my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?

title: Psalms 57:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. 'Destroy not.' Of David. Michtam; when he fled from Saul in the cave.>> Be gracious unto me, O God, be gracious unto me; for my soul taketh refuge in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings do I take refuge, until the calamities be overpast.

title: Psalms 57:2
text: I will call unto God, the Most High; unto *God that performeth [all] for me.

title: Psalms 57:3
text: He will send from the heavens and save me; he hath covered with reproach him that would swallow me up. Selah. God hath sent forth his loving-kindness and his truth.

title: Psalms 57:4
text: My soul is in the midst of lions; I lie down [among] them that breathe out flames, the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

title: Psalms 57:5
text: Be exalted above the heavens, O God; let thy glory be above all the earth!

title: Psalms 57:6
text: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul was bowed down: they have digged a pit before me; they are fallen into the midst thereof. Selah.

title: Psalms 57:7
text: ¶My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing, yea, I will sing psalms.

title: Psalms 57:8
text: Awake, my glory; awake, lute and harp: I will wake the dawn.

title: Psalms 57:9
text: I will give thee thanks among the peoples, O Lord; of thee will I sing psalms among the nations:

title: Psalms 57:10
text: For thy loving-kindness is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

title: Psalms 57:11
text: Be exalted above the heavens, O God; let thy glory be above all the earth!

title: Psalms 58:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. 'Destroy not.' Of David. Michtam.>> Is righteousness indeed silent? Do ye speak it? Do ye judge with equity, ye sons of men?

title: Psalms 58:2
text: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh out the violence of your hands in the earth.

title: Psalms 58:3
text: The wicked go astray from the womb; they err as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

title: Psalms 58:4
text: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: [they are] like the deaf adder which stoppeth her ear;

title: Psalms 58:5
text: Which doth not hearken to the voice of enchanters, of one charming ever so wisely.

title: Psalms 58:6
text: ¶O God, break their teeth in their mouth; break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Jehovah.

title: Psalms 58:7
text: Let them melt away as waters that flow off; when he aimeth his arrows, let them be as blunted:

title: Psalms 58:8
text: Let them be as a snail that melteth as it passeth away; [like] the untimely birth of a woman, let them not see the sun.

title: Psalms 58:9
text: Before your pots feel the thorns, green or burning, --they shall be whirled away.

title: Psalms 58:10
text: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance; he shall wash his footsteps in the blood of the wicked:

title: Psalms 58:11
text: And men shall say, Verily there is fruit for the righteous; verily there is a God that judgeth in the earth.

title: Psalms 59:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. 'Destroy not.' Of David. Michtam; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.>> Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God; secure me on high from them that rise up against me.

title: Psalms 59:2
text: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from men of blood.

title: Psalms 59:3
text: For behold, they lie in wait for my soul; strong ones are gathered against me: not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Jehovah.

title: Psalms 59:4
text: They run and prepare themselves without [my] fault: awake to meet me, and behold.

title: Psalms 59:5
text: Yea, do thou, Jehovah, the God of hosts, the God of Israel, arise to visit all the nations: be not gracious to any plotters of iniquity. Selah.

title: Psalms 59:6
text: They return in the evening; they howl like a dog, and go round about the city:

title: Psalms 59:7
text: Behold, they belch out with their mouth; swords are in their lips: for who [say they] doth hear?

title: Psalms 59:8
text: ¶But thou, Jehovah, wilt laugh at them; thou wilt have all the nations in derision.

title: Psalms 59:9
text: Their strength! ...I will take heed to thee; for God is my high fortress.

title: Psalms 59:10
text: God, whose loving-kindness will come to meet me, --God shall let me see [my desire] upon mine enemies.

title: Psalms 59:11
text: Slay them not, lest my people forget; by thy power make them wander, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.

title: Psalms 59:12
text: [Because of] the sin of their mouth, the word of their lips, let them even be taken in their pride; and because of cursing and lying which they speak.

title: Psalms 59:13
text: Make an end in wrath, make an end, that they may be no more; that they may know that God ruleth in Jacob, unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

title: Psalms 59:14
text: And in the evening they shall return, they shall howl like a dog, and go round about the city.

title: Psalms 59:15
text: They shall wander about for meat, and stay all night if they be not satisfied.

title: Psalms 59:16
text: But as for me, I will sing of thy strength; yea, I will sing aloud of thy loving-kindness in the morning; for thou hast been to me a high fortress, and a refuge in the day of my trouble.

title: Psalms 59:17
text: Unto thee, my strength, will I sing psalms; for God is my high fortress, the God of my mercy.

title: Psalms 60:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On Shushan. Testimony. Michtam of David; to teach: when he strove with the Syrians of Mesopotamia, and the Syrians of Zobah, and Joab returned, and smote the Edomites in the valley of salt, twelve thousand.>> O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased: restore us again.

title: Psalms 60:2
text: Thou hast made the earth to tremble, thou hast rent it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

title: Psalms 60:3
text: Thou hast shewn thy people hard things; thou hast made us to drink the wine of bewilderment.

title: Psalms 60:4
text: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth, (Selah,)

title: Psalms 60:5
text: That thy beloved ones may be delivered. Save with thy right hand, and answer me.

title: Psalms 60:6
text: ¶God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

title: Psalms 60:7
text: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine, and Ephraim is the strength of my head; Judah is my law-giver;

title: Psalms 60:8
text: Moab is my wash-pot; upon Edom will I cast my sandal; Philistia, shout aloud because of me.

title: Psalms 60:9
text: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me unto Edom?

title: Psalms 60:10
text: [Wilt] not thou, O God, who didst cast us off? and didst not go forth, O God, with our armies?

title: Psalms 60:11
text: Give us help from trouble; for vain is man's deliverance.

title: Psalms 60:12
text: Through God we shall do valiantly; and he it is that will tread down our adversaries.

title: Psalms 61:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On a stringed instrument. [A Psalm] of David.>> Hear, O God, my cry; attend unto my prayer.

title: Psalms 61:2
text: From the end of the earth will I call unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: thou wilt lead me on to a rock which is too high for me.

title: Psalms 61:3
text: For thou hast been a refuge for me, a strong tower from before the enemy.

title: Psalms 61:4
text: I will sojourn in thy tent for ever; I will take refuge in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

title: Psalms 61:5
text: ¶For thou, O God, hast heard my vows; thou hast given [me] the inheritance of those that fear thy name.

title: Psalms 61:6
text: Thou wilt add days to the days of the king: his years shall be as many generations.

title: Psalms 61:7
text: He shall abide before God for ever: bestow loving-kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

title: Psalms 61:8
text: So will I sing forth thy name for ever, performing my vows from day to day.

title: Psalms 62:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.>> Upon God alone doth my soul rest peacefully; from him is my salvation.

title: Psalms 62:2
text: He only is my rock and my salvation; my high fortress: I shall not be greatly moved.

title: Psalms 62:3
text: How long will ye assail a man; will ye [seek], all of you, to break him down as a bowing wall or a tottering fence?

title: Psalms 62:4
text: They only consult to thrust [him] down from his excellency; they delight in lies; they bless with their mouth, but in their inward part they curse. Selah.

title: Psalms 62:5
text: Upon God alone, O my soul, rest peacefully; for my expectation is from him.

title: Psalms 62:6
text: He only is my rock and my salvation; my high fortress: I shall not be moved.

title: Psalms 62:7
text: With God is my salvation and my glory; the rock of my strength, my refuge is in God.

title: Psalms 62:8
text: ¶Confide in him at all times, ye people; pour out your heart before him: God is our refuge. Selah.

title: Psalms 62:9
text: Men of low degree are only vanity; men of high degree, a lie: laid in the balance, they go up together [lighter] than vanity.

title: Psalms 62:10
text: Put not confidence in oppression, and become not vain in robbery; if wealth increase, set not your heart upon it.

title: Psalms 62:11
text: Once hath God spoken, twice have I heard this, that strength [belongeth] unto God.

title: Psalms 62:12
text: And unto thee, O Lord, [belongeth] loving-kindness; for *thou* renderest to every man according to his work.

title: Psalms 63:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of David; when he was in the wilderness of Judah.>> O God, thou art my *God; early will I seek thee. My soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh languisheth for thee, in a dry and weary land without water:

title: Psalms 63:2
text: To see thy power and thy glory, as I have beheld thee in the sanctuary;

title: Psalms 63:3
text: ¶For thy loving-kindness is better than life: my lips shall praise thee.

title: Psalms 63:4
text: So will I bless thee while I live; I will lift up my hands in thy name.

title: Psalms 63:5
text: My soul is satisfied as with marrow and fatness, and my mouth shall praise [thee] with joyful lips.

title: Psalms 63:6
text: When I remember thee upon my bed, I meditate on thee in the night-watches:

title: Psalms 63:7
text: ¶For thou hast been my help, and in the shadow of thy wings will I sing for joy.

title: Psalms 63:8
text: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

title: Psalms 63:9
text: But those that seek my soul, to destroy [it], shall go into the lower parts of the earth;

title: Psalms 63:10
text: They shall be given over to the power of the sword; they shall be the portion of foxes.

title: Psalms 63:11
text: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: for the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

title: Psalms 64:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Hear, O God, my voice in my plaint; preserve my life from fear of the enemy:

title: Psalms 64:2
text: Hide me from the secret counsel of evil-doers, from the tumultuous crowd of the workers of iniquity,

title: Psalms 64:3
text: Who have sharpened their tongue like a sword, [and] have aimed their arrow, a bitter word;

title: Psalms 64:4
text: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

title: Psalms 64:5
text: They encourage themselves in an evil matter, they concert to hide snares; they say, Who will see them?

title: Psalms 64:6
text: They devise iniquities: We have it ready, the plan is diligently sought out. And each one's inward [thought] and heart is deep.

title: Psalms 64:7
text: ¶But God will shoot an arrow at them: suddenly are they wounded;

title: Psalms 64:8
text: By their own tongue they are made to fall over one another: all that see them shall flee away.

title: Psalms 64:9
text: And all men shall fear, and shall declare God's doing; and they shall wisely consider his work.

title: Psalms 64:10
text: The righteous shall rejoice in Jehovah, and trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

title: Psalms 65:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David: a Song.>> Praise waiteth for thee in silence, O God, in Zion; and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

title: Psalms 65:2
text: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

title: Psalms 65:3
text: Iniquities have prevailed against me: our transgressions, thou wilt forgive them.

title: Psalms 65:4
text: Blessed is he whom thou choosest and causest to approach: he shall dwell in thy courts. We shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, of thy holy temple.

title: Psalms 65:5
text: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation, thou confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of the distant regions of the sea. ...

title: Psalms 65:6
text: ¶Who by his strength established the mountains, being girded with power;

title: Psalms 65:7
text: Who stilleth the raging of the seas, the raging of their waves, and the tumult of the peoples.

title: Psalms 65:8
text: And they that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens; thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

title: Psalms 65:9
text: Thou hast visited the earth, thou hast watered it; thou greatly enrichest it: the river of God is full of water; thou providest their corn, when thou hast so prepared it:

title: Psalms 65:10
text: Thou dost satiate its furrows, thou smoothest its clods, thou makest it soft with showers; thou blessest the springing thereof.

title: Psalms 65:11
text: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness, and thy paths drop fatness:

title: Psalms 65:12
text: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness, and the hills are girded with gladness.

title: Psalms 65:13
text: The meadows are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, yea, they sing.

title: Psalms 66:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Song: a Psalm.>> Shout aloud unto God, all the earth:

title: Psalms 66:2
text: Sing forth the glory of his name, make his praise glorious;

title: Psalms 66:3
text: Say unto God, How terrible are thy works! because of the greatness of thy strength, thine enemies come cringing unto thee.

title: Psalms 66:4
text: All the earth shall worship thee, and sing psalms unto thee: they shall sing forth thy name. Selah.

title: Psalms 66:5
text: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in [his] doings toward the children of men.

title: Psalms 66:6
text: He turned the sea into dry [land]; they went through the river on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

title: Psalms 66:7
text: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes observe the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

title: Psalms 66:8
text: ¶Bless our God, ye peoples, and make the voice of his praise to be heard;

title: Psalms 66:9
text: Who hath set our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.

title: Psalms 66:10
text: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

title: Psalms 66:11
text: Thou broughtest us into a net, thou didst lay a heavy burden upon our loins;

title: Psalms 66:12
text: Thou didst cause men to ride over our head; we went through fire and through water: but thou hast brought us out into abundance.

title: Psalms 66:13
text: ¶I will go into thy house with burnt-offerings; I will perform my vows to thee,

title: Psalms 66:14
text: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.

title: Psalms 66:15
text: I will offer up unto thee burnt-offerings of fatted beasts, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

title: Psalms 66:16
text: Come, hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

title: Psalms 66:17
text: I called unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

title: Psalms 66:18
text: Had I regarded iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not hear.

title: Psalms 66:19
text: But God hath heard; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

title: Psalms 66:20
text: Blessed be God, who hath not turned away my prayer, nor his loving-kindness from me!

title: Psalms 67:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm: a Song.>> God be gracious unto us, and bless us, [and] cause his face to shine upon us; Selah,

title: Psalms 67:2
text: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy salvation among all nations.

title: Psalms 67:3
text: Let the peoples praise thee, O God, let all the peoples praise thee.

title: Psalms 67:4
text: Let the nations rejoice and sing for joy: for thou wilt judge the peoples equitably; and the nations upon earth, thou wilt guide them. Selah.

title: Psalms 67:5
text: Let the peoples praise thee, O God; let all the peoples praise thee.

title: Psalms 67:6
text: The earth will yield her increase; God, our God, will bless us:

title: Psalms 67:7
text: God will bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

title: Psalms 68:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of David. A Psalm: a Song.>> Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered, and let them that hate him flee before him.

title: Psalms 68:2
text: As smoke is driven, thou wilt drive them away; as wax melteth before the fire, the wicked shall perish at the presence of God.

title: Psalms 68:3
text: But the righteous shall rejoice: they shall exult before God and be glad with joy.

title: Psalms 68:4
text: Sing unto God, sing forth his name; cast up a way for him that rideth in the deserts: his name is Jah; and rejoice before him.

title: Psalms 68:5
text: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

title: Psalms 68:6
text: God maketh the solitary into families; those that were bound he bringeth out into prosperity: but the rebellious dwell in a parched [land].

title: Psalms 68:7
text: ¶O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness--(Selah) --

title: Psalms 68:8
text: The earth trembled, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God, yon Sinai, at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

title: Psalms 68:9
text: Thou, O God, didst pour a plentiful rain upon thine inheritance, and when it was weary thou strengthenedst it.

title: Psalms 68:10
text: Thy flock hath dwelt therein: thou hast prepared in thy goodness, for the afflicted, O God!

title: Psalms 68:11
text: The Lord gives the word: great the host of the publishers.

title: Psalms 68:12
text: Kings of armies flee; they flee, and she that tarrieth at home divideth the spoil.

title: Psalms 68:13
text: Though ye have lain among the sheepfolds, [ye shall be as] wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with green gold.

title: Psalms 68:14
text: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it became snow-white as Zalmon.

title: Psalms 68:15
text: ¶[As] mount Bashan is the mount of God, a many-peaked mountain, [as] mount Bashan.

title: Psalms 68:16
text: Why do ye look with envy, ye many-peaked mountains, upon the mount that God hath desired for his abode? yea, Jehovah will dwell [there] for ever.

title: Psalms 68:17
text: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, thousands upon thousands; the Lord is among them: it is a Sinai in holiness.

title: Psalms 68:18
text: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts in Man, and even [for] the rebellious, for the dwelling [there] of Jah Elohim.

title: Psalms 68:19
text: Blessed be the Lord: day by day doth he load us [with good], the *God who is our salvation. Selah.

title: Psalms 68:20
text: Our *God is the *God of salvation; and with Jehovah, the Lord, are the goings forth [even] from death.

title: Psalms 68:21
text: Verily God will smite the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of him that goeth on still in his trespasses.

title: Psalms 68:22
text: ¶The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring [them] again from the depth of the sea;

title: Psalms 68:23
text: That thou mayest dip thy foot in blood: the tongue of thy dogs has its portion from enemies.

title: Psalms 68:24
text: They have seen thy goings, O God, the goings of my *God, my King, in the sanctuary.

title: Psalms 68:25
text: The singers went before, the players on stringed instruments after, in the midst of maidens playing on tabrets.

title: Psalms 68:26
text: In the congregations bless ye God, the Lord, --[ye] from the fountain of Israel.

title: Psalms 68:27
text: There is little Benjamin, their ruler; the princes of Judah, their company; the princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.

title: Psalms 68:28
text: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

title: Psalms 68:29
text: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.

title: Psalms 68:30
text: Rebuke the beast of the reeds, the assembly of the strong, with the calves of the peoples: [every one] submitteth himself with pieces of silver. Scatter the peoples that delight in war.

title: Psalms 68:31
text: Great ones shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall quickly stretch out her hands unto God.

title: Psalms 68:32
text: ¶Ye kingdoms of the earth, sing unto God; sing psalms of the Lord, (Selah,)

title: Psalms 68:33
text: Of him that rideth upon the heavens, the heavens which are of old: lo, he uttereth his voice, a mighty voice.

title: Psalms 68:34
text: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.

title: Psalms 68:35
text: Terrible art thou, O God, out of thy sanctuaries, --the *God of Israel! He it is that giveth strength and might unto the people. Blessed be God!

title: Psalms 69:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon Shoshannim. [A Psalm] of David.>> Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto [my] soul.

title: Psalms 69:2
text: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing; I am come into the depths of waters, and the flood overfloweth me.

title: Psalms 69:3
text: I am weary with my crying, my throat is parched; mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

title: Psalms 69:4
text: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head; they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

title: Psalms 69:5
text: Thou, O God, knowest my foolishness, and my trespasses are not hidden from thee.

title: Psalms 69:6
text: Let not them that wait on thee, Lord, Jehovah of hosts, be ashamed through me; let not those that seek thee be confounded through me, O God of Israel.

title: Psalms 69:7
text: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; confusion hath covered my face.

title: Psalms 69:8
text: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's sons;

title: Psalms 69:9
text: For the zeal of thy house hath devoured me, and the reproaches of them that reproach thee have fallen upon me.

title: Psalms 69:10
text: And I wept, my soul was fasting: that also was to my reproach; --

title: Psalms 69:11
text: And I made sackcloth my garment: then I became a proverb to them.

title: Psalms 69:12
text: They that sit in the gate talk of me, and [I am] the song of the drunkards.

title: Psalms 69:13
text: ¶But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, Jehovah, in an acceptable time: O God, in the abundance of thy loving-kindness answer me, according to the truth of thy salvation:

title: Psalms 69:14
text: Deliver me out of the mire, let me not sink; let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the depths of waters.

title: Psalms 69:15
text: Let not the flood of waters overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up; and let not the pit shut its mouth upon me.

title: Psalms 69:16
text: Answer me, O Jehovah; for thy loving-kindness is good: according to the abundance of thy tender mercies, turn toward me;

title: Psalms 69:17
text: And hide not thy face from thy servant, for I am in trouble: answer me speedily.

title: Psalms 69:18
text: Draw nigh unto my soul, be its redeemer; ransom me because of mine enemies.

title: Psalms 69:19
text: *Thou* knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

title: Psalms 69:20
text: Reproach hath broken my heart, and I am overwhelmed: and I looked for sympathy, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

title: Psalms 69:21
text: Yea, they gave me gall for my food, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

title: Psalms 69:22
text: ¶Let their table become a snare before them, and their very welfare a trap;

title: Psalms 69:23
text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not, and make their loins continually to shake.

title: Psalms 69:24
text: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let the fierceness of thine anger take hold of them.

title: Psalms 69:25
text: Let their habitation be desolate; let there be no dweller in their tents.

title: Psalms 69:26
text: For they persecute him whom *thou* hast smitten, and they talk for the sorrow of those whom thou hast wounded.

title: Psalms 69:27
text: Add iniquity unto their iniquity, and let them not come into thy righteousness.

title: Psalms 69:28
text: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

title: Psalms 69:29
text: But I am afflicted and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me secure on high.

title: Psalms 69:30
text: ¶I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving;

title: Psalms 69:31
text: And it shall please Jehovah more than an ox, --a bullock with horns and cloven hoofs.

title: Psalms 69:32
text: The meek shall see it, they shall be glad; ye that seek God, your heart shall live.

title: Psalms 69:33
text: For Jehovah heareth the needy, and despiseth not his prisoners.

title: Psalms 69:34
text: Let heavens and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moveth therein.

title: Psalms 69:35
text: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah; and they shall dwell there, and possess it:

title: Psalms 69:36
text: And the seed of his servants shall inherit it, and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

title: Psalms 70:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David: to bring to remembrance.>> Make haste, O God, to deliver me; Jehovah, [hasten] to my help.

title: Psalms 70:2
text: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion that seek after my soul; let them be turned backward and confounded that take pleasure in mine adversity;

title: Psalms 70:3
text: Let them turn back because of their shame that say, Aha! Aha!

title: Psalms 70:4
text: Let all those that seek thee be glad and rejoice in thee, and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified!

title: Psalms 70:5
text: But I am afflicted and needy: make haste unto me, O God. Thou art my help and my deliverer: O Jehovah, make no delay.

title: Psalms 71:1
text: ¶In thee, Jehovah, do I trust: let me never be ashamed.

title: Psalms 71:2
text: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and rescue me; incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

title: Psalms 71:3
text: Be to me a rock of habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

title: Psalms 71:4
text: My God, rescue me out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

title: Psalms 71:5
text: For thou art my hope, O Lord Jehovah, my confidence from my youth.

title: Psalms 71:6
text: On thee have I been stayed from the womb; from the bowels of my mother thou didst draw me forth: my praise shall be continually of thee.

title: Psalms 71:7
text: I have been as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

title: Psalms 71:8
text: My mouth shall be filled with thy praise, with thy glory, all the day.

title: Psalms 71:9
text: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

title: Psalms 71:10
text: For mine enemies speak against me, and they that watch for my soul consult together,

title: Psalms 71:11
text: Saying, God hath forsaken him; pursue and seize him, for there is none to deliver.

title: Psalms 71:12
text: O God, be not far from me; my God, hasten to my help.

title: Psalms 71:13
text: Let them be ashamed, let them be consumed, that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

title: Psalms 71:14
text: ¶But as for me, I will hope continually, and will praise thee yet more and more.

title: Psalms 71:15
text: My mouth shall declare thy righteousness, [and] thy salvation all the day: for I know not the numbers [thereof].

title: Psalms 71:16
text: I will go in the might of the Lord Jehovah; I will recall thy righteousness, thine alone.

title: Psalms 71:17
text: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth, and hitherto have I proclaimed thy marvellous works:

title: Psalms 71:18
text: Now also, when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not, until I have proclaimed thine arm unto [this] generation, thy might to every one that is to come.

title: Psalms 71:19
text: And thy righteousness, O God, reacheth on high, thou who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee?

title: Psalms 71:20
text: Thou, who hast shewn us many and sore troubles, wilt revive us again, and wilt bring us up again from the depths of the earth;

title: Psalms 71:21
text: Thou wilt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

title: Psalms 71:22
text: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, my God; unto thee will I sing psalms with the harp, thou holy One of Israel.

title: Psalms 71:23
text: My lips shall exult when I sing psalms unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

title: Psalms 71:24
text: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day; for they shall be ashamed, for they shall be brought to confusion, that seek my hurt.

title: Psalms 72:1
text: ¶<<For Solomon.>> O God, give the king thy judgments, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.

title: Psalms 72:2
text: ¶He will judge thy people with righteousness, and thine afflicted with judgment.

title: Psalms 72:3
text: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the hills, by righteousness.

title: Psalms 72:4
text: He will do justice to the afflicted of the people; he will save the children of the needy, and will break in pieces the oppressor.

title: Psalms 72:5
text: They shall fear thee as long as sun and moon endure, from generation to generation.

title: Psalms 72:6
text: He shall come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

title: Psalms 72:7
text: In his days shall the righteous flourish, and abundance of peace till the moon be no more.

title: Psalms 72:8
text: And he shall have dominion from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

title: Psalms 72:9
text: The dwellers in the desert shall bow before him, and his enemies shall lick the dust.

title: Psalms 72:10
text: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render presents; the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer tribute:

title: Psalms 72:11
text: Yea, all kings shall bow down before him; all nations shall serve him.

title: Psalms 72:12
text: For he will deliver the needy who crieth, and the afflicted, who hath no helper;

title: Psalms 72:13
text: He will have compassion on the poor and needy, and will save the souls of the needy:

title: Psalms 72:14
text: He will redeem their souls from oppression and violence, and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

title: Psalms 72:15
text: And he shall live; and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba; and prayer shall be made for him continually: all the day shall he be blessed.

title: Psalms 72:16
text: There shall be abundance of corn in the earth, upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon; and they of the city shall bloom like the herb of the earth.

title: Psalms 72:17
text: His name shall endure for ever; his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and [men] shall bless themselves in him; all nations shall call him blessed.

title: Psalms 72:18
text: ¶Blessed be Jehovah Elohim, the God of Israel, who alone doeth wondrous things!

title: Psalms 72:19
text: And blessed be his glorious name for ever! and let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen, and Amen.

title: Psalms 72:20
text: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

title: Psalms 73:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of Asaph.>> Truly God is good to Israel, to such as are of a pure heart.

title: Psalms 73:2
text: But as for me, my feet were almost gone, my steps had well nigh slipped;

title: Psalms 73:3
text: For I was envious at the arrogant, seeing the prosperity of the wicked.

title: Psalms 73:4
text: For they have no pangs in their death, and their body is well nourished;

title: Psalms 73:5
text: They have not the hardships of mankind, neither are they plagued like [other] men:

title: Psalms 73:6
text: Therefore pride encompasseth them as a neck-chain, violence covereth them [as] a garment;

title: Psalms 73:7
text: Their eyes stand out from fatness, they exceed the imaginations of their heart:

title: Psalms 73:8
text: They mock and speak wickedly of oppression, they speak loftily:

title: Psalms 73:9
text: They set their mouth in the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

title: Psalms 73:10
text: Therefore his people turn hither, and waters in fulness are wrung out to them.

title: Psalms 73:11
text: And they say, How can *God know, and is there knowledge in the Most High?

title: Psalms 73:12
text: Behold, these are the wicked, and they prosper in the world: they heap up riches.

title: Psalms 73:13
text: Truly have I purified my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency:

title: Psalms 73:14
text: For all the day have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

title: Psalms 73:15
text: ¶If I said, I will speak thus, behold, I should be faithless to the generation of thy children.

title: Psalms 73:16
text: When I thought to be able to know this, it was a grievous task in mine eyes;

title: Psalms 73:17
text: Until I went into the sanctuaries of *God; [then] understood I their end.

title: Psalms 73:18
text: Truly thou settest them in slippery places, thou castest them down in ruins.

title: Psalms 73:19
text: How are they suddenly made desolate! they pass away, consumed with terrors.

title: Psalms 73:20
text: As a dream, when one awaketh, wilt thou, Lord, on arising despise their image.

title: Psalms 73:21
text: ¶When my heart was in a ferment, and I was pricked in my reins,

title: Psalms 73:22
text: Then I was brutish and knew nothing; I was [as] a beast with thee.

title: Psalms 73:23
text: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden my right hand;

title: Psalms 73:24
text: Thou wilt guide me by thy counsel, and after the glory, thou wilt receive me.

title: Psalms 73:25
text: Whom have I in the heavens? and there is none upon earth I desire beside thee.

title: Psalms 73:26
text: My flesh and my heart faileth: God is the rock of my heart and my portion for ever.

title: Psalms 73:27
text: For behold, they that are far from thee shall perish; thou destroyest every one that goeth a whoring from thee.

title: Psalms 73:28
text: But as for me, it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord Jehovah, that I may declare all thy works.

title: Psalms 74:1
text: ¶<<An instruction: of Asaph.>> Why, O God, hast thou cast off for ever? [why] doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

title: Psalms 74:2
text: Remember thine assembly, which thou hast purchased of old, which thou hast redeemed [to be] the portion of thine inheritance, this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

title: Psalms 74:3
text: Lift up thy steps unto the perpetual desolations: everything in the sanctuary hath the enemy destroyed.

title: Psalms 74:4
text: Thine adversaries roar in the midst of thy place of assembly; they set up their signs [for] signs.

title: Psalms 74:5
text: [A man] was known as he could lift up axes in the thicket of trees;

title: Psalms 74:6
text: And now they break down its carved work altogether, with hatchets and hammers.

title: Psalms 74:7
text: They have set on fire thy sanctuary, they have profaned the habitation of thy name to the ground.

title: Psalms 74:8
text: They said in their heart, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all *God's places of assembly in the land.

title: Psalms 74:9
text: We see not our signs; there is no more any prophet, neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

title: Psalms 74:10
text: How long, O God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy contemn thy name for ever?

title: Psalms 74:11
text: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, and thy right hand? [pluck it] out of thy bosom: consume [them].

title: Psalms 74:12
text: ¶But God is my king of old, accomplishing deliverances in the midst of the earth.

title: Psalms 74:13
text: *Thou* didst divide the sea by thy strength; thou didst break the heads of the monsters on the waters:

title: Psalms 74:14
text: *Thou* didst break in pieces the heads of leviathan, thou gavest him to be meat to those that people the desert.

title: Psalms 74:15
text: *Thou* didst cleave fountain and torrent, *thou* driedst up ever-flowing rivers.

title: Psalms 74:16
text: The day is thine, the night also is thine; *thou* hast prepared the moon and the sun:

title: Psalms 74:17
text: *Thou* hast set all the borders of the earth; summer and winter--*thou* didst form them.

title: Psalms 74:18
text: ¶Remember this, that an enemy hath reproached Jehovah, and a foolish people have contemned thy name.

title: Psalms 74:19
text: Give not up the soul of thy turtle-dove unto the wild beast; forget not the troop of thine afflicted for ever.

title: Psalms 74:20
text: Have respect unto the covenant; for the dark places of the earth are full of the dwellings of violence.

title: Psalms 74:21
text: Oh let not the oppressed one return ashamed; let the afflicted and needy praise thy name.

title: Psalms 74:22
text: Rise up, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee all the day;

title: Psalms 74:23
text: Forget not the voice of thine adversaries: the tumult of those that rise up against thee ascendeth continually.

title: Psalms 75:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. 'Destroy not.' A Psalm of Asaph: a Song.>> Unto thee we give thanks, O God, we give thanks; and thy name is near: thy marvellous works declare it.

title: Psalms 75:2
text: When I shall receive the assembly, I will judge with equity.

title: Psalms 75:3
text: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I have established its pillars. Selah.

title: Psalms 75:4
text: I said unto the boastful, Boast not; and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

title: Psalms 75:5
text: Lift not up your horn on high; speak not arrogantly with a [stiff] neck.

title: Psalms 75:6
text: ¶For not from the east nor from the west, nor yet from the south doth exaltation [come]:

title: Psalms 75:7
text: For God is the judge; he putteth down one and exalteth another.

title: Psalms 75:8
text: For in the hand of Jehovah there is a cup, and it foameth with wine, it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same; yea, the dregs thereof shall all the wicked of the earth drain off, [and] drink.

title: Psalms 75:9
text: But as for me, I will declare for ever; I will sing psalms to the God of Jacob.

title: Psalms 75:10
text: And all the horns of the wicked will I cut off; [but] the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

title: Psalms 76:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph: a Song.>> In Judah is God known, his name is great in Israel;

title: Psalms 76:2
text: And in Salem is his tent, and his dwelling-place in Zion.

title: Psalms 76:3
text: There broke he the flashings of the bow, shield and sword and battle. Selah.

title: Psalms 76:4
text: More glorious art thou, more excellent, than the mountains of prey.

title: Psalms 76:5
text: The stout-hearted are made a spoil, they have slept their sleep; and none of the men of might have found their hands.

title: Psalms 76:6
text: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

title: Psalms 76:7
text: ¶Thou, thou art to be feared, and who can stand before thee when once thou art angry?

title: Psalms 76:8
text: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from the heavens; the earth feared, and was still,

title: Psalms 76:9
text: When God rose up to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

title: Psalms 76:10
text: For the fury of man shall praise thee; the remainder of fury wilt thou gird on thyself.
