title: Psalms 76:11
text: Vow and pay unto Jehovah your God: let all that are round about him bring presents unto him that is to be feared.

title: Psalms 76:12
text: He cutteth off the spirit of princes; [he] is terrible to the kings of the earth.

title: Psalms 77:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On Jeduthun. Of Asaph. A Psalm.>> My voice is unto God, and I will cry; my voice is unto God, and he will give ear unto me.

title: Psalms 77:2
text: In the day of my trouble, I sought the Lord: my hand was stretched out in the night, and slacked not; my soul refused to be comforted.

title: Psalms 77:3
text: I remembered God, and I moaned; I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

title: Psalms 77:4
text: Thou holdest open mine eyelids; I am full of disquiet and cannot speak.

title: Psalms 77:5
text: I consider the days of old, the years of ancient times.

title: Psalms 77:6
text: I remember my song in the night; I muse in mine own heart, and my spirit maketh diligent search.

title: Psalms 77:7
text: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

title: Psalms 77:8
text: Hath his loving-kindness ceased for ever? hath [his] word come to an end from generation to generation?

title: Psalms 77:9
text: Hath *God forgotten to be gracious? or hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

title: Psalms 77:10
text: Then said I, This is my weakness: --the years of the right hand of the Most High

title: Psalms 77:11
text: ¶Will I remember, --the works of Jah; for I will remember thy wonders of old,

title: Psalms 77:12
text: And I will meditate upon all thy work, and muse upon thy doings.

title: Psalms 77:13
text: O God, thy way is in the sanctuary: who is so great a *god as God?

title: Psalms 77:14
text: Thou art the *God that doest wonders; thou hast declared thy strength among the peoples.

title: Psalms 77:15
text: Thou hast with [thine] arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

title: Psalms 77:16
text: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they trembled, yea, the depths were troubled:

title: Psalms 77:17
text: The thick clouds poured out water; the skies sent out a sound, yea, thine arrows went abroad:

title: Psalms 77:18
text: The voice of thy thunder was in the whirlwind, lightnings lit up the world; the earth was troubled and it quaked.

title: Psalms 77:19
text: Thy way is in the sea, and thy paths are in the great waters; and thy footsteps are not known.

title: Psalms 77:20
text: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

title: Psalms 78:1
text: ¶<<An instruction. Of Asaph.>> Give ear, O my people, to my law; incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

title: Psalms 78:2
text: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter riddles from of old,

title: Psalms 78:3
text: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us:

title: Psalms 78:4
text: We will not hide [them] from their sons, shewing forth to the generation to come the praises of Jehovah, and his strength, and his marvellous works which he hath done.

title: Psalms 78:5
text: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

title: Psalms 78:6
text: That the generation to come might know [them], the children that should be born; that they might rise up and tell [them] to their children,

title: Psalms 78:7
text: And that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of *God, but observe his commandments;

title: Psalms 78:8
text: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that prepared not their heart, and whose spirit was not stedfast with *God.

title: Psalms 78:9
text: ¶The sons of Ephraim, armed bowmen, turned back in the day of battle.

title: Psalms 78:10
text: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

title: Psalms 78:11
text: And forgot his doings, and his marvellous works which he had shewn them.

title: Psalms 78:12
text: In the sight of their fathers had he done wonders, in the land of Egypt, the field of Zoan.

title: Psalms 78:13
text: He clave the sea, and caused them to pass through; and made the waters to stand as a heap;

title: Psalms 78:14
text: And he led them with a cloud in the daytime, and all the night with the light of fire.

title: Psalms 78:15
text: He clave rocks in the wilderness, and gave [them] drink as out of the depths, abundantly;

title: Psalms 78:16
text: And he brought streams out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

title: Psalms 78:17
text: Yet they still went on sinning against him, provoking the Most High in the desert;

title: Psalms 78:18
text: And they tempted *God in their heart, by asking meat for their lust;

title: Psalms 78:19
text: And they spoke against God: they said, Is *God able to prepare a table in the wilderness?

title: Psalms 78:20
text: Behold, he smote the rock, and waters gushed out, and streams overflowed; is he able to give bread also, or provide flesh for his people?

title: Psalms 78:21
text: Therefore Jehovah heard, and was wroth; and fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also went up against Israel:

title: Psalms 78:22
text: Because they believed not in God, and confided not in his salvation;

title: Psalms 78:23
text: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and had opened the doors of the heavens,

title: Psalms 78:24
text: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them the corn of the heavens.

title: Psalms 78:25
text: Man did eat the bread of the mighty; he sent them provision to the full.

title: Psalms 78:26
text: He caused the east wind to rise in the heavens, and by his strength he brought the south wind;

title: Psalms 78:27
text: And he rained flesh upon them as dust, and feathered fowl as the sand of the seas,

title: Psalms 78:28
text: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations:

title: Psalms 78:29
text: And they did eat, and were well filled; for that they lusted after, he brought to them.

title: Psalms 78:30
text: They were not alienated from their lust, their meat was yet in their mouths,

title: Psalms 78:31
text: When the anger of God went up against them; and he slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.

title: Psalms 78:32
text: For all this, they sinned still, and believed not in his marvellous works;

title: Psalms 78:33
text: And he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

title: Psalms 78:34
text: When he slew them, then they sought him, and returned and sought early after *God;

title: Psalms 78:35
text: And they remembered that God was their rock, and *God, the Most High, their redeemer.

title: Psalms 78:36
text: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied unto him with their tongue;

title: Psalms 78:37
text: For their heart was not firm toward him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

title: Psalms 78:38
text: But he was merciful: he forgave the iniquity, and destroyed [them] not; but many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his fury:

title: Psalms 78:39
text: And he remembered that they were flesh, a breath that passeth away and cometh not again.

title: Psalms 78:40
text: ¶How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

title: Psalms 78:41
text: And they turned again and tempted *God, and grieved the Holy One of Israel.

title: Psalms 78:42
text: They remembered not his hand, the day when he delivered them from the oppressor,

title: Psalms 78:43
text: How he set his signs in Egypt, and his miracles in the field of Zoan;

title: Psalms 78:44
text: And turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, that they could not drink;

title: Psalms 78:45
text: He sent dog-flies among them, which devoured them, and frogs, which destroyed them;

title: Psalms 78:46
text: And he gave their increase unto the caterpillar, and their labour unto the locust;

title: Psalms 78:47
text: He killed their vines with hail, and their sycamore trees with hail-stones;

title: Psalms 78:48
text: And he delivered up their cattle to the hail, and their flocks to thunderbolts.

title: Psalms 78:49
text: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and distress, --a mission of angels of woes.

title: Psalms 78:50
text: He made a way for his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;

title: Psalms 78:51
text: And he smote all the firstborn in Egypt, the first-fruits of their vigour in the tents of Ham.

title: Psalms 78:52
text: And he made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock;

title: Psalms 78:53
text: And he led them safely, so that they were without fear; and the sea covered their enemies.

title: Psalms 78:54
text: And he brought them to his holy border, this mountain, which his right hand purchased;

title: Psalms 78:55
text: And he drove out the nations before them, and allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

title: Psalms 78:56
text: But they tempted and provoked God, the Most High, and kept not his testimonies,

title: Psalms 78:57
text: And they drew back and dealt treacherously like their fathers: they turned like a deceitful bow.

title: Psalms 78:58
text: And they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

title: Psalms 78:59
text: God heard, and was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

title: Psalms 78:60
text: And he forsook the tabernacle at Shiloh, the tent where he had dwelt among men,

title: Psalms 78:61
text: And gave his strength into captivity, and his glory into the hand of the oppressor;

title: Psalms 78:62
text: And delivered up his people unto the sword, and was very wroth with his inheritance:

title: Psalms 78:63
text: The fire consumed their young men, and their maidens were not praised in [nuptial] song;

title: Psalms 78:64
text: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows made no lamentation.

title: Psalms 78:65
text: Then the Lord awoke as one out of sleep, like a mighty man that shouteth aloud by reason of wine;

title: Psalms 78:66
text: And he smote his adversaries in the hinder part, and put them to everlasting reproach.

title: Psalms 78:67
text: And he rejected the tent of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim,

title: Psalms 78:68
text: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved;

title: Psalms 78:69
text: And he built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he hath founded for ever.

title: Psalms 78:70
text: And he chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

title: Psalms 78:71
text: From following the suckling-ewes, he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

title: Psalms 78:72
text: And he fed them according to the integrity of his heart, and led them by the skilfulness of his hands.

title: Psalms 79:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of Asaph.>> O God, the nations are come into thine inheritance: thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

title: Psalms 79:2
text: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowl of the heavens, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth:

title: Psalms 79:3
text: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem, and there was none to bury [them].

title: Psalms 79:4
text: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a mockery and a derision to them that are round about us.

title: Psalms 79:5
text: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou be angry for ever? Shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

title: Psalms 79:6
text: ¶Pour out thy fury upon the nations that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that call not upon thy name:

title: Psalms 79:7
text: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his habitation.

title: Psalms 79:8
text: Remember not against us the iniquities of [our] forefathers; let thy tender mercies speedily come to meet us: for we are brought very low.

title: Psalms 79:9
text: Help us, O God of our salvation, because of the glory of thy name; and deliver us, and forgive our sins, for thy name's sake.

title: Psalms 79:10
text: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is their God? Let the avenging of the blood of thy servants that is shed be known among the nations in our sight.

title: Psalms 79:11
text: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thine arm, preserve those that are appointed to die;

title: Psalms 79:12
text: And render unto our neighbours, sevenfold into their bosom, their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

title: Psalms 79:13
text: And we, thy people and the sheep of thy pasture, will give thanks unto thee for ever; we will shew forth thy praise from generation to generation.

title: Psalms 80:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On Shoshannim-Eduth. Of Asaph. A Psalm.>> Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that sittest [between] the cherubim, shine forth.

title: Psalms 80:2
text: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up thy strength, and come to our deliverance.

title: Psalms 80:3
text: O God, restore us; and cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

title: Psalms 80:4
text: Jehovah, God of hosts, how long will thine anger smoke against the prayer of thy people?

title: Psalms 80:5
text: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure:

title: Psalms 80:6
text: Thou hast made us a strife unto our neighbours, and our enemies mock among themselves.

title: Psalms 80:7
text: Restore us, O God of hosts; and cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

title: Psalms 80:8
text: ¶Thou broughtest a vine out of Egypt; thou didst cast out the nations, and plant it:

title: Psalms 80:9
text: Thou preparedst space before it, and it took deep root, and filled the land;

title: Psalms 80:10
text: The mountains were covered with its shadow, and the branches thereof were [like] cedars of *God;

title: Psalms 80:11
text: It sent out its boughs unto the sea, and its shoots unto the river.

title: Psalms 80:12
text: Why hast thou broken down its fences, so that all who pass by the way do pluck it?

title: Psalms 80:13
text: The boar out of the forest doth waste it, and the beast of the field doth feed off it.

title: Psalms 80:14
text: O God of hosts, return, we beseech thee; look down from the heavens, and behold, and visit this vine;

title: Psalms 80:15
text: Even the stock which thy right hand hath planted, and the young plant thou madest strong for thyself.

title: Psalms 80:16
text: It is burned with fire, it is cut down; they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

title: Psalms 80:17
text: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou hast made strong for thyself.

title: Psalms 80:18
text: So will we not go back from thee. Revive us, and we will call upon thy name.

title: Psalms 80:19
text: Restore us, O Jehovah, God of hosts; cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

title: Psalms 81:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon the Gittith. [A Psalm] of Asaph.>> Sing ye joyously unto God our strength, shout aloud unto the God of Jacob;

title: Psalms 81:2
text: Raise a song, and sound the tambour, the pleasant harp with the lute.

title: Psalms 81:3
text: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, at the set time, on our feast day:

title: Psalms 81:4
text: For this is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob;

title: Psalms 81:5
text: He ordained it in Joseph [for] a testimony, when he went forth over the land of Egypt, [where] I heard a language that I knew not.

title: Psalms 81:6
text: I removed his shoulder from the burden; his hands were freed from the basket.

title: Psalms 81:7
text: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

title: Psalms 81:8
text: ¶Hear, my people, and I will testify unto thee; O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto me!

title: Psalms 81:9
text: There shall no strange *god be in thee, neither shalt thou worship any foreign *god.

title: Psalms 81:10
text: I am Jehovah thy God, that brought thee up out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

title: Psalms 81:11
text: But my people hearkened not to my voice, and Israel would none of me.

title: Psalms 81:12
text: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' stubbornness: they walked after their own counsels.

title: Psalms 81:13
text: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, that Israel had walked in my ways!

title: Psalms 81:14
text: I would soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

title: Psalms 81:15
text: The haters of Jehovah would have come cringing unto him; but their time would have been for ever.

title: Psalms 81:16
text: And he would have fed them with the finest of wheat; yea, with honey out of the rock would I have satisfied thee.

title: Psalms 82:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of Asaph.>> God standeth in the assembly of *God, he judgeth among the gods.

title: Psalms 82:2
text: How long will ye judge unrighteously, and accept the person of the wicked? Selah.

title: Psalms 82:3
text: Judge the poor and the fatherless, do justice to the afflicted and the destitute;

title: Psalms 82:4
text: Rescue the poor and needy, deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.

title: Psalms 82:5
text: They know not, neither do they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are moved.

title: Psalms 82:6
text: ¶I have said, Ye are gods, and all of you are children of the Most High;

title: Psalms 82:7
text: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

title: Psalms 82:8
text: Arise, O God, judge the earth; for *thou* shalt inherit all the nations.

title: Psalms 83:1
text: ¶<<A Song; a Psalm of Asaph.>> O God, keep not silence; hold not thy peace, and be not still, O *God:

title: Psalms 83:2
text: For behold, thine enemies make a tumult; and they that hate thee lift up the head.

title: Psalms 83:3
text: They take crafty counsel against thy people, and consult against thy hidden ones:

title: Psalms 83:4
text: They say, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation, and let the name of Israel be mentioned no more.

title: Psalms 83:5
text: For they have consulted together with one heart: they have made an alliance together against thee.

title: Psalms 83:6
text: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagarites;

title: Psalms 83:7
text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia, with the inhabitants of Tyre;

title: Psalms 83:8
text: Asshur also is joined with them: they are an arm to the sons of Lot. Selah.

title: Psalms 83:9
text: ¶Do unto them as to Midian; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the torrent of Kishon:

title: Psalms 83:10
text: Who were destroyed at Endor; they became as dung for the ground.

title: Psalms 83:11
text: Make their nobles as Oreb and as Zeeb; and all their chiefs as Zebah and as Zalmunna.

title: Psalms 83:12
text: For they have said, Let us take to ourselves God's dwelling-places in possession.

title: Psalms 83:13
text: O my God, make them like a whirling thing, like stubble before the wind.

title: Psalms 83:14
text: As fire burneth a forest, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire,

title: Psalms 83:15
text: So pursue them with thy tempest, and terrify them with thy whirlwind.

title: Psalms 83:16
text: Fill their faces with shame, that they may seek thy name, O Jehovah.

title: Psalms 83:17
text: Let them be put to shame and be dismayed for ever, and let them be confounded and perish:

title: Psalms 83:18
text: That they may know that thou alone, whose name is Jehovah, art the Most High over all the earth.

title: Psalms 84:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon the Gittith. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm.>> How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Jehovah of hosts!

title: Psalms 84:2
text: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of Jehovah; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living *God.

title: Psalms 84:3
text: Yea, the sparrow hath found a house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she layeth her young, thine altars, O Jehovah of hosts, my King and my God.

title: Psalms 84:4
text: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be constantly praising thee. Selah.

title: Psalms 84:5
text: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee, --they, in whose heart are the highways.

title: Psalms 84:6
text: Passing through the valley of Baca, they make it a well-spring; yea, the early rain covereth it with blessings.

title: Psalms 84:7
text: They go from strength to strength: [each one] will appear before God in Zion.

title: Psalms 84:8
text: ¶Jehovah, God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

title: Psalms 84:9
text: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

title: Psalms 84:10
text: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather stand at the threshold of the house of my God, than dwell in the tents of wickedness.

title: Psalms 84:11
text: For Jehovah Elohim is a sun and shield: Jehovah will give grace and glory; no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

title: Psalms 84:12
text: Jehovah of hosts, blessed is the man that confideth in thee!

title: Psalms 85:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm.>> Thou hast been favourable, Jehovah, unto thy land; thou hast turned the captivity of Jacob:

title: Psalms 85:2
text: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people; thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

title: Psalms 85:3
text: Thou hast withdrawn all thy wrath; thou hast turned from the fierceness of thine anger.

title: Psalms 85:4
text: Bring us back, O God of our salvation, and cause thine indignation toward us to cease.

title: Psalms 85:5
text: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger from generation to generation?

title: Psalms 85:6
text: Wilt thou not revive us again, that thy people may rejoice in thee?

title: Psalms 85:7
text: Shew us thy loving-kindness, O Jehovah, and grant us thy salvation.

title: Psalms 85:8
text: ¶I will hear what *God, Jehovah, will speak; for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his godly ones: but let them not turn again to folly.

title: Psalms 85:9
text: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

title: Psalms 85:10
text: Loving-kindness and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other:

title: Psalms 85:11
text: Truth shall spring out of the earth, and righteousness shall look down from the heavens.

title: Psalms 85:12
text: Jehovah also will give what is good, and our land shall yield its increase.

title: Psalms 85:13
text: Righteousness shall go before him, and shall set his footsteps on the way.

title: Psalms 86:1
text: ¶<<A Prayer of David.>> Incline thine ear, Jehovah, answer me; for I am afflicted and needy.

title: Psalms 86:2
text: Keep my soul, for I am godly; O thou my God, save thy servant who confideth in thee.

title: Psalms 86:3
text: Be gracious unto me, O Lord; for unto thee do I call all the day.

title: Psalms 86:4
text: Rejoice the soul of thy servant; for unto thee, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

title: Psalms 86:5
text: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive, and art of great loving-kindness unto all that call upon thee.

title: Psalms 86:6
text: Give ear, O Jehovah, unto my prayer, and attend to the voice of my supplications.

title: Psalms 86:7
text: In the day of my distress I will call upon thee, for thou wilt answer me.

title: Psalms 86:8
text: ¶Among the gods there is none like unto thee, Lord, and there is nothing like unto thy works.

title: Psalms 86:9
text: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord, and shall glorify thy name.

title: Psalms 86:10
text: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God, thou alone.

title: Psalms 86:11
text: Teach me thy way, Jehovah; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

title: Psalms 86:12
text: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart; and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

title: Psalms 86:13
text: For great is thy loving-kindness toward me, and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

title: Psalms 86:14
text: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assembly of the violent seek after my soul, and they have not set thee before them.

title: Psalms 86:15
text: But thou, Lord, art a *God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in goodness and truth.

title: Psalms 86:16
text: Turn toward me, and be gracious unto me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

title: Psalms 86:17
text: Shew me a token for good, that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed; for thou, Jehovah, hast helped me and comforted me.

title: Psalms 87:1
text: ¶<<Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm. A Song.>> His foundation is in the mountains of holiness.

title: Psalms 87:2
text: Jehovah loveth the gates of Zion more than all the habitations of Jacob.

title: Psalms 87:3
text: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

title: Psalms 87:4
text: ¶I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon among them that know me; behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia: this [man] was born there.

title: Psalms 87:5
text: And of Zion it shall be said, This one and that one was born in her; and the Most High himself shall establish her.

title: Psalms 87:6
text: Jehovah will count, when he inscribeth the peoples, This [man] was born there. Selah.

title: Psalms 87:7
text: As well the singers as the dancers [shall say], All my springs are in thee.

title: Psalms 88:1
text: ¶<<A Song, a Psalm for the sons of Korah. To the chief Musician. Upon Mahalath Leannoth. An instruction. Of Heman the Ezrahite.>> Jehovah, God of my salvation, I have cried by day [and] in the night before thee.

title: Psalms 88:2
text: Let my prayer come before thee; incline thine ear unto my cry.

title: Psalms 88:3
text: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draweth nigh to Sheol.

title: Psalms 88:4
text: I am reckoned with them that go down into the pit; I am as a man that hath no strength:

title: Psalms 88:5
text: Prostrate among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave; whom thou rememberest no more, and who are cut off from thy hand.

title: Psalms 88:6
text: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in dark places, in the deeps.

title: Psalms 88:7
text: Thy fury lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted [me] with all thy waves. Selah.

title: Psalms 88:8
text: Thou hast put my familiar friends far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

title: Psalms 88:9
text: Mine eye consumeth by reason of affliction. Upon thee, Jehovah, have I called every day; I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

title: Psalms 88:10
text: ¶Wilt thou do wonders to the dead? shall the shades arise and praise thee? Selah.

title: Psalms 88:11
text: Shall thy loving-kindness be declared in the grave? thy faithfulness in Destruction?

title: Psalms 88:12
text: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

title: Psalms 88:13
text: But as for me, Jehovah, I cry unto thee, and in the morning my prayer cometh before thee.

title: Psalms 88:14
text: Why, O Jehovah, castest thou off my soul? [why] hidest thou thy face from me?

title: Psalms 88:15
text: I am afflicted and expiring from my youth up; I suffer thy terrors, [and] I am distracted.

title: Psalms 88:16
text: Thy fierce anger hath gone over me; thy terrors have brought me to nought:

title: Psalms 88:17
text: They have surrounded me all the day like water; they have compassed me about together.

title: Psalms 88:18
text: Lover and associate hast thou put far from me: my familiar friends are darkness.

title: Psalms 89:1
text: ¶<<An instruction. Of Ethan the Ezrahite.>> I will sing of the loving-kindness of Jehovah for ever; with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness from generation to generation.

title: Psalms 89:2
text: For I said, Loving-kindness shall be built up for ever; in the very heavens wilt thou establish thy faithfulness.

title: Psalms 89:3
text: I have made a covenant with mine elect, I have sworn unto David my servant:

title: Psalms 89:4
text: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne from generation to generation. Selah.

title: Psalms 89:5
text: ¶And the heavens shall celebrate thy wonders, O Jehovah, and thy faithfulness in the congregation of the saints.

title: Psalms 89:6
text: For who in the heaven can be compared to Jehovah? [who] among the sons of the mighty shall be likened to Jehovah?

title: Psalms 89:7
text: *God is greatly to be feared in the council of the saints, and terrible for all that are round about him.

title: Psalms 89:8
text: Jehovah, God of hosts, who is like unto thee, the strong Jah? And thy faithfulness is round about thee.

title: Psalms 89:9
text: *Thou* rulest the pride of the sea: when its waves arise, *thou* stillest them.

title: Psalms 89:10
text: Thou hast crushed Rahab as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with the arm of thy strength.

title: Psalms 89:11
text: Thine are the heavens, the earth also is thine; the world and its fulness, *thou* hast founded them.

title: Psalms 89:12
text: The north and the south, *thou* hast created them: Tabor and Hermon triumph in thy name.

title: Psalms 89:13
text: Thine is the arm of might: strong is thy hand, high is thy right hand.

title: Psalms 89:14
text: Righteousness and judgment are the foundation of thy throne; loving-kindness and truth go before thy face.

title: Psalms 89:15
text: ¶Blessed is the people that know the shout of joy: they walk, O Jehovah, in the light of thy countenance.

title: Psalms 89:16
text: In thy name are they joyful all the day, and in thy righteousness are they exalted.

title: Psalms 89:17
text: For thou art the glory of their strength; and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

title: Psalms 89:18
text: For Jehovah is our shield, and the Holy One of Israel, our king.

title: Psalms 89:19
text: ¶Then thou spakest in vision of thy Holy One, and saidst, I have laid help upon a mighty one; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

title: Psalms 89:20
text: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

title: Psalms 89:21
text: With whom my hand shall be established; and mine arm shall strengthen him.

title: Psalms 89:22
text: No enemy shall exact upon him, nor the son of wickedness afflict him;

title: Psalms 89:23
text: But I will beat down his adversaries before his face, and will smite them that hate him.

title: Psalms 89:24
text: And my faithfulness and my loving-kindness shall be with him, and by my name shall his horn be exalted.

title: Psalms 89:25
text: And I will set his hand in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

title: Psalms 89:26
text: *He* shall call unto me, Thou art my father, my *God, and the rock of my salvation;

title: Psalms 89:27
text: And as to me, I will make him firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

title: Psalms 89:28
text: My loving-kindness will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him;

title: Psalms 89:29
text: And I will establish his seed for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

title: Psalms 89:30
text: If his sons forsake my law, and walk not in mine ordinances;

title: Psalms 89:31
text: If they profane my statutes, and keep not my commandments:

title: Psalms 89:32
text: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

title: Psalms 89:33
text: Nevertheless my loving-kindness will I not utterly take from him, nor belie my faithfulness;

title: Psalms 89:34
text: My covenant will I not profane, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

title: Psalms 89:35
text: Once have I sworn by my holiness; I will not lie unto David:

title: Psalms 89:36
text: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me;

title: Psalms 89:37
text: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and the witness in the sky is firm. Selah.

title: Psalms 89:38
text: ¶But thou hast rejected and cast off; thou hast been very wroth with thine anointed:

title: Psalms 89:39
text: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant; thou hast profaned his crown to the ground:

title: Psalms 89:40
text: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.

title: Psalms 89:41
text: All that pass by the way plunder him; he is become a reproach to his neighbours.

title: Psalms 89:42
text: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his oppressors; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice:

title: Psalms 89:43
text: Yea, thou hast turned back the edge of his sword, and hast not made him stand in the battle.

title: Psalms 89:44
text: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground;

title: Psalms 89:45
text: The days of his youth hast thou shortened; thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

title: Psalms 89:46
text: How long, Jehovah, wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy fury burn like fire?

title: Psalms 89:47
text: Remember, as regards me, what life is. Wherefore hast thou created all the children of men to be vanity?

title: Psalms 89:48
text: What man liveth, and shall not see death? Shall he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

title: Psalms 89:49
text: Where, Lord, are thy former loving-kindnesses, [which] thou swarest unto David in thy faithfulness?

title: Psalms 89:50
text: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants--that I bear in my bosom [that of] all the mighty peoples--

title: Psalms 89:51
text: Wherewith thine enemies, O Jehovah, have reproached, wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

title: Psalms 89:52
text: Blessed be Jehovah for evermore! Amen, and Amen.

title: Psalms 90:1
text: ¶<<A Prayer of Moses, the man of God.>> Lord, *thou* hast been our dwelling-place in all generations.

title: Psalms 90:2
text: Before the mountains were brought forth, and thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from eternity to eternity thou art *God.

title: Psalms 90:3
text: Thou makest [mortal] man to return to dust, and sayest, Return, children of men.

title: Psalms 90:4
text: For a thousand years, in thy sight, are as yesterday when it is past, and [as] a watch in the night.

title: Psalms 90:5
text: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are [as] a sleep: in the morning they are like grass [that] groweth up:

title: Psalms 90:6
text: In the morning it flourisheth and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down and withereth.

title: Psalms 90:7
text: ¶For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy fury are we troubled.

title: Psalms 90:8
text: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret [sins] in the light of thy countenance.

title: Psalms 90:9
text: For all our days pass away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a [passing] thought.

title: Psalms 90:10
text: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if, by reason of strength, they be fourscore years, yet their pride is labour and vanity, for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

title: Psalms 90:11
text: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? and thy wrath according to the fear of thee?

title: Psalms 90:12
text: ¶So teach [us] to number our days, that we may acquire a wise heart.

title: Psalms 90:13
text: Return, Jehovah: how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

title: Psalms 90:14
text: Satisfy us early with thy loving-kindness; that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

title: Psalms 90:15
text: Make us glad according to the days [wherein] thou hast afflicted us, according to the years [wherein] we have seen evil.

title: Psalms 90:16
text: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy majesty unto their sons.

title: Psalms 90:17
text: And let the beauty of Jehovah our God be upon us; and establish thou the work of our hands upon us: yea, the work of our hands, establish thou it.

title: Psalms 91:1
text: ¶He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

title: Psalms 91:2
text: I say of Jehovah, My refuge and my fortress; my God, I will confide in him.

title: Psalms 91:3
text: Surely *he* shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, [and] from the destructive pestilence.

title: Psalms 91:4
text: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou find refuge: his truth is a shield and buckler.

title: Psalms 91:5
text: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, for the arrow that flieth by day,

title: Psalms 91:6
text: For the pestilence that walketh in darkness, for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

title: Psalms 91:7
text: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; [but] it shall not come nigh thee.

title: Psalms 91:8
text: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, and see the reward of the wicked.

title: Psalms 91:9
text: ¶Because *thou* hast made Jehovah, my refuge, the Most High, thy dwelling-place,

title: Psalms 91:10
text: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.

title: Psalms 91:11
text: For he shall give his angels charge concerning thee, to keep thee in all thy ways:

title: Psalms 91:12
text: They shall bear thee up in [their] hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

title: Psalms 91:13
text: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and the adder; the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under foot.

title: Psalms 91:14
text: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him; I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

title: Psalms 91:15
text: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him and honour him.

title: Psalms 91:16
text: With length of days will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.

title: Psalms 92:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm, a Song, for the Sabbath day.>> It is good to give thanks unto Jehovah, and to sing psalms unto thy name, O Most High;

title: Psalms 92:2
text: To declare thy loving-kindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness in the nights,

title: Psalms 92:3
text: Upon an instrument of ten strings and upon the lute; upon the Higgaion with the harp.

title: Psalms 92:4
text: For thou, Jehovah, hast made me glad through thy work; I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

title: Psalms 92:5
text: Jehovah, how great are thy works! Thy thoughts are very deep:

title: Psalms 92:6
text: A brutish man knoweth not, neither doth a fool understand it.

title: Psalms 92:7
text: ¶When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity flourish, it is that they may be destroyed for ever.

title: Psalms 92:8
text: And thou, Jehovah, art on high for evermore.

title: Psalms 92:9
text: For lo, thine enemies, O Jehovah, for lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

title: Psalms 92:10
text: But my horn shalt thou exalt like a buffalo's: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

title: Psalms 92:11
text: And mine eye shall see [its desire] on mine enemies; mine ears shall hear [it] of the evil-doers that rise up against me.

title: Psalms 92:12
text: The righteous shall shoot forth like a palm-tree; he shall grow like a cedar on Lebanon.

title: Psalms 92:13
text: Those that are planted in the house of Jehovah shall flourish in the courts of our God:

title: Psalms 92:14
text: They are still vigorous in old age, they are full of sap and green;

title: Psalms 92:15
text: To shew that Jehovah is upright: [he is] my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

title: Psalms 93:1
text: ¶Jehovah reigneth, he hath clothed himself with majesty: Jehovah hath clothed himself, he hath girded himself with strength; yea, the world is established, it shall not be moved.

title: Psalms 93:2
text: Thy throne is established of old; thou art from eternity.

title: Psalms 93:3
text: The floods lifted up, O Jehovah, the floods lifted up their voice; the floods lifted up their roaring waves.

title: Psalms 93:4
text: Jehovah on high is mightier than the voices of many waters, than the mighty breakers of the sea.

title: Psalms 93:5
text: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for ever.

title: Psalms 94:1
text: ¶O *God of vengeances, Jehovah, *God of vengeances, shine forth;

title: Psalms 94:2
text: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth, render the reward to the proud.

title: Psalms 94:3
text: How long shall the wicked, O Jehovah, how long shall the wicked triumph?

title: Psalms 94:4
text: [How long] shall they utter [and] speak insolence--all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

title: Psalms 94:5
text: They crush thy people, O Jehovah, and afflict thine inheritance;

title: Psalms 94:6
text: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless,

title: Psalms 94:7
text: And say, Jah will not see, neither will the God of Jacob regard [it].

title: Psalms 94:8
text: Understand, ye brutish among the people; and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

title: Psalms 94:9
text: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? He that formed the eye, shall he not see?

title: Psalms 94:10
text: He that instructeth the nations, shall not he correct--he that teacheth man knowledge?

title: Psalms 94:11
text: Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

title: Psalms 94:12
text: ¶Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jah, and whom thou teachest out of thy law;

title: Psalms 94:13
text: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of evil, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

title: Psalms 94:14
text: For Jehovah will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance;

title: Psalms 94:15
text: For judgment shall return unto righteousness, and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

title: Psalms 94:16
text: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?

title: Psalms 94:17
text: If Jehovah had not been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

title: Psalms 94:18
text: When I said, My foot slippeth, thy loving-kindness, O Jehovah, held me up.

title: Psalms 94:19
text: In the multitude of my anxious thoughts within me thy comforts have delighted my soul.

title: Psalms 94:20
text: Shall the throne of wickedness be united to thee, which frameth mischief into a law?

title: Psalms 94:21
text: They band together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn innocent blood.

title: Psalms 94:22
text: But Jehovah will be my high tower; and my God the rock of my refuge.

title: Psalms 94:23
text: And he will bring upon them their iniquity, and will cut them off in their own evil: Jehovah our God will cut them off.

title: Psalms 95:1
text: ¶Come, let us sing aloud to Jehovah, let us shout for joy to the rock of our salvation;

title: Psalms 95:2
text: Let us come before his face with thanksgiving; let us shout aloud unto him with psalms.

title: Psalms 95:3
text: For Jehovah is a great *God, and a great king above all gods.

title: Psalms 95:4
text: In his hand are the deep places of the earth; the heights of the mountains are his also:

title: Psalms 95:5
text: The sea is his, and he made it, and his hands formed the dry [land].

title: Psalms 95:6
text: Come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker.

title: Psalms 95:7
text: ¶For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand. To-day if ye hear his voice,

title: Psalms 95:8
text: Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, as [in] the day of Massah, in the wilderness;

title: Psalms 95:9
text: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

title: Psalms 95:10
text: Forty years was I grieved with the generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways;

title: Psalms 95:11
text: So that I swore in mine anger, that they should not enter into my rest.

title: Psalms 96:1
text: ¶Sing ye unto Jehovah a new song: sing unto Jehovah, all the earth.

title: Psalms 96:2
text: Sing unto Jehovah, bless his name; publish his salvation from day to day.

title: Psalms 96:3
text: Declare his glory among the nations, his wondrous works among all the peoples.

title: Psalms 96:4
text: For Jehovah is great and exceedingly to be praised; he is terrible above all gods.

title: Psalms 96:5
text: For all the gods of the peoples are idols; but Jehovah made the heavens.

title: Psalms 96:6
text: Majesty and splendour are before him; strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

title: Psalms 96:7
text: Give unto Jehovah, ye families of peoples, give unto Jehovah glory and strength;

title: Psalms 96:8
text: Give unto Jehovah the glory of his name; bring an oblation and come into his courts;

title: Psalms 96:9
text: Worship Jehovah in holy splendour; tremble before him, all the earth.

title: Psalms 96:10
text: ¶Say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth! yea, the world is established, it shall not be moved; he will execute judgment upon the peoples with equity.

title: Psalms 96:11
text: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;

title: Psalms 96:12
text: Let the field exult and all that is therein. Then shall all the trees of the forest sing for joy,

title: Psalms 96:13
text: Before Jehovah, for he cometh; for he cometh to judge the earth: he will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples in his faithfulness.

title: Psalms 97:1
text: ¶Jehovah reigneth: let the earth be glad, let the many isles rejoice.

title: Psalms 97:2
text: Clouds and darkness are round about him; righteousness and judgment are the foundation of his throne.

title: Psalms 97:3
text: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his adversaries round about.

title: Psalms 97:4
text: His lightnings lightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

title: Psalms 97:5
text: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of Jehovah, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

title: Psalms 97:6
text: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the peoples see his glory.

title: Psalms 97:7
text: Ashamed be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols. Worship him, all ye gods.

title: Psalms 97:8
text: ¶Zion heard, and rejoiced; and the daughters of Judah were glad, because of thy judgments, O Jehovah.

title: Psalms 97:9
text: For thou, Jehovah, art the Most High above all the earth; thou art exalted exceedingly above all gods.

title: Psalms 97:10
text: Ye that love Jehovah, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints, he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

title: Psalms 97:11
text: Light is sown for the righteous, and joy for the upright in heart.

title: Psalms 97:12
text: Rejoice in Jehovah, ye righteous; and give thanks in remembrance of his holiness.

title: Psalms 98:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm.>> Sing ye unto Jehovah a new song: for he hath done wondrous things; his right hand and his holy arm hath wrought salvation for him.

title: Psalms 98:2
text: Jehovah hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the nations.

title: Psalms 98:3
text: He hath remembered his loving-kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

title: Psalms 98:4
text: ¶Shout aloud unto Jehovah, all the earth; break forth and shout for joy, and sing psalms.

title: Psalms 98:5
text: Sing psalms unto Jehovah with the harp: with the harp, and the voice of a song;

title: Psalms 98:6
text: With trumpets and sound of cornet, make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.

title: Psalms 98:7
text: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein;

title: Psalms 98:8
text: Let the floods clap [their] hands; let the mountains sing for joy together,

title: Psalms 98:9
text: Before Jehovah, for he cometh to judge the earth: he will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

title: Psalms 99:1
text: ¶Jehovah reigneth: let the peoples tremble. He sitteth [between the] cherubim: let the earth be moved.

title: Psalms 99:2
text: Jehovah is great in Zion, and he is high above all the peoples.

title: Psalms 99:3
text: They shall praise thy great and terrible name, --it is holy! --

title: Psalms 99:4
text: And the strength of the king that loveth justice. *Thou* hast established equity: it is thou that executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

title: Psalms 99:5
text: Exalt Jehovah our God, and worship at his footstool. He is holy!

title: Psalms 99:6
text: ¶Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name: they called unto Jehovah, and *he* answered them.

title: Psalms 99:7
text: He spoke unto them in the pillar of cloud: they kept his testimonies, and the statute that he gave them.

title: Psalms 99:8
text: Jehovah, our God, *thou* answeredst them: a forgiving *God wast thou unto them, though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.

title: Psalms 99:9
text: Exalt Jehovah our God, and worship at the hill of his holiness; for holy is Jehovah our God.

title: Psalms 100:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of thanksgiving.>> Shout aloud unto Jehovah, all the earth!

title: Psalms 100:2
text: Serve Jehovah with joy: come before his presence with exultation.

title: Psalms 100:3
text: Know that Jehovah is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; [we are] his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

title: Psalms 100:4
text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving [and] into his courts with praise; give thanks unto him, bless his name:

title: Psalms 100:5
text: For Jehovah is good; his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever; and his faithfulness from generation to generation.

title: Psalms 101:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> I will sing of loving-kindness and judgment: unto thee, Jehovah, will I sing psalms.

title: Psalms 101:2
text: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. When wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house in the integrity of my heart.

title: Psalms 101:3
text: I will set no thing of Belial before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

title: Psalms 101:4
text: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will not know evil.

title: Psalms 101:5
text: Whoso secretly slandereth his neighbour, him will I destroy; him that hath a high look and a proud heart will I not suffer.

title: Psalms 101:6
text: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

title: Psalms 101:7
text: He that practiseth deceit shall not dwell within my house; he that speaketh falsehoods shall not subsist in my sight.

title: Psalms 101:8
text: Every morning will I destroy all the wicked of the land: to cut off all workers of iniquity from the city of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 102:1
text: ¶<<A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before Jehovah.>> Jehovah, hear my prayer, and let my cry come unto thee.

title: Psalms 102:2
text: Hide not thy face from me: in the day of my trouble, incline thine ear unto me; in the day I call, answer me speedily.

title: Psalms 102:3
text: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as a firebrand.

title: Psalms 102:4
text: My heart is smitten and withered like grass; yea, I have forgotten to eat my bread.

title: Psalms 102:5
text: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones cleave to my flesh.

title: Psalms 102:6
text: I am become like the pelican of the wilderness, I am as an owl in desolate places;

title: Psalms 102:7
text: I watch, and am like a sparrow alone upon the housetop.

title: Psalms 102:8
text: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; they that are mad against me swear by me.

title: Psalms 102:9
text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

title: Psalms 102:10
text: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath; for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

title: Psalms 102:11
text: My days are like a lengthened-out shadow, and I, I am withered like grass.

title: Psalms 102:12
text: ¶But thou, Jehovah, abidest for ever, and thy memorial from generation to generation.

title: Psalms 102:13
text: *Thou* wilt rise up, thou wilt have mercy upon Zion: for it is the time to be gracious to her, for the set time is come.

title: Psalms 102:14
text: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour her dust.

title: Psalms 102:15
text: And the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

title: Psalms 102:16
text: When Jehovah shall build up Zion, he will appear in his glory.

title: Psalms 102:17
text: He will regard the prayer of the destitute one, and not despise their prayer.

title: Psalms 102:18
text: This shall be written for the generation to come; and a people that shall be created shall praise Jah:

title: Psalms 102:19
text: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from the heavens hath Jehovah beheld the earth,

title: Psalms 102:20
text: To hear the groaning of the prisoner, to loose those that are appointed to die;

title: Psalms 102:21
text: That the name of Jehovah may be declared in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

title: Psalms 102:22
text: When the peoples shall be gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.

title: Psalms 102:23
text: ¶He weakened my strength in the way, he shortened my days.

title: Psalms 102:24
text: I said, My *God, take me not away in the midst of my days! ...Thy years are from generation to generation.

title: Psalms 102:25
text: Of old hast thou founded the earth, and the heavens are the work of thy hands:

title: Psalms 102:26
text: *They* shall perish, but *thou* continuest; and all of them shall grow old as a garment: as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed.

title: Psalms 102:27
text: But thou art the Same, and thy years shall have no end.

title: Psalms 102:28
text: The children of thy servants shall abide, and their seed shall be established before thee.

title: Psalms 103:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Bless Jehovah, O my soul; and all that is within me, [bless] his holy name!

title: Psalms 103:2
text: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

title: Psalms 103:3
text: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities, who healeth all thy diseases;

title: Psalms 103:4
text: Who redeemeth thy life from the pit, who crowneth thee with loving-kindness and tender mercies;

title: Psalms 103:5
text: Who satisfieth thine old age with good [things]; thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.

title: Psalms 103:6
text: ¶Jehovah executeth righteousness and justice for all that are oppressed.

title: Psalms 103:7
text: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

title: Psalms 103:8
text: Jehovah is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving-kindness.

title: Psalms 103:9
text: He will not always chide, neither will he keep [his anger] for ever.

title: Psalms 103:10
text: He hath not dealt with us according to our sins, nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

title: Psalms 103:11
text: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving-kindness toward them that fear him.

title: Psalms 103:12
text: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

title: Psalms 103:13
text: As a father pitieth [his] children, so Jehovah pitieth them that fear him.

title: Psalms 103:14
text: For himself knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

title: Psalms 103:15
text: As for man, his days are as grass; as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth:

title: Psalms 103:16
text: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone, and the place thereof knoweth it no more.

title: Psalms 103:17
text: But the loving-kindness of Jehovah is from everlasting and to everlasting, upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children,

title: Psalms 103:18
text: To such as keep his covenant and to those that remember his precepts to do them.

title: Psalms 103:19
text: ¶Jehovah hath established his throne in the heavens, and his kingdom ruleth over all.

title: Psalms 103:20
text: Bless Jehovah, ye his angels, mighty in strength, that execute his word, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

title: Psalms 103:21
text: Bless Jehovah, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his that do his will.

title: Psalms 103:22
text: Bless Jehovah, all his works, in all places of his dominion. Bless Jehovah, O my soul!

title: Psalms 104:1
text: ¶Bless Jehovah, O my soul! Jehovah my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with majesty and splendour;

title: Psalms 104:2
text: Covering thyself with light as with a garment, stretching out the heavens like a tent-curtain; --

title: Psalms 104:3
text: Who layeth the beams of his upper chambers in the waters, who maketh clouds his chariot, who walketh upon the wings of the wind;

title: Psalms 104:4
text: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flame of fire.

title: Psalms 104:5
text: He laid the earth upon its foundations: it shall not be removed for ever.

title: Psalms 104:6
text: Thou hadst covered it with the deep, as with a vesture; the waters stood above the mountains:

title: Psalms 104:7
text: At thy rebuke they fled, at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away; --

title: Psalms 104:8
text: The mountains rose, the valleys sank, unto the place which thou hadst founded for them; --

title: Psalms 104:9
text: Thou hast set a bound which they may not pass over, that they turn not again to cover the earth.

title: Psalms 104:10
text: ¶He sendeth the springs into the valleys: they run among the mountains;

title: Psalms 104:11
text: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild asses quench their thirst.

title: Psalms 104:12
text: The birds of heaven dwell by them; they give forth their voice from among the branches.

title: Psalms 104:13
text: He watereth the mountains from his upper-chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

title: Psalms 104:14
text: He maketh the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man; bringing forth bread out of the earth,

title: Psalms 104:15
text: And wine which gladdeneth the heart of man; making [his] face shine with oil; and with bread he strengtheneth man's heart.

title: Psalms 104:16
text: The trees of Jehovah are satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted,

title: Psalms 104:17
text: Where the birds make their nests; [as for] the stork, the fir trees are her house.

title: Psalms 104:18
text: The high mountains are for the wild goats; the cliffs, a refuge for the rock-badgers.

title: Psalms 104:19
text: ¶He made the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth its going down.

title: Psalms 104:20
text: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, wherein all the beasts of the forest creep forth:

title: Psalms 104:21
text: The young lions roar after the prey, and to seek their food from *God.

title: Psalms 104:22
text: The sun ariseth, they retreat, and lay them down in their dens.

title: Psalms 104:23
text: Man goeth forth unto his work, and to his labour until the evening.

title: Psalms 104:24
text: How manifold are thy works, O Jehovah! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

title: Psalms 104:25
text: Yonder is the great and wide sea: therein are moving things innumerable, living creatures small and great.

title: Psalms 104:26
text: There go the ships; [there] that leviathan, which thou hast formed to play therein.

title: Psalms 104:27
text: These all look unto thee, that thou mayest give their food in its season:

title: Psalms 104:28
text: That thou givest unto them, they gather; thou openest thy hand, they are filled with good.

title: Psalms 104:29
text: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled; thou takest away their breath, they expire and return to their dust.

title: Psalms 104:30
text: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created, and thou renewest the face of the earth.

title: Psalms 104:31
text: ¶The glory of Jehovah will endure for ever; Jehovah will rejoice in his works.

title: Psalms 104:32
text: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; he toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

title: Psalms 104:33
text: I will sing unto Jehovah as long as I live; I will sing psalms to my God while I have my being.

title: Psalms 104:34
text: My meditation shall be pleasant unto him; I will rejoice in Jehovah.

title: Psalms 104:35
text: Sinners shall be consumed out of the earth, and the wicked shall be no more. Bless Jehovah, O my soul. Hallelujah!

title: Psalms 105:1
text: ¶Give ye thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; make known his acts among the peoples.

title: Psalms 105:2
text: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him; meditate upon all his wondrous works.

title: Psalms 105:3
text: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.

title: Psalms 105:4
text: Seek Jehovah and his strength, seek his face continually;

title: Psalms 105:5
text: Remember his wondrous works which he hath done, his miracles and the judgments of his mouth:

title: Psalms 105:6
text: Ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.

title: Psalms 105:7
text: He, Jehovah, is our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

title: Psalms 105:8
text: ¶He is ever mindful of his covenant, --the word which he commanded to a thousand generations, --

title: Psalms 105:9
text: Which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;

title: Psalms 105:10
text: And he confirmed it unto Jacob for a statute, unto Israel for an everlasting covenant,

title: Psalms 105:11
text: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

title: Psalms 105:12
text: When they were a few men in number, of small account, and strangers in it.

title: Psalms 105:13
text: And they went from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

title: Psalms 105:14
text: He suffered no man to oppress them, and reproved kings for their sakes,

title: Psalms 105:15
text: [Saying,] Touch not mine anointed ones, and do my prophets no harm.

title: Psalms 105:16
text: And he called for a famine upon the land; he broke the whole staff of bread.

title: Psalms 105:17
text: He sent a man before them: Joseph was sold for a bondman.

title: Psalms 105:18
text: They afflicted his feet with fetters; his soul came into irons;

title: Psalms 105:19
text: Until the time when what he said came about: the word of Jehovah tried him.

title: Psalms 105:20
text: The king sent and loosed him--the ruler of peoples--and let him go free.

title: Psalms 105:21
text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler over all his possessions:

title: Psalms 105:22
text: To bind his princes at his pleasure, and teach his elders wisdom.

title: Psalms 105:23
text: And Israel came into Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

title: Psalms 105:24
text: And he made his people exceeding fruitful, and made them mightier than their oppressors.

title: Psalms 105:25
text: ¶He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

title: Psalms 105:26
text: He sent Moses his servant, [and] Aaron whom he had chosen:

title: Psalms 105:27
text: They set his signs among them, and miracles in the land of Ham.

title: Psalms 105:28
text: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

title: Psalms 105:29
text: He turned their waters into blood, and caused their fish to die.

title: Psalms 105:30
text: Their land swarmed with frogs, --in the chambers of their kings.

title: Psalms 105:31
text: He spoke, and there came dog-flies, [and] gnats in all their borders.

title: Psalms 105:32
text: He gave them hail for rain, [and] flaming fire in their land;

title: Psalms 105:33
text: And he smote their vines and their fig-trees, and broke the trees of their borders.

title: Psalms 105:34
text: He spoke, and the locust came, and the cankerworm, even without number;

title: Psalms 105:35
text: And they devoured every herb in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

title: Psalms 105:36
text: And he smote every firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigour.

title: Psalms 105:37
text: And he brought them forth with silver and gold; and there was not one feeble among their tribes.

title: Psalms 105:38
text: Egypt rejoiced at their departure; for the fear of them had fallen upon them.

title: Psalms 105:39
text: He spread a cloud for a covering, and fire to give light in the night.

title: Psalms 105:40
text: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

title: Psalms 105:41
text: He opened the rock, and waters gushed forth; they ran in the dry places [like] a river.

title: Psalms 105:42
text: For he remembered his holy word, [and] Abraham his servant;

title: Psalms 105:43
text: And he brought forth his people with gladness, his chosen with rejoicing;

title: Psalms 105:44
text: And he gave them the lands of the nations, and they took possession of the labour of the peoples:

title: Psalms 105:45
text: That they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Hallelujah!

title: Psalms 106:1
text: ¶Hallelujah! Give ye thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 106:2
text: Who can utter the mighty acts of Jehovah? [who] can shew forth all his praise?

title: Psalms 106:3
text: Blessed are they that keep justice, [and] he that doeth righteousness at all times.

title: Psalms 106:4
text: Remember me, O Jehovah, with [thy] favour toward thy people; visit me with thy salvation:

title: Psalms 106:5
text: That I may see the prosperity of thy chosen ones, that I may rejoice in the joy of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

title: Psalms 106:6
text: ¶We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

title: Psalms 106:7
text: Our fathers in Egypt considered not thy wondrous works; they remembered not the multitude of thy loving-kindnesses; but they rebelled at the sea, at the Red Sea.

title: Psalms 106:8
text: Yet he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make known his might.

title: Psalms 106:9
text: And he rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; and he led them through the deeps as through a wilderness.

title: Psalms 106:10
text: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated [them], and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

title: Psalms 106:11
text: And the waters covered their oppressors: there was not one of them left.

title: Psalms 106:12
text: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

title: Psalms 106:13
text: ¶They soon forgot his works; they waited not for his counsel:

title: Psalms 106:14
text: And they lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted *God in the desert.

title: Psalms 106:15
text: Then he gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

title: Psalms 106:16
text: And they envied Moses in the camp, [and] Aaron, the saint of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 106:17
text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram;

title: Psalms 106:18
text: And fire was kindled in their company; a flame burned up the wicked.

title: Psalms 106:19
text: They made a calf in Horeb, and did homage to a molten image;

title: Psalms 106:20
text: And they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

title: Psalms 106:21
text: They forgot *God their Saviour, who had done great things in Egypt,

title: Psalms 106:22
text: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, terrible things by the Red Sea.

title: Psalms 106:23
text: And he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses, his chosen, stood before him in the breach, to turn away his fury, lest he should destroy [them].

title: Psalms 106:24
text: And they despised the pleasant land; they believed not his word,

title: Psalms 106:25
text: But murmured in their tents: they hearkened not unto the voice of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 106:26
text: And he lifted up his hand to them, that he would make them fall in the wilderness;

title: Psalms 106:27
text: And that he would make their seed fall among the nations, and disperse them through the countries.

title: Psalms 106:28
text: And they joined themselves unto Baal-Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead;

title: Psalms 106:29
text: And they provoked [him] to anger with their doings; and a plague broke out among them.

title: Psalms 106:30
text: Then stood up Phinehas and executed judgment, and the plague was stayed;

title: Psalms 106:31
text: And that was reckoned unto him for righteousness, from generation to generation, for evermore.

title: Psalms 106:32
text: And they moved him to wrath at the waters of Meribah, and it went ill with Moses on their account;

title: Psalms 106:33
text: For they provoked his spirit, so that he spoke unadvisedly with his lips.

title: Psalms 106:34
text: ¶They did not destroy the peoples, as Jehovah commanded them;

title: Psalms 106:35
text: But they mingled with the nations, and learned their works;

title: Psalms 106:36
text: And they served their idols; and they were a snare unto them:

title: Psalms 106:37
text: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,

title: Psalms 106:38
text: And shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; and the land was polluted with blood.

title: Psalms 106:39
text: And they were defiled with their works, and went a-whoring in their doings.

title: Psalms 106:40
text: Then was the anger of Jehovah kindled against his people, and he abhorred his inheritance;

title: Psalms 106:41
text: And he gave them into the hand of the nations; and they that hated them ruled over them:

title: Psalms 106:42
text: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

title: Psalms 106:43
text: Often did he deliver them; but as for them they provoked [him] by their counsel, and they were brought low by their iniquity.

title: Psalms 106:44
text: But he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry;

title: Psalms 106:45
text: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving-kindnesses;

title: Psalms 106:46
text: And he caused them to find compassion of all those that had carried them captives.

title: Psalms 106:47
text: Save us, Jehovah our God, and gather us from among the nations, to give thanks unto thy holy name, [and] to triumph in thy praise.

title: Psalms 106:48
text: Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel, from eternity and to eternity! And let all the people say, Amen! Hallelujah!

title: Psalms 107:1
text: ¶Give ye thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 107:2
text: Let the redeemed of Jehovah say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the oppressor,

title: Psalms 107:3
text: And gathered out of the countries, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the sea.

title: Psalms 107:4
text: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way, they found no city of habitation;

title: Psalms 107:5
text: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them:

title: Psalms 107:6
text: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, [and] he delivered them out of their distresses,

title: Psalms 107:7
text: And he led them forth by a right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

title: Psalms 107:8
text: Let them give thanks unto Jehovah for his loving-kindness, and for his wondrous works to the children of men;

title: Psalms 107:9
text: For he hath satisfied the longing soul and filled the hungry soul with good.

title: Psalms 107:10
text: ¶Such as inhabit darkness and the shadow of death, bound in affliction and iron,

title: Psalms 107:11
text: Because they had rebelled against the words of *God, and had despised the counsel of the Most High; ...

title: Psalms 107:12
text: And he bowed down their heart with labour; they stumbled, and there was none to help:

title: Psalms 107:13
text: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, [and] he saved them out of their distresses;

title: Psalms 107:14
text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke their bands in sunder.

title: Psalms 107:15
text: Let them give thanks unto Jehovah for his loving-kindness, and for his wondrous works to the children of men;

title: Psalms 107:16
text: For he hath broken the gates of bronze, and cut asunder the bars of iron.

title: Psalms 107:17
text: ¶Fools, because of their way of transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted;

title: Psalms 107:18
text: Their soul abhorreth all manner of food, and they draw near unto the gates of death:

title: Psalms 107:19
text: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, [and] he saveth them out of their distresses;

title: Psalms 107:20
text: He sendeth his word, and healeth them, and delivereth them from their destructions.

title: Psalms 107:21
text: Let them give thanks unto Jehovah for his loving-kindness, and for his wondrous works to the children of men,

title: Psalms 107:22
text: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works in joyful song.

title: Psalms 107:23
text: ¶They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters,

title: Psalms 107:24
text: These see the works of Jehovah, and his wonders in the deep.

title: Psalms 107:25
text: For he speaketh, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof:

title: Psalms 107:26
text: They mount up to the heavens, they go down to the depths; their soul is melted because of trouble;

title: Psalms 107:27
text: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and they are at their wits' end:

title: Psalms 107:28
text: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses;

title: Psalms 107:29
text: He maketh the storm a calm, and the waves thereof are still:

title: Psalms 107:30
text: And they rejoice because they are quiet; and he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

title: Psalms 107:31
text: Let them give thanks unto Jehovah for his loving-kindness, and for his wondrous works to the children of men;

title: Psalms 107:32
text: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the session of the elders.

title: Psalms 107:33
text: ¶He maketh rivers into a wilderness, and water-springs into dry ground;

title: Psalms 107:34
text: A fruitful land into a plain of salt, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

title: Psalms 107:35
text: He maketh the wilderness into a pool of water, and the dry land into water-springs;

title: Psalms 107:36
text: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, and they establish a city of habitation;

title: Psalms 107:37
text: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, which yield fruits of increase;

title: Psalms 107:38
text: And he blesseth them, so that they are multiplied greatly; and he suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

title: Psalms 107:39
text: And they are diminished and brought low, through oppression, adversity, and sorrow:

title: Psalms 107:40
text: He poureth contempt upon nobles, and causeth them to wander in a pathless waste;

title: Psalms 107:41
text: But he secureth the needy one on high from affliction, and maketh [him] families like flocks.

title: Psalms 107:42
text: The upright shall see it, and rejoice; and all unrighteousness shall stop its mouth.

title: Psalms 107:43
text: Whoso is wise, let him observe these things, and let them understand the loving-kindnesses of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 108:1
text: ¶<<A Song, a Psalm of David.>> My heart is fixed, O God: I will sing, yea, I will sing psalms, even [with] my glory.

title: Psalms 108:2
text: Awake, lute and harp: I will wake the dawn.

title: Psalms 108:3
text: I will give thee thanks among the peoples, O Jehovah; of thee will I sing psalms among the nations:

title: Psalms 108:4
text: For thy loving-kindness is great above the heavens, and thy truth is unto the clouds.

title: Psalms 108:5
text: Be thou exalted above the heavens, O God, and thy glory above all the earth.

title: Psalms 108:6
text: ¶That thy beloved ones may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.

title: Psalms 108:7
text: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

title: Psalms 108:8
text: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine, and Ephraim is the strength of my head; Judah is my law-giver;

title: Psalms 108:9
text: Moab is my wash-pot; upon Edom will I cast my sandal; over Philistia will I shout aloud.

title: Psalms 108:10
text: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me unto Edom?

title: Psalms 108:11
text: [Wilt] not [thou], O God, who didst cast us off? and didst not go forth, O God, with our armies?

title: Psalms 108:12
text: Give us help from trouble; for vain is man's deliverance.

title: Psalms 108:13
text: Through God we shall do valiantly; and he it is that will tread down our adversaries.

title: Psalms 109:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of David. A Psalm.>> O God of my praise, be not silent:

title: Psalms 109:2
text: For the mouth of the wicked [man] and the mouth of deceit are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue,

title: Psalms 109:3
text: And with words of hatred have they encompassed me; and they fight against me without a cause.

title: Psalms 109:4
text: For my love they are mine adversaries; but I [give myself unto] prayer.

title: Psalms 109:5
text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

title: Psalms 109:6
text: ¶Set a wicked [man] over him, and let [the] adversary stand at his right hand;

title: Psalms 109:7
text: When he shall be judged, let him go out guilty, and let his prayer become sin;

title: Psalms 109:8
text: Let his days be few, let another take his office;

title: Psalms 109:9
text: Let his sons be fatherless, and his wife a widow;

title: Psalms 109:10
text: Let his sons be vagabonds and beg, and let them seek [their bread] far from their desolate places;

title: Psalms 109:11
text: Let the usurer cast the net over all that he hath, and let strangers despoil his labour;

title: Psalms 109:12
text: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him, neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children;

title: Psalms 109:13
text: Let his posterity be cut off; in the generation following let their name be blotted out:

title: Psalms 109:14
text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah, and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out;

title: Psalms 109:15
text: Let them be before Jehovah continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth:

title: Psalms 109:16
text: Because he remembered not to shew kindness, but persecuted the afflicted and needy man, and the broken in heart, to slay him.

title: Psalms 109:17
text: And he loved cursing; so let it come unto him. And he delighted not in blessing; and let it be far from him.

title: Psalms 109:18
text: And he clothed himself with cursing like his vestment; so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones;

title: Psalms 109:19
