text: Let it be unto him as a garment with which he covereth himself, and for a girdle wherewith he is constantly girded.

title: Psalms 109:20
text: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from Jehovah, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

title: Psalms 109:21
text: ¶But do *thou* for me, Jehovah, Lord, for thy name's sake; because thy loving-kindness is good, deliver me:

title: Psalms 109:22
text: For I am afflicted and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

title: Psalms 109:23
text: I am gone like a shadow when it lengtheneth; I am tossed about like the locust;

title: Psalms 109:24
text: My knees are failing through fasting, and my flesh hath lost its fatness;

title: Psalms 109:25
text: And I am become a reproach unto them; [when] they look upon me they shake their heads.

title: Psalms 109:26
text: Help me, Jehovah my God; save me according to thy loving-kindness:

title: Psalms 109:27
text: That they may know that this is thy hand; that *thou*, Jehovah, hast done it.

title: Psalms 109:28
text: Let *them* curse, but bless *thou*; when they rise up, let them be ashamed, and let thy servant rejoice.

title: Psalms 109:29
text: Let mine adversaries be clothed with confusion, and let them cover themselves with their shame as with a mantle.

title: Psalms 109:30
text: I will greatly celebrate Jehovah with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

title: Psalms 109:31
text: For he standeth at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those that judge his soul.

title: Psalms 110:1
text: ¶<<Psalm of David.>> Jehovah said unto my Lord, Sit at my right hand, until I put thine enemies [as] footstool of thy feet.

title: Psalms 110:2
text: Jehovah shall send the sceptre of thy might out of Zion: rule in the midst of thine enemies.

title: Psalms 110:3
text: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in holy splendour: from the womb of the morning [shall come] to thee the dew of thy youth.

title: Psalms 110:4
text: Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art priest for ever after the order of Melchisedek.

title: Psalms 110:5
text: ¶The Lord at thy right hand will smite through kings in the day of his anger.

title: Psalms 110:6
text: He shall judge among the nations; he shall fill [all places] with dead bodies; he shall smite through the head over a great country.

title: Psalms 110:7
text: He shall drink of the brook in the way; therefore shall he lift up the head.

title: Psalms 111:1
text: ¶Hallelujah! I will celebrate Jehovah with [my] whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the assembly.

title: Psalms 111:2
text: Great are the works of Jehovah; sought out of all that delight in them.

title: Psalms 111:3
text: His work is majesty and splendour, and his righteousness abideth for ever.

title: Psalms 111:4
text: He hath made his wonders to be remembered: Jehovah is gracious and merciful.

title: Psalms 111:5
text: He hath given meat unto them that fear him; he is ever mindful of his covenant.

title: Psalms 111:6
text: ¶He hath shewn his people the power of his works, to give them the heritage of the nations.

title: Psalms 111:7
text: The works of his hands are truth and judgment; all his precepts are faithful:

title: Psalms 111:8
text: Maintained for ever and ever, done in truth and uprightness.

title: Psalms 111:9
text: He sent deliverance unto his people; he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and terrible is his name.

title: Psalms 111:10
text: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; a good understanding have all they that do [his precepts]: his praise abideth for ever.

title: Psalms 112:1
text: ¶Hallelujah! Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

title: Psalms 112:2
text: His seed shall be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

title: Psalms 112:3
text: Wealth and riches [shall be] in his house; and his righteousness abideth for ever.

title: Psalms 112:4
text: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness; he is gracious, and merciful, and righteous.

title: Psalms 112:5
text: It is well with the man that is gracious and lendeth; he will sustain his cause in judgment.

title: Psalms 112:6
text: ¶For he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

title: Psalms 112:7
text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings; his heart is fixed confiding in Jehovah;

title: Psalms 112:8
text: His heart is maintained, he is not afraid, until he see [his desire] upon his oppressors.

title: Psalms 112:9
text: He scattereth abroad, he giveth to the needy; his righteousness abideth for ever: his horn shall be exalted with honour.

title: Psalms 112:10
text: The wicked [man] shall see [it] and be vexed; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

title: Psalms 113:1
text: ¶Hallelujah! Praise, ye servants of Jehovah, praise the name of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 113:2
text: Blessed be the name of Jehovah, from this time forth and for evermore!

title: Psalms 113:3
text: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same, let Jehovah's name be praised.

title: Psalms 113:4
text: Jehovah is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

title: Psalms 113:5
text: Who is like unto Jehovah our God, who hath placed his dwelling on high;

title: Psalms 113:6
text: Who humbleth himself to look on the heavens and on the earth?

title: Psalms 113:7
text: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust; from the dung-hill he lifteth up the needy,

title: Psalms 113:8
text: To set [him] among nobles, among the nobles of his people.

title: Psalms 113:9
text: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, [as] a joyful mother of sons. Hallelujah!

title: Psalms 114:1
text: ¶When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language,

title: Psalms 114:2
text: Judah was his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

title: Psalms 114:3
text: The sea saw it and fled, the Jordan turned back;

title: Psalms 114:4
text: The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.

title: Psalms 114:5
text: What ailed thee, thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou turnedst back?

title: Psalms 114:6
text: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams? ye hills, like lambs?

title: Psalms 114:7
text: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the +God of Jacob,

title: Psalms 114:8
text: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

title: Psalms 115:1
text: ¶Not unto us, O Jehovah, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy loving-kindness and for thy truth's sake.

title: Psalms 115:2
text: Wherefore should the nations say, Where then is their God?

title: Psalms 115:3
text: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he pleased.

title: Psalms 115:4
text: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands:

title: Psalms 115:5
text: They have a mouth, and they speak not; eyes have they, and they see not;

title: Psalms 115:6
text: They have ears, and they hear not; a nose have they, and they smell not;

title: Psalms 115:7
text: They have hands, and they handle not; feet have they, and they walk not; they give no sound through their throat.

title: Psalms 115:8
text: They that make them are like unto them, --every one that confideth in them.

title: Psalms 115:9
text: ¶O Israel, confide thou in Jehovah: he is their help and their shield.

title: Psalms 115:10
text: House of Aaron, confide in Jehovah: he is their help and their shield.

title: Psalms 115:11
text: Ye that fear Jehovah, confide in Jehovah: he is their help and their shield.

title: Psalms 115:12
text: Jehovah hath been mindful of us: he will bless, he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron;

title: Psalms 115:13
text: He will bless them that fear Jehovah, both the small and the great.

title: Psalms 115:14
text: Jehovah will add unto you more, unto you and unto your children.

title: Psalms 115:15
text: Ye are blessed of Jehovah, who made the heavens and the earth.

title: Psalms 115:16
text: The heavens are the heavens of Jehovah, but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

title: Psalms 115:17
text: The dead praise not Jah, neither any that go down into silence;

title: Psalms 115:18
text: But *we* will bless Jah from this time forth and for evermore. Hallelujah!

title: Psalms 116:1
text: ¶I love Jehovah, for he hath heard my voice [and] my supplications;

title: Psalms 116:2
text: For he hath inclined his ear unto me, and I will call upon him during [all] my days.

title: Psalms 116:3
text: The bands of death encompassed me, and the anguish of Sheol took hold of me; I found trouble and sorrow:

title: Psalms 116:4
text: Then called I upon the name of Jehovah: I beseech thee, Jehovah, deliver my soul.

title: Psalms 116:5
text: Gracious is Jehovah and righteous; and our God is merciful.

title: Psalms 116:6
text: Jehovah keepeth the simple: I was brought low, and he saved me.

title: Psalms 116:7
text: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for Jehovah hath dealt bountifully with thee.

title: Psalms 116:8
text: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, my feet from falling.

title: Psalms 116:9
text: I will walk before Jehovah in the land of the living.

title: Psalms 116:10
text: ¶I believed, therefore have I spoken. As for me, I was greatly afflicted.

title: Psalms 116:11
text: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

title: Psalms 116:12
text: What shall I render unto Jehovah, [for] all his benefits toward me?

title: Psalms 116:13
text: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 116:14
text: I will perform my vows unto Jehovah, yea, before all his people.

title: Psalms 116:15
text: Precious in the sight of Jehovah is the death of his saints.

title: Psalms 116:16
text: Yea, Jehovah! for I am thy servant; I am thy servant, the son of thy handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

title: Psalms 116:17
text: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 116:18
text: I will perform my vows unto Jehovah, yea, before all his people,

title: Psalms 116:19
text: In the courts of Jehovah's house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!

title: Psalms 117:1
text: ¶Praise Jehovah, all ye nations; laud him, all ye peoples;

title: Psalms 117:2
text: For his loving-kindness is great toward us, and the truth of Jehovah [endureth] for ever. Hallelujah!

title: Psalms 118:1
text: ¶Give ye thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 118:2
text: Oh let Israel say, that his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 118:3
text: Oh let the house of Aaron say, that his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 118:4
text: Oh let them that fear Jehovah say, that his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 118:5
text: I called upon Jah in distress; Jah answered me [and set me] in a large place.

title: Psalms 118:6
text: Jehovah is for me, I will not fear; what can man do unto me?

title: Psalms 118:7
text: Jehovah is for me among them that help me; and I shall see [my desire] upon them that hate me.

title: Psalms 118:8
text: It is better to trust in Jehovah than to put confidence in man;

title: Psalms 118:9
text: It is better to trust in Jehovah than to put confidence in nobles.

title: Psalms 118:10
text: All nations encompassed me; but in the name of Jehovah have I destroyed them.

title: Psalms 118:11
text: They encompassed me, yea, encompassed me; but in the name of Jehovah have I destroyed them.

title: Psalms 118:12
text: They encompassed me like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of Jehovah have I destroyed them.

title: Psalms 118:13
text: Thou hast thrust hard at me that I might fall; but Jehovah helped me.

title: Psalms 118:14
text: My strength and song is Jah, and he is become my salvation.

title: Psalms 118:15
text: The voice of triumph and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: the right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly;

title: Psalms 118:16
text: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted, the right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.

title: Psalms 118:17
text: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of Jah.

title: Psalms 118:18
text: Jah hath chastened me sore; but he hath not given me over unto death.

title: Psalms 118:19
text: ¶Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will enter into them; Jah will I praise.

title: Psalms 118:20
text: This is the gate of Jehovah: the righteous shall enter therein.

title: Psalms 118:21
text: I will give thee thanks, for thou hast answered me, and art become my salvation.

title: Psalms 118:22
text: [The] stone which the builders rejected hath become the head of the corner:

title: Psalms 118:23
text: This is of Jehovah; it is wonderful in our eyes.

title: Psalms 118:24
text: This is the day that Jehovah hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

title: Psalms 118:25
text: Oh save, Jehovah, I beseech thee; Jehovah, I beseech thee, oh send prosperity!

title: Psalms 118:26
text: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of Jehovah. We have blessed you out of the house of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 118:27
text: Jehovah is *God, and he hath given us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, --up to the horns of the altar.

title: Psalms 118:28
text: Thou art my *God, and I will give thee thanks; my God, I will exalt thee.

title: Psalms 118:29
text: Give ye thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 119:1
text: ¶ALEPH. Blessed are the perfect in the way, who walk in the law of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 119:2
text: Blessed are they that observe his testimonies, that seek him with the whole heart;

title: Psalms 119:3
text: Who also do no unrighteousness: they walk in his ways.

title: Psalms 119:4
text: ¶Thou hast enjoined thy precepts, to be kept diligently.

title: Psalms 119:5
text: Oh that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

title: Psalms 119:6
text: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:7
text: ¶I will give thee thanks with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

title: Psalms 119:8
text: I will keep thy statutes: forsake me not utterly.

title: Psalms 119:9
text: ¶BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his path? by taking heed according to thy word.

title: Psalms 119:10
text: ¶With my whole heart have I sought thee: let me not wander from thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:11
text: ¶Thy *word have I hid in my heart, that I might not sin against thee.

title: Psalms 119:12
text: ¶Blessed art thou, Jehovah! teach me thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:13
text: ¶With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

title: Psalms 119:14
text: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as [much as] in all wealth.

title: Psalms 119:15
text: I will meditate upon thy precepts, and have respect unto thy paths.

title: Psalms 119:16
text: I delight myself in thy statutes; I will not forget thy word.

title: Psalms 119:17
text: ¶GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant [and] I shall live; and I will keep thy word.

title: Psalms 119:18
text: ¶Open mine eyes, and I shall behold wondrous things out of thy law.

title: Psalms 119:19
text: ¶I am a stranger in the land; hide not thy commandments from me.

title: Psalms 119:20
text: ¶My soul breaketh for longing after thy judgments at all times.

title: Psalms 119:21
text: ¶Thou hast rebuked the proud [that are] cursed, who wander from thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:22
text: ¶Roll off from me reproach and contempt; for I observe thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:23
text: ¶Princes also did sit [and] talk together against me: thy servant doth meditate in thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:24
text: ¶Thy testimonies also are my delight [and] my counsellors.

title: Psalms 119:25
text: ¶DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken me according to thy word.

title: Psalms 119:26
text: ¶I have declared my ways, and thou hast answered me: teach me thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:27
text: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts, and I will meditate upon thy wondrous works.

title: Psalms 119:28
text: ¶My soul melteth for sadness: strengthen me according to thy word.

title: Psalms 119:29
text: Remove from me the way of falsehood, and graciously grant me thy law.

title: Psalms 119:30
text: ¶I have chosen the way of faithfulness; thy judgments have I set [before me].

title: Psalms 119:31
text: I cleave unto thy testimonies; Jehovah, let me not be ashamed.

title: Psalms 119:32
text: I will run the way of thy commandments when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

title: Psalms 119:33
text: ¶HE. Teach me, O Jehovah, the way of thy statutes, and I will observe it [unto] the end.

title: Psalms 119:34
text: Give me understanding, and I will observe thy law; and I will keep it with [my] whole heart.

title: Psalms 119:35
text: ¶Make me to walk in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

title: Psalms 119:36
text: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to gain.

title: Psalms 119:37
text: ¶Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; quicken me in thy way.

title: Psalms 119:38
text: ¶Establish thy *word unto thy servant, who is [devoted] to thy fear.

title: Psalms 119:39
text: ¶Turn away my reproach which I fear; for thy judgments are good.

title: Psalms 119:40
text: ¶Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

title: Psalms 119:41
text: ¶VAU. And let thy loving-kindness come unto me, O Jehovah, --thy salvation according to thy *word.

title: Psalms 119:42
text: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me; for I confide in thy word.

title: Psalms 119:43
text: ¶And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; because I have hoped in thy judgments.

title: Psalms 119:44
text: Then will I keep thy law continually, for ever and ever;

title: Psalms 119:45
text: ¶And I will walk at liberty, for I have sought thy precepts;

title: Psalms 119:46
text: And I will speak of thy testimonies before kings, and will not be ashamed;

title: Psalms 119:47
text: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved;

title: Psalms 119:48
text: And I will lift up my hands unto thy commandments, which I have loved, and I will meditate in thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:49
text: ¶ZAIN. Remember the word for thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

title: Psalms 119:50
text: ¶This is my comfort in mine affliction; for thy *word hath quickened me.

title: Psalms 119:51
text: ¶The proud have derided me beyond measure: I have not declined from thy law.

title: Psalms 119:52
text: ¶I remembered thy judgments of old, O Jehovah, and have comforted myself.

title: Psalms 119:53
text: ¶Burning indignation hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked who forsake thy law.

title: Psalms 119:54
text: ¶Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

title: Psalms 119:55
text: ¶I have remembered thy name, O Jehovah, in the night, and have kept thy law.

title: Psalms 119:56
text: This I have had, because I have observed thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:57
text: ¶CHETH. My portion, O Jehovah, I have said, is to keep thy words.

title: Psalms 119:58
text: ¶I have sought thy favour with [my] whole heart: be gracious unto me according to thy *word.

title: Psalms 119:59
text: ¶I have thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:60
text: I have made haste, and not delayed, to keep thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:61
text: ¶The bands of the wicked have wrapped me round: I have not forgotten thy law.

title: Psalms 119:62
text: ¶At midnight I rise up to give thanks unto thee, because of thy righteous judgments.

title: Psalms 119:63
text: ¶I am the companion of all that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:64
text: ¶The earth, O Jehovah, is full of thy loving-kindness: teach me thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:65
text: ¶TETH. Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Jehovah, according to thy word.

title: Psalms 119:66
text: Teach me good discernment and knowledge; for I have believed in thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:67
text: ¶Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I keep thy *word.

title: Psalms 119:68
text: ¶Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:69
text: ¶The proud have forged falsehood against me: I will observe thy precepts with [my] whole heart.

title: Psalms 119:70
text: Their heart is as fat as grease: as for me, I delight in thy law.

title: Psalms 119:71
text: ¶It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I might learn thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:72
text: ¶The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

title: Psalms 119:73
text: ¶YOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, and I will learn thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:74
text: ¶They that fear thee will see me, and rejoice; because I have hoped in thy word.

title: Psalms 119:75
text: ¶I know, Jehovah, that thy Judgments are righteousness, and that in faithfulness thou hast afflicted me.

title: Psalms 119:76
text: ¶Oh let thy loving-kindness be for my comfort, according to thy *word unto thy servant.

title: Psalms 119:77
text: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; for thy law is my delight.

title: Psalms 119:78
text: ¶Let the proud be ashamed; for they have acted perversely towards me with falsehood: as for me, I meditate in thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:79
text: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that know thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:80
text: ¶Let my heart be perfect in thy statutes, that I be not ashamed.

title: Psalms 119:81
text: ¶CAPH. My soul fainteth for thy salvation; I hope in thy word.

title: Psalms 119:82
text: Mine eyes fail for thy *word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

title: Psalms 119:83
text: ¶For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; I do not forget thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:84
text: ¶How many shall be the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

title: Psalms 119:85
text: ¶The proud have digged pits for me, which is not according to thy law.

title: Psalms 119:86
text: All thy commandments are faithfulness. They persecute me wrongfully: help thou me.

title: Psalms 119:87
text: They had almost consumed me upon the earth; but as for me, I forsook not thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:88
text: ¶Quicken me according to thy loving-kindness, and I will keep the testimony of thy mouth.

title: Psalms 119:89
text: ¶LAMED. For ever, O Jehovah, thy word is settled in the heavens.

title: Psalms 119:90
text: Thy faithfulness is from generation to generation: thou hast established the earth, and it standeth.

title: Psalms 119:91
text: By thine ordinances they stand this day; for all things are thy servants.

title: Psalms 119:92
text: ¶Unless thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

title: Psalms 119:93
text: ¶I will never forget thy precepts; for by them thou hast quickened me.

title: Psalms 119:94
text: ¶I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:95
text: ¶The wicked have awaited me to destroy me; [but] I attend unto thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:96
text: ¶I have seen an end of all perfection: thy commandment is exceeding broad.

title: Psalms 119:97
text: ¶MEM. Oh how I love thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

title: Psalms 119:98
text: ¶Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies; for they are ever with me.

title: Psalms 119:99
text: I have more understanding than all my teachers; for thy testimonies are my meditation.

title: Psalms 119:100
text: I understand more than the aged, because I have observed thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:101
text: ¶I have refrained my feet from every evil path, that I might keep thy word.

title: Psalms 119:102
text: ¶I have not departed from thy judgments; for it is thou that hast taught me.

title: Psalms 119:103
text: ¶How sweet are thy *words unto my taste! more than honey to my mouth!

title: Psalms 119:104
text: From thy precepts I get understanding; therefore I hate every false path.

title: Psalms 119:105
text: ¶NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

title: Psalms 119:106
text: ¶I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

title: Psalms 119:107
text: ¶I am afflicted very much; O Jehovah, quicken me according to thy word.

title: Psalms 119:108
text: ¶Accept, I beseech thee, Jehovah, the voluntary-offerings of my mouth, and teach me thy judgments.

title: Psalms 119:109
text: ¶My life is continually in my hand; but I do not forget thy law.

title: Psalms 119:110
text: The wicked have laid a snare for me; but I have not wandered from thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:111
text: ¶Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

title: Psalms 119:112
text: I have inclined my heart to perform thy statutes for ever, unto the end.

title: Psalms 119:113
text: ¶SAMECH. The double-minded have I hated; but thy law do I love.

title: Psalms 119:114
text: ¶Thou art my hiding-place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

title: Psalms 119:115
text: ¶Depart from me, ye evil-doers; and I will observe the commandments of my God.

title: Psalms 119:116
text: ¶Uphold me according to thy *word, that I may live; and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

title: Psalms 119:117
text: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe; and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

title: Psalms 119:118
text: ¶Thou hast set at nought all them that wander from thy statutes; for their deceit is falsehood.

title: Psalms 119:119
text: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth [like] dross; therefore I love thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:120
text: My flesh shuddereth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

title: Psalms 119:121
text: ¶AIN. I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

title: Psalms 119:122
text: Be surety for thy servant for good; let not the proud oppress me.

title: Psalms 119:123
text: ¶Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the *word of thy righteousness.

title: Psalms 119:124
text: ¶Deal with thy servant according to thy loving-kindness, and teach me thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:125
text: I am thy servant; give me understanding that I may know thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:126
text: ¶It is time for Jehovah to work: they have made void thy law.

title: Psalms 119:127
text: ¶Therefore I love thy commandments above gold, yea, above fine gold.

title: Psalms 119:128
text: Therefore I regard all [thy] precepts concerning all things to be right: I hate every false path.

title: Psalms 119:129
text: ¶PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful; therefore doth my soul observe them.

title: Psalms 119:130
text: ¶The entrance of thy words giveth light, giving understanding unto the simple.

title: Psalms 119:131
text: ¶I opened my mouth wide and panted; for I longed for thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:132
text: ¶Turn unto me, and be gracious unto me, as thou art wont to do unto those that love thy name.

title: Psalms 119:133
text: ¶Establish my steps in thy *word; and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

title: Psalms 119:134
text: ¶Deliver me from the oppression of man; and I will keep thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:135
text: ¶Make thy face to shine upon thy servant, and teach me thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:136
text: ¶Mine eyes run down with streams of water, because they keep not thy law.

title: Psalms 119:137
text: ¶TZADE. Righteous art thou, Jehovah, and upright are thy judgments.

title: Psalms 119:138
text: Thou hast commanded thy testimonies in righteousness and exceeding faithfulness.

title: Psalms 119:139
text: ¶My zeal destroyeth me, because mine oppressors have forgotten thy words.

title: Psalms 119:140
text: ¶Thy *word is exceeding pure, and thy servant loveth it.

title: Psalms 119:141
text: ¶I am little and despised: thy precepts have I not forgotten.

title: Psalms 119:142
text: ¶Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is truth.

title: Psalms 119:143
text: ¶Trouble and anguish have taken hold upon me: thy commandments are my delights.

title: Psalms 119:144
text: The righteousness of thy testimonies is for ever: give me understanding, and I shall live.

title: Psalms 119:145
text: ¶KOPH. I have called with [my] whole heart; answer me, O Jehovah: I will observe thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:146
text: I call upon thee; save me, and I will keep thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:147
text: ¶I anticipate the morning-dawn and I cry: I hope in thy word.

title: Psalms 119:148
text: Mine eyes anticipate the night-watches, that I may meditate in thy *word.

title: Psalms 119:149
text: ¶Hear my voice according to thy loving-kindness: O Jehovah, quicken me according to thy judgment.

title: Psalms 119:150
text: ¶They have drawn nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

title: Psalms 119:151
text: Thou, Jehovah, art near, and all thy commandments are truth.

title: Psalms 119:152
text: ¶From thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

title: Psalms 119:153
text: ¶RESH. See mine affliction, and deliver me; for I have not forgotten thy law.

title: Psalms 119:154
text: Plead my cause, and redeem me: quicken me according to thy *word.

title: Psalms 119:155
text: ¶Salvation is far from the wicked; for they seek not thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:156
text: ¶Many are thy tender mercies, O Jehovah; quicken me according to thy judgments.

title: Psalms 119:157
text: ¶Many are my persecutors and mine oppressors; I have not declined from thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:158
text: ¶I beheld them that deal treacherously, and was grieved; because they kept not thy *word.

title: Psalms 119:159
text: ¶See how I have loved thy precepts: quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thy loving-kindness.

title: Psalms 119:160
text: ¶The sum of thy word is truth, and every righteous judgment of thine is for ever.

title: Psalms 119:161
text: ¶SHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause; but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

title: Psalms 119:162
text: ¶I have joy in thy *word, as one that findeth great spoil.

title: Psalms 119:163
text: ¶I hate and abhor falsehood; thy law do I love.

title: Psalms 119:164
text: ¶Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

title: Psalms 119:165
text: ¶Great peace have they that love thy law, and nothing doth stumble them.

title: Psalms 119:166
text: ¶I have hoped for thy salvation, O Jehovah, and have done thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:167
text: ¶My soul hath kept thy testimonies, and I love them exceedingly.

title: Psalms 119:168
text: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies; for all my ways are before thee.

title: Psalms 119:169
text: ¶TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, Jehovah: give me understanding according to thy word.

title: Psalms 119:170
text: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy *word.

title: Psalms 119:171
text: ¶My lips shall pour forth praise when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:172
text: ¶My tongue shall speak aloud of thy *word; for all thy commandments are righteousness.

title: Psalms 119:173
text: ¶Let thy hand be for my help; for I have chosen thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:174
text: I have longed for thy salvation, O Jehovah, and thy law is my delight.

title: Psalms 119:175
text: ¶Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

title: Psalms 119:176
text: ¶I have gone astray like a lost sheep: seek thy servant; for I have not forgotten thy commandments.

title: Psalms 120:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> In my trouble I called unto Jehovah, and he answered me.

title: Psalms 120:2
text: Jehovah, deliver my soul from the lying lip, from the deceitful tongue.

title: Psalms 120:3
text: What shall be given unto thee, what shall be added unto thee, thou deceitful tongue?

title: Psalms 120:4
text: Sharp arrows of a mighty one, with burning coals of broom-wood.

title: Psalms 120:5
text: ¶Woe is me, that I sojourn in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

title: Psalms 120:6
text: My soul hath long dwelt with them that hate peace.

title: Psalms 120:7
text: I [am for] peace; but when I speak, *they* [are] for war.

title: Psalms 121:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> I lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: whence shall my help come?

title: Psalms 121:2
text: My help [cometh] from Jehovah, who made the heavens and the earth.

title: Psalms 121:3
text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved; he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

title: Psalms 121:4
text: Behold, he that keepeth Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

title: Psalms 121:5
text: Jehovah is thy keeper, Jehovah is thy shade upon thy right hand;

title: Psalms 121:6
text: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

title: Psalms 121:7
text: Jehovah will keep thee from all evil; he will keep thy soul.

title: Psalms 121:8
text: Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in, from henceforth and for evermore.

title: Psalms 122:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees. Of David.>> I rejoiced when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 122:2
text: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

title: Psalms 122:3
text: Jerusalem, which art built as a city that is compact together,

title: Psalms 122:4
text: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of Jah, a testimony to Israel, to give thanks unto the name of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 122:5
text: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

title: Psalms 122:6
text: ¶Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

title: Psalms 122:7
text: Peace be within thy bulwarks, prosperity within thy palaces.

title: Psalms 122:8
text: For my brethren and companions' sakes I will say, Peace be within thee!

title: Psalms 122:9
text: Because of the house of Jehovah our God I will seek thy good.

title: Psalms 123:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> Unto thee do I lift up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

title: Psalms 123:2
text: Behold, as the eyes of servants [look] unto the hand of their masters, as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress, so our eyes [are directed] to Jehovah our God, until he be gracious unto us.

title: Psalms 123:3
text: Be gracious unto us, O Jehovah, be gracious unto us; for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

title: Psalms 123:4
text: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

title: Psalms 124:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees. Of David.>> If it had not been Jehovah who was for us--oh let Israel say--

title: Psalms 124:2
text: If it had not been Jehovah who was for us, when men rose up against us,

title: Psalms 124:3
text: Then they had swallowed us up alive, when their anger was kindled against us;

title: Psalms 124:4
text: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, a torrent had gone over our soul;

title: Psalms 124:5
text: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

title: Psalms 124:6
text: ¶Blessed be Jehovah, who gave us not up a prey to their teeth!

title: Psalms 124:7
text: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we have escaped.

title: Psalms 124:8
text: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, the maker of heavens and earth.

title: Psalms 125:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> They that confide in Jehovah are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved; it abideth for ever.

title: Psalms 125:2
text: Jerusalem! --mountains are round about her, and Jehovah is round about his people, from henceforth and for evermore.

title: Psalms 125:3
text: For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

title: Psalms 125:4
text: ¶Do good, O Jehovah, unto the good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

title: Psalms 125:5
text: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Jehovah will lead them forth with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel!

title: Psalms 126:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> When Jehovah turned the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

title: Psalms 126:2
text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with rejoicing: then said they among the nations, Jehovah hath done great things for them.

title: Psalms 126:3
text: Jehovah hath done great things for us; [and] we are joyful.

title: Psalms 126:4
text: ¶Turn our captivity, O Jehovah, as the streams in the south.

title: Psalms 126:5
text: They that sow in tears shall reap with rejoicing:

title: Psalms 126:6
text: He goeth forth and weepeth, bearing seed for scattering; he cometh again with rejoicing, bearing his sheaves.

title: Psalms 127:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees. Of Solomon.>> Unless Jehovah build the house, in vain do its builders labour in it; unless Jehovah keep the city, the keeper watcheth in vain:

title: Psalms 127:2
text: It is vain for you to rise up early, to lie down late, to eat the bread of sorrows: so to his beloved one he giveth sleep.

title: Psalms 127:3
text: Lo, children are an inheritance from Jehovah, [and] the fruit of the womb a reward.

title: Psalms 127:4
text: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.

title: Psalms 127:5
text: Happy is the man that hath filled his quiver with them. They shall not be ashamed when they speak with enemies in the gate.

title: Psalms 128:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> Blessed is every one that feareth Jehovah, that walketh in his ways.

title: Psalms 128:2
text: For thou shalt eat the labour of thy hands; happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

title: Psalms 128:3
text: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine in the inner part of thy house; thy children like olive-plants round about thy table.

title: Psalms 128:4
text: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed that feareth Jehovah.

title: Psalms 128:5
text: Jehovah will bless thee out of Zion; and mayest thou see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life,

title: Psalms 128:6
text: And see thy children's children. Peace be upon Israel!

title: Psalms 129:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth--oh let Israel say--

title: Psalms 129:2
text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth; yet they have not prevailed against me.

title: Psalms 129:3
text: The ploughers ploughed upon my back; they made long their furrows.

title: Psalms 129:4
text: Jehovah is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

title: Psalms 129:5
text: ¶Let them be ashamed and turned backward, all that hate Zion;

title: Psalms 129:6
text: Let them be as the grass upon the house-tops, which withereth before it is plucked up,

title: Psalms 129:7
text: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand, nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom;

title: Psalms 129:8
text: Neither do the passers-by say, The blessing of Jehovah be upon you; we bless you in the name of Jehovah!

title: Psalms 130:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> Out of the depths do I call upon thee, Jehovah.

title: Psalms 130:2
text: Lord, hear my voice; let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplication.

title: Psalms 130:3
text: If thou, Jah, shouldest mark iniquities, Lord, who shall stand?

title: Psalms 130:4
text: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

title: Psalms 130:5
text: ¶I wait for Jehovah; my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

title: Psalms 130:6
text: My soul [waiteth] for the Lord more than the watchers [wait] for the morning, [more than] the watchers for the morning.

title: Psalms 130:7
text: Let Israel hope in Jehovah, because with Jehovah there is loving-kindness, and with him is plenteous redemption;

title: Psalms 130:8
text: And he will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

title: Psalms 131:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees. Of David.>> Jehovah, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty; neither do I exercise myself in great matters, and in things too wonderful for me.

title: Psalms 131:2
text: Surely I have restrained and composed my soul, like a weaned child with its mother: my soul within me is as a weaned child.

title: Psalms 131:3
text: Let Israel hope in Jehovah, from henceforth and for evermore.

title: Psalms 132:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> Jehovah, remember for David all his affliction;

title: Psalms 132:2
text: How he swore unto Jehovah, vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:

title: Psalms 132:3
text: I will not come into the tent of my house, I will not go up to the couch of my bed;

title: Psalms 132:4
text: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, slumber to mine eyelids,

title: Psalms 132:5
text: Until I find out a place for Jehovah, habitations for the Mighty One of Jacob. ...

title: Psalms 132:6
text: Behold, we heard of it at Ephratah, we found it in the fields of the wood.

title: Psalms 132:7
text: Let us go into his habitations, let us worship at his footstool.

title: Psalms 132:8
text: Arise, Jehovah, into thy rest, thou and the ark of thy strength.

title: Psalms 132:9
text: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness, and let thy saints shout for joy.

title: Psalms 132:10
text: For thy servant David's sake, turn not away the face of thine anointed.

title: Psalms 132:11
text: ¶Jehovah hath sworn [in] truth unto David; he will not turn from it: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne;

title: Psalms 132:12
text: If thy children keep my covenant, and my testimonies which I will teach them, their children also for evermore shall sit upon thy throne.

title: Psalms 132:13
text: For Jehovah hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his dwelling:

title: Psalms 132:14
text: This is my rest for ever; here will I dwell, for I have desired it.

title: Psalms 132:15
text: I will abundantly bless her provision; I will satisfy her needy ones with bread;

title: Psalms 132:16
text: And I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

title: Psalms 132:17
text: There will I cause the horn of David to bud forth; I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

title: Psalms 132:18
text: His enemies will I clothe with shame; but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

title: Psalms 133:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees. Of David.>> Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

title: Psalms 133:2
text: Like the precious oil upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, upon Aaron's beard, that ran down to the hem of his garments;

title: Psalms 133:3
text: As the dew of Hermon that descendeth on the mountains of Zion; for there hath Jehovah commanded the blessing, life for evermore.

title: Psalms 134:1
text: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> Behold, bless Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah, who by night stand in the house of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 134:2
text: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless Jehovah.

title: Psalms 134:3
text: Jehovah, the maker of heavens and earth, bless thee out of Zion.

title: Psalms 135:1
text: ¶Hallelujah! Praise the name of Jehovah; praise, ye servants of Jehovah,

title: Psalms 135:2
text: Ye that stand in the house of Jehovah, in the courts of the house of our God.

title: Psalms 135:3
text: Praise ye Jah; for Jehovah is good: sing psalms unto his name; for it is pleasant.

title: Psalms 135:4
text: For Jah hath chosen Jacob unto himself, Israel for his own possession.

title: Psalms 135:5
text: ¶For *I* know that Jehovah is great, and our Lord is above all gods.

title: Psalms 135:6
text: Whatsoever Jehovah pleased, he hath done in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all deeps;

title: Psalms 135:7
text: Who causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; who maketh lightnings for the rain; who bringeth the wind out of his treasuries:

title: Psalms 135:8
text: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast;

title: Psalms 135:9
text: Who sent signs and miracles into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh and upon all his servants;

title: Psalms 135:10
text: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings,

title: Psalms 135:11
text: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan;

title: Psalms 135:12
text: And gave their land for an inheritance, an inheritance unto Israel his people.

title: Psalms 135:13
text: Thy name, O Jehovah, is for ever; thy memorial, O Jehovah, from generation to generation.

title: Psalms 135:14
text: For Jehovah will judge his people, and will repent in favour of his servants.

title: Psalms 135:15
text: ¶The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men's hands:

title: Psalms 135:16
text: They have a mouth, and they speak not; eyes have they, and they see not;

title: Psalms 135:17
text: They have ears, and they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouth.

title: Psalms 135:18
text: They that make them are like unto them, --every one that confideth in them.

title: Psalms 135:19
text: House of Israel, bless ye Jehovah; house of Aaron, bless ye Jehovah;

title: Psalms 135:20
text: House of Levi, bless ye Jehovah; ye that fear Jehovah, bless Jehovah.

title: Psalms 135:21
text: Blessed be Jehovah out of Zion, who dwelleth at Jerusalem! Hallelujah!

title: Psalms 136:1
text: ¶Give ye thanks unto Jehovah, for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:2
text: Give thanks unto the God of gods, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:3
text: Give thanks unto the Lord of lords, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 136:4
text: To him who alone doeth great wonders, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:5
text: To him that by understanding made the heavens, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:6
text: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:7
text: To him that made great lights, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:8
text: The sun for rule over the day, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

title: Psalms 136:9
text: The moon and stars for rule over the night, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:10
text: ¶To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

title: Psalms 136:11
text: And brought out Israel from among them, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

title: Psalms 136:12
text: With a powerful hand and with a stretched-out arm, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:13
text: To him that divided the Red sea into parts, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

title: Psalms 136:14
text: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

title: Psalms 136:15
text: And overturned Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:16
text: To him that led his people through the wilderness, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:17
text: To him that smote great kings, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

title: Psalms 136:18
text: And slew famous kings, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:19
text: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

title: Psalms 136:20
text: And Og king of Bashan, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:21
text: And gave their land for an inheritance, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

title: Psalms 136:22
text: An inheritance unto Israel his servant, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:23
text: ¶Who hath remembered us in our low estate, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:24
text: And hath delivered us from our oppressors, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:25
text: Who giveth food to all flesh, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 136:26
text: Give ye thanks unto the *God of the heavens; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 137:1
text: ¶By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down; yea, we wept when we remembered Zion.

title: Psalms 137:2
text: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

title: Psalms 137:3
text: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that made us wail [required] mirth, [saying,] Sing us [one] of the songs of Zion.

title: Psalms 137:4
text: How should we sing a song of Jehovah's upon a foreign soil?

title: Psalms 137:5
text: If I forget thee, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget [its skill];

title: Psalms 137:6
text: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to my palate: if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

title: Psalms 137:7
text: ¶Remember, O Jehovah, against the sons of Edom, the day of Jerusalem; who said, Lay [it] bare, Lay [it] bare, down to its foundation!

title: Psalms 137:8
text: Daughter of Babylon, who art to be laid waste, happy he that rendereth unto thee that which thou hast meted out to us.

title: Psalms 137:9
text: Happy he that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the rock.

title: Psalms 138:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> I will give thee thanks with my whole heart; before the gods will I sing psalms of thee.

title: Psalms 138:2
text: I will bow down toward the temple of thy holiness, and celebrate thy name for thy loving-kindness and for thy truth; for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

title: Psalms 138:3
text: In the day when I called thou answeredst me; thou didst encourage me with strength in my soul.

title: Psalms 138:4
text: All the kings of the earth shall celebrate thee, Jehovah, when they have heard the words of thy mouth;

title: Psalms 138:5
text: And they shall sing in the ways of Jehovah, for great is the glory of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 138:6
text: ¶For Jehovah is high; but he looketh upon the lowly, and the proud he knoweth afar off.

title: Psalms 138:7
text: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou wilt stretch forth thy hand against the anger of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

title: Psalms 138:8
text: Jehovah will perfect what concerneth me: thy loving-kindness, O Jehovah, [endureth] for ever; forsake not the works of thine own hands.

title: Psalms 139:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Jehovah, thou hast searched me, and known [me].

title: Psalms 139:2
text: *Thou* knowest my down-sitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off;

title: Psalms 139:3
text: Thou searchest out my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways;

title: Psalms 139:4
text: For there is not yet a word on my tongue, [but] lo, O Jehovah, thou knowest it altogether.

title: Psalms 139:5
text: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thy hand upon me.

title: Psalms 139:6
text: O knowledge too wonderful for me! it is high, I cannot [attain] unto it.

title: Psalms 139:7
text: ¶Whither shall I go from thy Spirit? and whither flee from thy presence?

title: Psalms 139:8
text: If I ascend up into the heavens thou art there; or if I make my bed in Sheol, behold, thou [art there];

title: Psalms 139:9
text: [If] I take the wings of the dawn [and] dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,

title: Psalms 139:10
text: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

title: Psalms 139:11
text: And if I say, Surely darkness shall cover me, and the light about me be night;

title: Psalms 139:12
text: Even darkness hideth not from thee, and the night shineth as the day: the darkness is as the light.

title: Psalms 139:13
text: For thou hast possessed my reins; thou didst cover me in my mother's womb.

title: Psalms 139:14
text: I will praise thee, for I am fearfully, wonderfully made. Marvellous are thy works; and [that] my soul knoweth right well.

title: Psalms 139:15
text: My bones were not hidden from thee when I was made in secret, curiously wrought in the lower parts of the earth.

title: Psalms 139:16
text: Thine eyes did see my unformed substance, and in thy book all [my members] were written; [during many] days were they fashioned, when [as yet] there was none of them.

title: Psalms 139:17
text: ¶But how precious are thy thoughts unto me, O *God! how great is the sum of them!

title: Psalms 139:18
text: [If] I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I awake, I am still with thee.

title: Psalms 139:19
text: Oh that thou wouldest slay the wicked, O +God! And ye men of blood, depart from me.

title: Psalms 139:20
text: For they speak of thee wickedly, they take [thy name] in vain, thine enemies.

title: Psalms 139:21
text: Do not I hate them, O Jehovah, that hate thee? and do not I loathe them that rise up against thee?

title: Psalms 139:22
text: I hate them with perfect hatred; I account them mine enemies.

title: Psalms 139:23
text: Search me, O *God, and know my heart; prove me, and know my thoughts;

title: Psalms 139:24
text: And see if there be any grievous way in me; and lead me in the way everlasting.

title: Psalms 140:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Free me, O Jehovah, from the evil man; preserve me from the violent man:

title: Psalms 140:2
text: Who devise mischiefs in [their] heart; every day are they banded together for war.

title: Psalms 140:3
text: They sharpen their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.

title: Psalms 140:4
text: Keep me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked [man], preserve me from the violent man, who devise to overthrow my steps.

title: Psalms 140:5
text: The proud have hidden a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the way-side; they have set traps for me. Selah.

title: Psalms 140:6
text: I have said unto Jehovah, Thou art my *God: give ear, O Jehovah, to the voice of my supplications.

title: Psalms 140:7
text: Jehovah, the Lord, is the strength of my salvation: thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

title: Psalms 140:8
text: ¶Grant not, O Jehovah, the desire of the wicked; further not his device: they would exalt themselves. Selah.

title: Psalms 140:9
text: [As for] the head of those that encompass me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

title: Psalms 140:10
text: Let burning coals fall on them; let them be cast into the fire; into deep waters, that they rise not up again.

title: Psalms 140:11
text: Let not the man of [evil] tongue be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the man of violence to [his] ruin.

title: Psalms 140:12
text: I know that Jehovah will maintain the cause of the afflicted one, the right of the needy.

title: Psalms 140:13
text: Yea, the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name; the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

title: Psalms 141:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Jehovah, I have called upon thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I call unto thee.

title: Psalms 141:2
text: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense, the lifting up of my hands as the evening oblation.

title: Psalms 141:3
text: Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

title: Psalms 141:4
text: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise deeds of wickedness with men that are workers of iniquity; and let me not eat of their dainties.

title: Psalms 141:5
text: ¶Let the righteous smite me, it is kindness; and let him reprove me, it is an excellent oil which my head shall not refuse: for yet my prayer also is [for them] in their calamities.

title: Psalms 141:6
text: When their judges are thrown down from the rocks, they shall hear my words, for they are sweet.

title: Psalms 141:7
text: Our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol, as when one cutteth and cleaveth [wood] upon the earth.

title: Psalms 141:8
text: For unto thee, Jehovah, Lord, are mine eyes; in thee do I trust: leave not my soul destitute.

title: Psalms 141:9
text: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, and from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

title: Psalms 141:10
text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that *I* withal pass over.

title: Psalms 142:1
text: ¶<<An instruction of David; when he was in the cave: a prayer.>> I cry unto Jehovah with my voice: with my voice unto Jehovah do I make supplication.

title: Psalms 142:2
text: I pour out my plaint before him; I shew before him my trouble.

title: Psalms 142:3
text: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then *thou* knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they hidden a snare for me.

title: Psalms 142:4
text: ¶Look on the right hand and see; there is no man that knoweth me: refuge hath failed me; no man careth for my soul.

title: Psalms 142:5
text: I cried unto thee, Jehovah; I said, Thou art my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.

title: Psalms 142:6
text: Attend unto my cry, for I am brought very low; deliver me from my persecutors, for they are stronger than I.

title: Psalms 142:7
text: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may celebrate thy name. The righteous shall surround me, because thou dealest bountifully with me.

title: Psalms 143:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Jehovah, hear my prayer; give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, in thy righteousness.

title: Psalms 143:2
text: And enter not into judgment with thy servant; for in thy sight no man living shall be justified.

title: Psalms 143:3
text: For the enemy persecuteth my soul: he hath crushed my life down to the earth; he hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.

title: Psalms 143:4
text: And my spirit is overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

title: Psalms 143:5
text: I remember the days of old: I meditate on all thy doing; I muse on the work of thy hands.

title: Psalms 143:6
text: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul, as a parched land, [thirsteth] after thee. Selah.

title: Psalms 143:7
text: ¶Answer me speedily, O Jehovah; my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, or I shall be like unto them that go down into the pit.

title: Psalms 143:8
text: Cause me to hear thy loving-kindness in the morning, for in thee do I confide; make me to know the way wherein I should walk, for unto thee do I lift up my soul.

title: Psalms 143:9
text: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from mine enemies: unto thee do I flee for refuge.

title: Psalms 143:10
text: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: let thy good Spirit lead me in a plain country.

title: Psalms 143:11
text: Revive me, O Jehovah, for thy name's sake; in thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble;

title: Psalms 143:12
text: And in thy loving-kindness cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that oppress my soul: for I am thy servant.

title: Psalms 144:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Blessed be Jehovah my rock, who teacheth my hands to war, my fingers to fight;

title: Psalms 144:2
text: My mercy and my fortress, my high tower and my deliverer, my shield and he in whom I trust, who subdueth my people under me!

title: Psalms 144:3
text: Jehovah, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him, the son of man, that thou takest thought of him?

title: Psalms 144:4
text: Man is like to vanity; his days are as a shadow that passeth away.

title: Psalms 144:5
text: Jehovah, bow thy heavens, and come down; touch the mountains, that they smoke;

title: Psalms 144:6
text: Cast forth lightnings, and scatter them; send forth thine arrows, and discomfit them:

title: Psalms 144:7
text: Stretch out thy hands from above; rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of aliens,

title: Psalms 144:8
text: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

title: Psalms 144:9
text: ¶O God, I will sing a new song unto thee; with the ten-stringed lute will I sing psalms unto thee:

title: Psalms 144:10
text: Who givest salvation unto kings; who rescuest David thy servant from the hurtful sword.

title: Psalms 144:11
text: Rescue me, and deliver me from the hand of aliens, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

title: Psalms 144:12
text: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; our daughters as corner-columns, sculptured after the fashion of a palace:

title: Psalms 144:13
text: Our granaries full, affording all manner of store; our sheep bringing forth thousands, ten thousands in our pastures;

title: Psalms 144:14
text: Our kine laden [with young]; no breaking in and no going forth, and no outcry in our streets.

title: Psalms 144:15
text: Blessed the people that is in such a case! Blessed the people whose God is Jehovah!

title: Psalms 145:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of praise. Of David.>> I will extol thee, my God, O King, and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 145:2
text: Every day will I bless thee, and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 145:3
text: Great is Jehovah, and exceedingly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

title: Psalms 145:4
text: One generation shall laud thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

title: Psalms 145:5
text: I will speak of the glorious splendour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.

title: Psalms 145:6
text: And they shall tell of the might of thy terrible acts; and thy great deeds will I declare.

title: Psalms 145:7
text: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

title: Psalms 145:8
text: Jehovah is gracious and merciful; slow to anger, and of great loving-kindness.

title: Psalms 145:9
text: Jehovah is good to all; and his tender mercies are over all his works.

title: Psalms 145:10
text: ¶All thy works shall praise thee, Jehovah, and thy saints shall bless thee.

title: Psalms 145:11
text: They shall tell of the glory of thy kingdom, and speak of thy power;

title: Psalms 145:12
text: To make known to the children of men his mighty acts, and the glorious splendour of his kingdom.

title: Psalms 145:13
text: Thy kingdom is a kingdom of all ages, and thy dominion is throughout all generations.

title: Psalms 145:14
text: Jehovah upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all that are bowed down.

title: Psalms 145:15
text: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their food in its season.

title: Psalms 145:16
text: Thou openest thy hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

title: Psalms 145:17
text: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways, and kind in all his works.

title: Psalms 145:18
text: Jehovah is nigh unto all that call upon him, unto all that call upon him in truth.

title: Psalms 145:19
text: He fulfilleth the desire of them that fear him; he heareth their cry, and saveth them.

title: Psalms 145:20
text: Jehovah keepeth all that love him, and all the wicked will he destroy.

title: Psalms 145:21
text: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah; and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 146:1
text: ¶Hallelujah! Praise Jehovah, O my soul.

title: Psalms 146:2
text: As long as I live will I praise Jehovah; I will sing psalms unto my God while I have my being.

title: Psalms 146:3
text: Put not confidence in nobles, in a son of man, in whom there is no salvation.

title: Psalms 146:4
text: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his purposes perish.

title: Psalms 146:5
text: ¶Blessed is he who hath the *God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Jehovah his God,

title: Psalms 146:6
text: Who made the heavens and the earth, the sea and all that is therein; who keepeth truth for ever;

title: Psalms 146:7
text: Who executeth judgment for the oppressed, who giveth bread to the hungry. Jehovah looseth the prisoners;

title: Psalms 146:8
text: Jehovah openeth [the eyes of] the blind; Jehovah raiseth up them that are bowed down; Jehovah loveth the righteous;

title: Psalms 146:9
text: Jehovah preserveth the strangers; he lifteth up the fatherless and the widow; but the way of the wicked doth he subvert.

title: Psalms 146:10
text: Jehovah will reign for ever, [even] thy God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Hallelujah!

title: Psalms 147:1
text: ¶Praise ye Jah! for it is good. Sing psalms of our God; for it is pleasant: praise is comely.

title: Psalms 147:2
text: Jehovah doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth the outcasts of Israel.

title: Psalms 147:3
text: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

title: Psalms 147:4
text: He counteth the number of the stars; he giveth names to them all.

title: Psalms 147:5
text: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.

title: Psalms 147:6
text: Jehovah lifteth up the meek; he abaseth the wicked to the earth.

title: Psalms 147:7
text: Sing unto Jehovah with thanksgiving; sing psalms upon the harp unto our God:

title: Psalms 147:8
text: Who covereth the heavens with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains;

title: Psalms 147:9
text: Who giveth to the cattle their food, to the young ravens which cry.

title: Psalms 147:10
text: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse, he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man;

title: Psalms 147:11
text: Jehovah taketh pleasure in those that fear him, in those that hope in his loving-kindness.

title: Psalms 147:12
text: ¶Laud Jehovah, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.

title: Psalms 147:13
text: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee;

title: Psalms 147:14
text: He maketh peace in thy borders; he satisfieth thee with the finest of the wheat.

title: Psalms 147:15
text: He sendeth forth his oracles to the earth: his word runneth very swiftly.

title: Psalms 147:16
text: He giveth snow like wool, scattereth the hoar frost like ashes;

title: Psalms 147:17
text: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

title: Psalms 147:18
text: He sendeth his word, and melteth them; he causeth his wind to blow--the waters flow.

title: Psalms 147:19
text: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.

title: Psalms 147:20
text: He hath not dealt thus with any nation; and as for [his] judgments, they have not known them. Hallelujah!

title: Psalms 148:1
text: ¶Hallelujah! Praise Jehovah from the heavens; praise him in the heights.

title: Psalms 148:2
text: Praise ye him, all his angels; praise ye him, all his hosts.

title: Psalms 148:3
text: Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all ye stars of light.

title: Psalms 148:4
text: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that are above the heavens.

title: Psalms 148:5
text: Let them praise the name of Jehovah, for he it is that commanded, and they were created:

title: Psalms 148:6
text: And he established them for ever and ever; he made [for them] a statute which shall not pass.

title: Psalms 148:7
text: ¶Praise Jehovah from the earth, ye sea-monsters, and all deeps;

title: Psalms 148:8
text: Fire and hail, snow and vapour, stormy wind fulfilling his word;

title: Psalms 148:9
text: Mountains and all hills, fruit-trees and all cedars;

title: Psalms 148:10
text: Beasts and all cattle, creeping things and winged fowl;

title: Psalms 148:11
text: Kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth;

title: Psalms 148:12
text: Both young men and maidens, old men with youths, --

title: Psalms 148:13
text: Let them praise the name of Jehovah: for his name alone is exalted; his majesty is above the earth and the heavens.

title: Psalms 148:14
text: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, [even] of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Hallelujah!

title: Psalms 149:1
text: ¶Hallelujah! Sing unto Jehovah a new song; [sing] his praise in the congregation of the godly.

title: Psalms 149:2
text: Let Israel rejoice in his Maker; let the sons of Zion be joyful in their King.

title: Psalms 149:3
text: Let them praise his name in the dance; let them sing psalms unto him with the tambour and harp.

title: Psalms 149:4
text: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people; he beautifieth the meek with salvation.

title: Psalms 149:5
text: Let the godly exult in glory; let them shout for joy upon their beds.

title: Psalms 149:6
text: ¶Let the high praises of *God be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand:

title: Psalms 149:7
text: To execute vengeance against the nations, [and] punishment among the peoples;

title: Psalms 149:8
text: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

title: Psalms 149:9
text: To execute upon them the judgment written. This honour have all his saints. Hallelujah!

title: Psalms 150:1
text: ¶Hallelujah! Praise *God in his sanctuary; praise him in the firmament of his power.

title: Psalms 150:2
text: Praise him in his mighty acts; praise him according to the abundance of his greatness.

title: Psalms 150:3
text: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet; praise him with lute and harp;

title: Psalms 150:4
text: Praise him with the tambour and dance; praise him with stringed instruments and the pipe;

title: Psalms 150:5
text: Praise him with loud cymbals; praise him with high sounding cymbals.

title: Psalms 150:6
text: Let everything that hath breath praise Jah. Hallelujah!

title: Proverbs 1:1
text: ¶Proverbs of Solomon, son of David, king of Israel:

title: Proverbs 1:2
text: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

title: Proverbs 1:3
text: to receive the instruction of wisdom, righteousness and judgment, and equity;

title: Proverbs 1:4
text: to give prudence to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.

title: Proverbs 1:5
text: He that is wise will hear, and will increase learning; and the intelligent will gain wise counsels:

title: Proverbs 1:6
text: to understand a proverb and an allegory, the words of the wise and their enigmas.

title: Proverbs 1:7
text: ¶The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of knowledge: fools despise wisdom and instruction.

title: Proverbs 1:8
text: Hear, my son, the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the teaching of thy mother;

title: Proverbs 1:9
text: for they shall be a garland of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.

title: Proverbs 1:10
text: ¶My son, if sinners entice thee, consent not.

title: Proverbs 1:11
text: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk secretly for the innocent without cause;

title: Proverbs 1:12
text: let us swallow them up alive as Sheol, and whole, as those that go down into the pit;

title: Proverbs 1:13
text: we shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:

title: Proverbs 1:14
text: cast in thy lot among us; we will all have one purse:

title: Proverbs 1:15
text: --my son, walk not in the way with them, keep back thy foot from their path;

title: Proverbs 1:16
text: for their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed blood.

title: Proverbs 1:17
text: For in vain the net is spread in the sight of anything which hath wings.

title: Proverbs 1:18
text: And these lay wait for their own blood; they lurk secretly for their own lives.

title: Proverbs 1:19
text: So are the paths of every one that is greedy of gain: it taketh away the life of its possessors.

title: Proverbs 1:20
text: ¶Wisdom crieth without; she raiseth her voice in the broadways;

title: Proverbs 1:21
text: she calleth in the chief [place] of concourse, in the entry of the gates; in the city she uttereth her words:

title: Proverbs 1:22
text: How long, simple ones, will ye love simpleness, and scorners take pleasure in their scorning, and the foolish hate knowledge?

title: Proverbs 1:23
text: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour forth my spirit unto you, I will make known to you my words.

title: Proverbs 1:24
text: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one regarded;

title: Proverbs 1:25
text: and ye have rejected all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:

title: Proverbs 1:26
text: I also will laugh in your calamity, I will mock when your fear cometh;

title: Proverbs 1:27
text: when your fear cometh as sudden destruction, and your calamity cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish come upon you:

title: Proverbs 1:28
text: --then will they call upon me, but I will not answer; they will seek me early, and shall not find me.

title: Proverbs 1:29
text: Because they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of Jehovah;

title: Proverbs 1:30
text: they would none of my counsel, they despised all my reproof:

title: Proverbs 1:31
text: therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their way, and be filled with their own devices.

title: Proverbs 1:32
text: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of the foolish shall cause them to perish.

title: Proverbs 1:33
text: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be at rest from fear of evil.

title: Proverbs 2:1
text: ¶My son, if thou receivest my words, and layest up my commandments with thee,

title: Proverbs 2:2
text: so that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom [and] thou apply thy heart to understanding;

title: Proverbs 2:3
text: yea, if thou criest after discernment [and] liftest up thy voice to understanding;

title: Proverbs 2:4
text: if thou seekest her as silver and searchest for her as for hidden treasures:

title: Proverbs 2:5
text: then shalt thou understand the fear of Jehovah, and find the knowledge of God.

title: Proverbs 2:6
text: For Jehovah giveth wisdom; out of his mouth [come] knowledge and understanding.

title: Proverbs 2:7
text: He layeth up sound wisdom for the upright; [he] is a shield to them that walk in integrity;

title: Proverbs 2:8
text: guarding the paths of just judgment and keeping the way of his godly ones.

title: Proverbs 2:9
text: Then shalt thou understand righteousness and judgment and equity: every good path.

title: Proverbs 2:10
text: ¶When wisdom entereth into thy heart and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul,

title: Proverbs 2:11
text: discretion shall keep thee, understanding shall preserve thee:

title: Proverbs 2:12
text: To deliver thee from the way of evil, from the man that speaketh froward things;

title: Proverbs 2:13
text: [from those] who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

title: Proverbs 2:14
text: who rejoice to do evil, [and] delight in the frowardness of evil;

title: Proverbs 2:15
text: whose paths are crooked, and who are perverted in their course:

title: Proverbs 2:16
text: To deliver thee from the strange woman, from the stranger who flattereth with her words;

title: Proverbs 2:17
text: who forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God;

title: Proverbs 2:18
text: --for her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead;

title: Proverbs 2:19
text: none that go unto her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life:

title: Proverbs 2:20
text: --that thou mayest walk in the way of the good, and keep the paths of the righteous.

title: Proverbs 2:21
text: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it;

title: Proverbs 2:22
text: but the wicked shall be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful shall be plucked up out of it.

title: Proverbs 3:1
text: ¶My son, forget not my teaching, and let thy heart observe my commandments;

title: Proverbs 3:2
text: for length of days, and years of life, and peace shall they add to thee.

title: Proverbs 3:3
text: Let not loving-kindness and truth forsake thee; bind them about thy neck, write them upon the tablet of thy heart:

title: Proverbs 3:4
text: and thou shalt find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

title: Proverbs 3:5
text: Confide in Jehovah with all thy heart, and lean not unto thine own intelligence;

title: Proverbs 3:6
text: in all thy ways acknowledge him, and he will make plain thy paths.

title: Proverbs 3:7
text: ¶Be not wise in thine own eyes; fear Jehovah, and depart from evil:

title: Proverbs 3:8
text: it shall be health for thy navel, and moisture for thy bones.

title: Proverbs 3:9
text: Honour Jehovah with thy substance, and with the first-fruits of all thine increase;

title: Proverbs 3:10
text: so shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy vats shall overflow with new wine.

title: Proverbs 3:11
text: My son, despise not the instruction of Jehovah, neither be weary of his chastisement;

title: Proverbs 3:12
text: for whom Jehovah loveth he chasteneth, even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.

title: Proverbs 3:13
text: ¶Blessed is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.

title: Proverbs 3:14
text: For the gain thereof is better than the gain of silver, and her revenue than fine gold.

title: Proverbs 3:15
text: She is more precious than rubies; and all the things thou canst desire are not equal unto her.

title: Proverbs 3:16
text: Length of days is in her right hand; in her left hand riches and honour.

title: Proverbs 3:17
text: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

title: Proverbs 3:18
text: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her; and happy is he that retaineth her.

title: Proverbs 3:19
text: Jehovah by wisdom founded the earth; by understanding he established the heavens.

title: Proverbs 3:20
text: By his knowledge the deeps were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

title: Proverbs 3:21
text: ¶My son, let them not depart from thine eyes; keep sound wisdom and discretion:

title: Proverbs 3:22
text: so shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace unto thy neck.

title: Proverbs 3:23
text: Then shalt thou walk in thy way securely, and thy foot shall not stumble;

title: Proverbs 3:24
text: when thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid, but thou shalt lie down and thy sleep shall be sweet.

title: Proverbs 3:25
text: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the destruction of the wicked, when it cometh;

title: Proverbs 3:26
text: for Jehovah shall be thy confidence, and he will keep thy foot from being taken.

title: Proverbs 3:27
text: ¶Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thy hand to do it.

title: Proverbs 3:28
text: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to-morrow I will give, when thou hast it by thee.

title: Proverbs 3:29
text: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

title: Proverbs 3:30
text: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.

title: Proverbs 3:31
text: Envy not the man of violence, and choose none of his ways.

title: Proverbs 3:32
text: For the perverse is an abomination to Jehovah; but his secret is with the upright.

title: Proverbs 3:33
text: The curse of Jehovah is in the house of the wicked; but he blesseth the habitation of the righteous.

title: Proverbs 3:34
text: He indeed scorneth the scorners; but he giveth grace unto the lowly.

title: Proverbs 3:35
text: The wise shall inherit glory; but shame shall be the promotion of the foolish.

title: Proverbs 4:1
