text: Thine own friend, and thy father's friend, forsake not; and go not into thy brother's house in the day of thy calamity: better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.

title: Proverbs 27:11
text: ¶Be wise, my son, and make my heart glad, that I may have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me.

title: Proverbs 27:12
text: ¶A prudent [man] seeth the evil, [and] hideth himself; the simple pass on, [and] are punished.

title: Proverbs 27:13
text: ¶Take his garment that is become surety [for] another, and hold him in pledge for a strange woman.

title: Proverbs 27:14
text: ¶He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be reckoned a curse to him.

title: Proverbs 27:15
text: ¶A continual dropping on a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike:

title: Proverbs 27:16
text: whosoever will restrain her restraineth the wind, and his right hand encountereth oil.

title: Proverbs 27:17
text: ¶Iron is sharpened by iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

title: Proverbs 27:18
text: ¶Whoso keepeth the fig-tree shall eat the fruit thereof; and he that guardeth his master shall be honoured.

title: Proverbs 27:19
text: ¶As [in] water face [answereth] to face, so the heart of man to man.

title: Proverbs 27:20
text: ¶Sheol and destruction are insatiable; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.

title: Proverbs 27:21
text: ¶The fining-pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold; so let a man be to the mouth that praiseth him.

title: Proverbs 27:22
text: ¶If thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his folly depart from him.

title: Proverbs 27:23
text: ¶Be well acquainted with the appearance of thy flocks; look well to thy herds:

title: Proverbs 27:24
text: for wealth is not for ever; and doth the crown [endure] from generation to generation?

title: Proverbs 27:25
text: The hay is removed, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered in.

title: Proverbs 27:26
text: The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of a field;

title: Proverbs 27:27
text: and there is goats' milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and sustenance for thy maidens.

title: Proverbs 28:1
text: ¶The wicked flee when no man pursueth; but the righteous are bold as a lion.

title: Proverbs 28:2
text: ¶By the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof; but by a man of understanding [and] of knowledge, [its] stability is prolonged.

title: Proverbs 28:3
text: ¶A poor man who oppresseth the helpless is a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.

title: Proverbs 28:4
text: ¶They that forsake the law praise the wicked; but such as keep the law contend with them.

title: Proverbs 28:5
text: ¶Evil men understand not judgment; but they that seek Jehovah understand everything.

title: Proverbs 28:6
text: ¶Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse, double in ways, though he be rich.

title: Proverbs 28:7
text: ¶Whoso observeth the law is a son that hath understanding; but he that is a companion of profligates bringeth shame to his father.

title: Proverbs 28:8
text: ¶He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance gathereth it for him that is gracious to the poor.

title: Proverbs 28:9
text: ¶He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

title: Proverbs 28:10
text: ¶Whoso causeth the upright to go astray in an evil way, shall himself fall into his own pit; but the perfect shall inherit good.

title: Proverbs 28:11
text: ¶A rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.

title: Proverbs 28:12
text: ¶When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men conceal themselves.

title: Proverbs 28:13
text: ¶He that covereth his transgressions shall not prosper; but whoso confesseth and forsaketh [them] shall obtain mercy.

title: Proverbs 28:14
text: ¶Happy is the man that feareth always; but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into evil.

title: Proverbs 28:15
text: ¶A roaring lion, and a ranging bear, is a wicked ruler over a poor people.

title: Proverbs 28:16
text: ¶The prince void of intelligence is also a great oppressor: he that hateth covetousness shall prolong [his] days.

title: Proverbs 28:17
text: ¶A man laden with the blood of [any] person, fleeth to the pit: let no man stay him.

title: Proverbs 28:18
text: ¶Whoso walketh in integrity shall be saved; but he that is perverted in [his] double ways, shall fall in one [of them].

title: Proverbs 28:19
text: ¶He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread; but he that followeth the worthless shall have poverty enough.

title: Proverbs 28:20
text: ¶A faithful man aboundeth with blessings; but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.

title: Proverbs 28:21
text: ¶To have respect of persons is not good; but for a piece of bread will a man transgress.

title: Proverbs 28:22
text: ¶He that hath an evil eye hasteth after wealth, and knoweth not that poverty shall come upon him.

title: Proverbs 28:23
text: ¶He that rebuketh a man shall afterwards find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.

title: Proverbs 28:24
text: ¶Whoso robbeth his father and his mother, and saith, It is no transgression, the same is the companion of a destroyer.

title: Proverbs 28:25
text: ¶He that is puffed up in soul exciteth contention; but he that relieth upon Jehovah shall be made fat.

title: Proverbs 28:26
text: ¶He that confideth in his own heart is a fool; but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.

title: Proverbs 28:27
text: ¶He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack; but he that withdraweth his eyes shall have many a curse.

title: Proverbs 28:28
text: ¶When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous increase.

title: Proverbs 29:1
text: ¶He that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and without remedy.

title: Proverbs 29:2
text: ¶When the righteous increase, the people rejoice; but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.

title: Proverbs 29:3
text: ¶Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father; but he that is a companion of harlots destroyeth [his] substance.

title: Proverbs 29:4
text: ¶A king by just judgment establisheth the land; but he that taketh gifts overthroweth it.

title: Proverbs 29:5
text: ¶A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his steps.

title: Proverbs 29:6
text: ¶In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare; but the righteous shall sing and rejoice.

title: Proverbs 29:7
text: ¶The righteous taketh knowledge of the cause of the poor; the wicked understandeth not knowledge.

title: Proverbs 29:8
text: ¶Scornful men set the city in a flame; but the wise turn away anger.

title: Proverbs 29:9
text: ¶If a wise man contendeth with a fool, whether he rage or laugh, [he] hath no rest.

title: Proverbs 29:10
text: ¶The bloodthirsty hate the perfect, but the upright care for his soul.

title: Proverbs 29:11
text: ¶A fool uttereth all his mind; but a wise [man] keepeth it back.

title: Proverbs 29:12
text: ¶If a ruler hearken to lying words, all his servants are wicked.

title: Proverbs 29:13
text: ¶The indigent and the oppressor meet together; Jehovah lighteneth the eyes of them both.

title: Proverbs 29:14
text: ¶A king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.

title: Proverbs 29:15
text: ¶The rod and reproof give wisdom; but a child left [to himself] bringeth his mother to shame.

title: Proverbs 29:16
text: ¶When the wicked increase, transgression increaseth; but the righteous shall see their fall.

title: Proverbs 29:17
text: ¶Chasten thy son, and he shall give thee rest, and shall give delight unto thy soul.

title: Proverbs 29:18
text: ¶Where there is no vision the people cast off restraint; but happy is he that keepeth the law.

title: Proverbs 29:19
text: ¶A servant is not corrected by words: he understandeth indeed, but he will not answer.

title: Proverbs 29:20
text: ¶Hast thou seen a man hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

title: Proverbs 29:21
text: ¶He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child, shall in the end have him as a son.

title: Proverbs 29:22
text: ¶An angry man exciteth contention; and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.

title: Proverbs 29:23
text: ¶A man's pride bringeth him low; but the humble in spirit shall obtain honour.

title: Proverbs 29:24
text: ¶Whoso shareth with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth the adjuration, and declareth not.

title: Proverbs 29:25
text: ¶The fear of man bringeth a snare; but whoso putteth his confidence in Jehovah is protected.

title: Proverbs 29:26
text: ¶Many seek the ruler's face; but a man's right judgment is from Jehovah.

title: Proverbs 29:27
text: ¶An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous; and he that is of upright way is an abomination to the wicked [man].

title: Proverbs 30:1
text: ¶The words of Agur the son of Jakeh; the prophecy uttered by the man unto Ithiel, [even] unto Ithiel and Ucal:

title: Proverbs 30:2
text: Truly *I* am more stupid than any one; and I have not a man's intelligence.

title: Proverbs 30:3
text: I have neither learned wisdom, nor have I the knowledge of the Holy.

title: Proverbs 30:4
text: Who hath ascended up into the heavens, and descended? Who hath gathered the wind in his fists? Who hath bound the waters in a mantle? Who hath established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son's name, if thou knowest?

title: Proverbs 30:5
text: Every word of +God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.

title: Proverbs 30:6
text: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.

title: Proverbs 30:7
text: ¶Two things do I ask of thee; deny me [them] not before I die:

title: Proverbs 30:8
text: Remove far from me vanity and lies; give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with the bread of my daily need:

title: Proverbs 30:9
text: lest I be full and deny [thee], and say, Who is Jehovah? or lest I be poor and steal, and outrage the name of my God.

title: Proverbs 30:10
text: ¶Speak not too much about a servant to his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be held guilty.

title: Proverbs 30:11
text: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother;

title: Proverbs 30:12
text: there is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness;

title: Proverbs 30:13
text: there is a generation, --how lofty are their eyes, how their eyelids are lifted up!

title: Proverbs 30:14
text: --a generation whose teeth are swords, and their jaw-teeth knives, to devour the afflicted from off the earth, and the needy from [among] men.

title: Proverbs 30:15
text: ¶The leech hath two daughters: Give, give. There are three [things] never satisfied; four which say not, It is enough:

title: Proverbs 30:16
text: --Sheol, and the barren womb; the earth which is not filled with water, and the fire which saith not, It is enough.

title: Proverbs 30:17
text: The eye that mocketh at a father, and despiseth to obey a mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.

title: Proverbs 30:18
text: ¶There are three [things] too wonderful for me, and four that I know not:

title: Proverbs 30:19
text: The way of an eagle in the heavens, the way of a serpent upon a rock, the way of a ship in the midst of the sea, and the way of a man with a maid.

title: Proverbs 30:20
text: Such is the way of an adulterous woman: she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.

title: Proverbs 30:21
text: Under three [things] the earth is disquieted, and under four it cannot bear up:

title: Proverbs 30:22
text: Under a servant when he reigneth, and a churl when he is filled with meat;

title: Proverbs 30:23
text: under an odious [woman] when she is married, and a handmaid when she is heir to her mistress.

title: Proverbs 30:24
text: ¶There are four [things] little upon the earth, and they are exceeding wise:

title: Proverbs 30:25
text: The ants, a people not strong, yet they provide their food in the summer;

title: Proverbs 30:26
text: the rock-badgers are but a feeble folk, yet they make their house in the cliff;

title: Proverbs 30:27
text: the locusts have no king, yet they go forth all of them by bands;

title: Proverbs 30:28
text: thou takest hold of the lizard with the hands, yet is she in kings' palaces.

title: Proverbs 30:29
text: ¶There are three [things] which have a stately step, and four are comely in going:

title: Proverbs 30:30
text: The lion, mighty among beasts, which turneth not away for any;

title: Proverbs 30:31
text: a [horse] girt in the loins; or the he-goat; and a king, against whom none can rise up.

title: Proverbs 30:32
text: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, [lay] the hand upon thy mouth.

title: Proverbs 30:33
text: For the pressing of milk bringeth forth butter, and the pressing of the nose bringeth forth blood; and the pressing of anger bringeth forth strife.

title: Proverbs 31:1
text: ¶The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him:

title: Proverbs 31:2
text: What, my son? and what, O son of my womb? and what, O son of my vows?

title: Proverbs 31:3
text: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to them that destroy kings.

title: Proverbs 31:4
text: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for rulers [to say], Where is the strong drink?

title: Proverbs 31:5
text: --lest they drink and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the children of affliction.

title: Proverbs 31:6
text: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto the bitter of soul:

title: Proverbs 31:7
text: let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

title: Proverbs 31:8
text: Open thy mouth for the dumb, for the cause of all those that are left desolate.

title: Proverbs 31:9
text: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and minister justice to the afflicted and needy.

title: Proverbs 31:10
text: ¶Who can find a woman of worth? for her price is far above rubies.

title: Proverbs 31:11
text: The heart of her husband confideth in her, and he shall have no lack of spoil.

title: Proverbs 31:12
text: She doeth him good, and not evil, all the days of her life.

title: Proverbs 31:13
text: She seeketh wool and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.

title: Proverbs 31:14
text: She is like the merchants' ships: she bringeth her food from afar;

title: Proverbs 31:15
text: And she riseth while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and the day's work to her maidens.

title: Proverbs 31:16
text: She considereth a field, and acquireth it; of the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.

title: Proverbs 31:17
text: She girdeth her loins with strength, and maketh strong her arms.

title: Proverbs 31:18
text: She perceiveth that her earning is good; her lamp goeth not out by night.

title: Proverbs 31:19
text: She putteth her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

title: Proverbs 31:20
text: She stretcheth out her hand to the afflicted, and she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.

title: Proverbs 31:21
text: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

title: Proverbs 31:22
text: She maketh herself coverlets; her clothing is byssus and purple.

title: Proverbs 31:23
text: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.

title: Proverbs 31:24
text: She maketh body linen and selleth it, and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.

title: Proverbs 31:25
text: Strength and dignity are her clothing, and she laugheth [at] the coming day.

title: Proverbs 31:26
text: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and upon her tongue is the law of kindness.

title: Proverbs 31:27
text: She surveyeth the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.

title: Proverbs 31:28
text: Her children rise up and call her blessed; her husband [also], and he praiseth her:

title: Proverbs 31:29
text: Many daughters have done worthily, but thou excellest them all.

title: Proverbs 31:30
text: Gracefulness is deceitful and beauty is vain; a woman [that] feareth Jehovah, she shall be praised.

title: Proverbs 31:31
text: Give her of the fruit of her hands, and let her own works praise her in the gates.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:1
text: ¶The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:2
text: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities! all is vanity.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:3
text: What profit hath man of all his labour wherewith he laboureth under the sun?

title: Ecclesiastes 1:4
text: ¶[One] generation passeth away, and [another] generation cometh, but the earth standeth for ever.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:5
text: The sun also riseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to its place where it ariseth.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:6
text: The wind goeth towards the south, and turneth about towards the north: it turneth about continually, and the wind returneth again to its circuits.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:7
text: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full: unto the place whither the rivers go, thither they go again.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:8
text: All things are full of toil; none can express it. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:9
text: ¶That which hath been is that which shall be; and that which hath been done is that which will be done: and there is nothing new under the sun.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:10
text: Is there a thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? It hath been already in the ages which were before us.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:11
text: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be remembrance of things that are to come with those who shall live afterwards.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:12
text: ¶I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:13
text: And I applied my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the heavens: this grievous occupation hath God given to the children of men to weary themselves therewith.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:14
text: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun, and behold, all is vanity and pursuit of the wind.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:15
text: That which is crooked cannot be made straight; and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:16
text: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I have become great and have acquired wisdom more than all they that have been before me over Jerusalem; and my heart hath seen much of wisdom and knowledge.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:17
text: And I applied my heart to the knowledge of wisdom, and to the knowledge of madness and folly: I perceived that this also is a striving after the wind.

title: Ecclesiastes 1:18
text: For in much wisdom is much vexation, and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.

title: Ecclesiastes 2:1
text: ¶I said in my heart, Come now, I will try thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure. But behold, this also is vanity.

title: Ecclesiastes 2:2
text: I said of laughter, Madness! and of mirth, What availeth it?

title: Ecclesiastes 2:3
text: I searched in my heart how to cherish my flesh with wine, while practising my heart with wisdom; and how to lay hold on folly, till I should see what was that good for the children of men which they should do under the heavens all the days of their life.

title: Ecclesiastes 2:4
text: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards;

title: Ecclesiastes 2:5
text: I made me gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of every kind of fruit;

title: Ecclesiastes 2:6
text: I made me ponds of water, to water therewith the wood, where the trees are reared.

title: Ecclesiastes 2:7
text: I acquired servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all that had been in Jerusalem before me.

title: Ecclesiastes 2:8
text: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces; I got me men-singers and women-singers, and the delights of the children of men, a wife and concubines.

title: Ecclesiastes 2:9
text: And I became great, and increased more than all that had been before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.

title: Ecclesiastes 2:10
text: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them: I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour, and this was my portion from all my labour.
